jobs.title: Head Operational Excellence Europe (m/f/d) (Operations Manager/in)
jobs.description:
To further strengthen our Operations & Supply Chain organization, we are looking for an experienced Head of Operational Excellence at Group level.

This high-impact role, reporting directly to the COO, offers a unique opportunity to design, build, and implement the Operational Excellence system from the start. You will operate within an international environment with multiple manufacturing sites.

In this initial phase, you will take the lead in developing and rolling out the foundation of our Operational Excellence framework, driving sustainable operational improvements throughout the organization.

Your mission

- In the first phase, your key responsibility will be to: - Design and establish the Group-wide Operational Excellence Production System
- Build the standards, tools and governance needed for sustainable implementation
- Create and roll out structured processes across Production, Logistics and Quality
- Set up performance management (KPI cascade, visual management, gap analysis)
- Develop and initiate the first wave of improvement projects and cost optimization pipeline
- Following this setup phase, you will: - Drive year-on-year efficiency improvements
- Scale and embed Lean & Six Sigma methodologies across all sites
- Act as a change leader, embedding mindset, behavior and capabilities

Your profile

- Master’s degree in engineering with strong analytical and statistical skills
- At least 3 years of leadership experience in a complex operations/manufacturing environment
- Strong track record in building and implementing Operational Excellence frameworks from the ground up
- Deep expertise in Lean / Six Sigma (Green/Black Belt preferred)
- Structured, hands-on and capable of turning concepts into execution
- Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
- Willingness to travel across Europe (25–50%)
- Fluent in English and preferably German

Benefits

- **Work-life balance:** We offer flexible working hours in a hybrid work environment
- **Time off & flexibility:** With 30 days of vacation per year and flexible scheduling
- **Quick decision-making & autonomy:** You’ll benefit from quick decision-making and plenty of freedom to pursue your own ideas and creative solutions
- **Motivated team & international environment:** Work in a dedicated team with colleagues from different countries and cultures
- Individual management coaching: We support your personal and professional development through individual coaching
- **Exciting tasks:** Look forward to varied responsibilities in a sustainable and innovative company
- **Comprehensive benefits:** Enjoy advantages such as capital-forming benefits, TicketPlus, Hansefit and exclusive discounts

Your next step - get in touch!

We welcome your application, including details of your salary expectations and your earliest possible start date. For initial contact, please reach out to Roman Heizmann, Recruiting Manager.

jobs.title: Technical Advisor / Principal Architect, Office of the CTO
jobs.description:
Postulation uniquement en ligne - merci de mentionner sous source (ORP)

Kandou AI is redefining the economics of AI infrastructure. Our proprietary MIMO‑over‑copper technology powers a high‑performance, chiplet‑based AI memory fabric that delivers high bandwidth and ultra‑low latency at dramatically lower power. Our architecture represents a foundational shift in how next‑generation AI hardware is built.

We are seeking a Technical Advisor / Principal Architect to work directly with the CTO on the conception, modeling, and development of breakthrough communication and interconnect technologies.

This is a rare opportunity for an engineer who thrives at the intersection of theory, architecture, and silicon implementation — someone who wants to help shape the future of chip‑to‑chip, die‑to‑die, memory, and networking interconnects.

Role Overview:
You will partner closely with the CTO to explore, evaluate, and prototype next‑generation communication system architectures. This role spans research, modeling, algorithm development, system architecture, and early‑stage silicon feasibility. You will help translate theoretical concepts into implementable designs that can scale into real products.

What You Will Do:
Partner with the CTO to develop next-generation communication and interconnect architectures.
Explore novel signaling, coding, equalization, and system-level techniques.
Build models, simulations, and prototypes to validate architectural concepts.
Evaluate performance, power, latency, area, and manufacturability tradeoffs.
Translate research into silicon-ready architectures and intellectual property.
Identify emerging technologies and opportunities for competitive differentiation.
Provide technical leadership and guidance across research, architecture, and product teams

Required Qualifications:
Advanced degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or related field.
Strong background in digital communications and communication system fundamentals.
Deep understanding of information theory, coding, modulation, and signal processing.
Experience building mathematical models, simulations, or prototypes.
Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, C++, or similar environments.
Ability to work across abstraction levels — from theory to architecture to implementation.
Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills; comfortable exploring unfamiliar domains.

Highly Desirable Experience (streamlined):
SerDes architecture, equalization, or wireline communications.
Coding theory, FEC, or advanced modulation schemes.
System‑level modeling (SystemC or equivalent).
Machine learning applied to communications.
Experience taking concepts from theory to silicon.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

The ideal candidate:
Moves fluidly between mathematics, algorithms, architecture, and hardware.
Is willing and able to be hands-on when needed, diving into analysis, modeling, coding, simulation, debugging, or lab work to help move critical projects forward.
Is intellectually curious and thrives on open‑ended technical challenges.
Challenges assumptions and proposes unconventional approaches when needed.
Understands that elegant theory must ultimately translate into manufacturable silicon.

jobs.title: Lead SAP Application Developer
jobs.description:
Lead SAP Application Developer  
You will work 80–100% of the time in Zug and partly remotely  
Lead SAP Application Developer  
V\-ZUG Information \& Communication Technology \- Business Applications  
V\-ZUG Business Applications is a division within the ICT organisation in the Digital Transformation \& Business Development department. The team is responsible for the V\-ZUG Group's business applications (SAP, Microsoft and others) and implements V\-ZUG's digital vision through strategic projects. We develop solutions, consult the business units and ensure smooth and stable operation of the systems – working together and taking a hands\-on approach.  
What this position offers you  
The focus is on the development and enhancement of SAP applications (ABAP, ABAP OO, interfaces, forms, Fiori/UI5, OData services, CDS views, enhancements, upgrades, authorisations and so on) in line with SAFe priorities  
As a technical leader, you will manage and coordinate both internal and external experts, ensure that developer guidelines and governance are adhered to, oversee code reviews and guarantee efficient resource planning  
You are proficient in using modern development platforms such as Eclipse IDE, VS Code or Business Application Studio and work with the latest technologies such as the ABAP RESTful Application Programming Model  
Together with the team, you will implement sustainable changes to the SAP system, provide second\- and third\-level support for our entire SAP environment (SAP HANA and R/3 systems), and ensure the stable operation of the systems  
You will help define and further develop the SAP roadmap, particularly with regard to clean core, technology trends and the integration platform based on SAP BTP and Azure Integration Services. In close cooperation with the ICT Enterprise Architecture organisation, you will contribute to building a stable and future\-proof system landscape  
What you can bring to this position  
You hold a degree in Computer Science, Business Informatics or an equivalent qualification  
You have extensive experience with SAP and ABAP, particularly with ABAP OO, RAP, CDS views as well as BAPIs, BADIs and enhancement frameworks  
You have a clear understanding of SAP architecture (S/4HANA, Fiori, SAP BTP) and experience with integrations via RFC, IDoc, SOAP, OData or APIs  
Thanks to your experience in technical leadership, you can manage complex technical issues, consult the business and delegate tasks effectively and strengthen the team's skills  
You work independent with high quality; clean code principles and best practices are well known to you  
Experience with SAFe or other agile methodologies is an advantage, as well as your willingness to actively put new technologies – such as AI\-based approaches – into practice  
Not yet convinced? V\-ZUG offers you more than just a job  
As part of the V\-ZUG family, you will benefit from modern employment conditions, a wide range of development opportunities, a suitable infrastructure and numerous offers and services for your personal wellbeing.  
What are you waiting for?  
Jennifer Stöver, Talent Acquisition Partner, is happy to provide you with further details.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer / E-Mail Security  - 100% remote
jobs.description:
Technical Support Engineer / E\-Mail Security (m/w/d) \- 100% remote  
Technical Support Engineer / E\-Mail Security (m/w/d)  
Seit über 25 Jahren entwickeln wir bei SEPPmail wegweisende Secure\-E\-Mail\-Lösungen, die Inhalte und Absenderidentität zuverlässig schützen und Spam oder Malware zuverlässig in ihre Schranken weisen – ohne technische Hürden für Absender oder Empfänger, flexibel integrierbar und immer mit höchstem Anspruch an Sicherheit und Vertraulichkeit. Über 3\.400 Endkunden aus Branchen wie Medizin, Energie, Finanz\- und Versicherungswesen, öffentlicher Verwaltung, Pharma und Recht vertrauen auf unsere Technologie, um ihre E\-Mail\-Kommunikation sicher zu gestalten.  
Mit Sitz in der Schweiz und Deutschland verbinden wir die Präzision und Verlässlichkeit eines Taschenmessers mit deutscher Gründlichkeit. Unsere zentralen Werte – Offenheit, Zuverlässigkeit, Wertschätzung und Kompetenz – prägen die Zusammenarbeit im Team genauso wie den Umgang mit unseren Kunden und Partnern.  
SEPPmail ist Teil von Partners, einem auf Softwareunternehmen spezialisierten PE\-Unternehmen. Partners stellt ein ausgezeichnetes Netzwerk an Branchen\-/Industrie\-Experten zur Verfügung und leistet so einen erheblichen Mehrwert für die persönliche und unternehmerische Weiterentwicklung.  
Zur Verstärkung unseres Support\-Teams suchen wir eine service\- und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit, die unsere Kunden bei technischen Fragen rund um unsere E\-Mail\-Security\-Lösungen kompetent und freundlich unterstützt.  
Diese Stelle ist vollständig im Homeoffice zu besetzen \- Du kannst von überall in Deutschland oder der Schweiz aus arbeiten.  
Aufgaben  
Du übernimmst den technischen Support für unsere Kunden und analysierst und behebst E\-Mail\-Zustellungsprobleme, z.B. im Zusammenhang mit Blacklisting oder DNS\-Einträgen wie MX, SPF, DKIM und DMARC  
Du unterstützt bei der Konfiguration und dem Betrieb unserer Mailserver\-Lösungen, insbesondere auf Basis von Postfix, und arbeitest sicher mit Linux\-Servern (idealerweise Debian/Ubuntu oder CentOS/RHEL) auf Kommandozeilenebene  
Du hilfst Endnutzern auch bei grundlegenden Fragen rund um Windows\-Betriebssysteme weiter  
Du nutzt dein Verständnis von TCP/IP, DNS, Firewall\-Regeln und grundlegenden Netzwerkdiensten zur Fehleranalyse  
Du automatisierst wiederkehrende Aufgaben und die Analyse von Logdateien, idealerweise mit Shell\-Skripten (Bash), und nutzt bei Bedarf Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken zur Auswertung von Kunden\- und Systemdaten  
Du erklärst komplexe technische Sachverhalte verständlich und kundenfreundlich – sowohl gegenüber technisch versierten Nutzern als auch Laien – und dokumentierst Lösungen und Prozesse sorgfältig  
Du bringst dich aktiv ins Team ein, teilst dein Wissen mit Kolleg:innen und beteiligst dich proaktiv an gemeinsamen Projekten  
Qualifikation  
Deine Skills  
Must have: E\-Mail\-Protokolle (SMTP, DNS), Postfix, Linux\-Kommandozeile, Fehleranalyse bei E\-Mail\-Zustellung (Blacklisting, MX/SPF/DKIM/DMARC), Netzwerkgrundlagen (TCP/IP, DNS, Firewall)  
Nice to have: Bash\-Skripting, Grundkenntnisse relationaler Datenbanken, Grundkenntnisse Windows  
Dein Profil  
Abgeschlossene Ausbildung im Bereich Informatik, Fachinformatik (Systemintegration/Anwendungsentwicklung) oder vergleichbare Qualifikation, sowie erste Berufserfahrung im IT\-Support, idealerweise bei einem Internet Service Provider (ISP) oder im Hosting\-Umfeld  
Ausgeprägte analytische Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie die Fähigkeit, auch unter Druck einen kühlen Kopf zu bewahren und logische Schlussfolgerungen zu ziehen  
Exzellente mündliche und schriftliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten in Deutsch und Englisch, ösisch von Vorteil  
Hohe Service\- und Kundenorientierung sowie ein freundliches, geduldiges und empathisches Auftreten – auch in schwierigen Situationen  
Verständnis für IT\-Sicherheitspraktiken, insbesondere im Kontext von E\-Mail (Phishing, Spam, Verschlüsselung)  
Teamfähigkeit, Freude am Wissensaustausch und Vertrautheit mit Remote\-Arbeit bzw. geografisch verteilten Teams  
Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Eigeninitiative und eine strukturierte, sorgfältige Arbeitsweise mit klarer Prioritätensetzung  
Benefits  
Eine verantwortungsvolle Position bei einem etablierten, PE\-backed Marktführer im Bereich E\-Mail\-Security mit über 25 Jahren Erfahrung  
Die Möglichkeit, im Homeoffice bzw. remote in einem verteilten Team zu arbeiten  
Kurze Entscheidungswege, flache Hierarchien und eine offene, wertschätzende Unternehmenskultur  
Raum für Eigeninitiative sowie kontinuierliche Weiterbildung in neuen Technologien und internen Systemen  
Ein Team, das Wissensaustausch und gegenseitige Förderung aktiv lebt  
Spannende, sicherheitskritische Produkte mit direktem Kundennutzen für namhafte Unternehmen und Institutionen  
Deine Perspektive  
Bei SEPPmail übernimmst du von Anfang an Verantwortung im direkten Kundenkontakt für Produkte, die täglich von tausenden Nutzer:innen europaweit im Einsatz sind. Du entwickelst dich fachlich weiter, vertiefst dein Know\-how rund um E\-Mail\-Security und Mailserver\-Technologien und wächst mit den Anforderungen unserer Kunden. Im Kontext des dynamischen Wachstums des Unternehmens ergeben sich perspektivisch Möglichkeiten zur persönlichen Weiterentwicklung und Karriereplanung.  
Ansprechpartner  
Schreiber, Recruiterin bei SEPPmail

Stillingen som overenskomstansat hospicepræst på Sct. Maria hospice i Vejle Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. oktober 2026.

Stillingen er en deltidsstilling på 18,5 timer.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

I embedsbeskrivelsen kan du læse mere om opgaverne. Embedsbeskrivelsen kan læses på Haderslev Stifts hjemmeside Ledige stillinger | Haderslev Stift og på Præsteforeningens hjemmeside.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Sct. Maria Hospice kan du også orientere dig deres hjemmeside: Forside - Sct. Maria Hospice

Ansættelse og aflønning sker i henhold til den Cirkulære om overenskomst for Akademikere i staten

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Du vil også få et særligt tillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 på kr. 11.100,00 årligt for en fuldtidsstilling. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er ikke knyttet nogen tjenestebolig til stillingen.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både hospiceleder og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

jobs.title: NYT GENOPSLAG - Sognepræst i Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat, Vesthimmerlands Provsti, Viborg Stift
jobs.description:
Stillingen som tjenestemandsansat sognepræst i Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat, Vesthimmerlands Provsti er ledig til besættelse den 1. oktober 2026 eller snarest derefter.

Til stillingen er knyttet en forpligtelse som kirkebogsfører og begravelsesmyndighed.

Stillingen er en fuldtidsstilling.

Som ny sognepræst får du et introduktionsforløb, hvor du får en mentor, der guider dig igennem i den første tid i embedet og sætter dig nærmere ind i de forskellige arbejdsopgaver, der er for en præst.

I embedsbeskrivelsen fra menighedsrådet kan du læse om sognet / pastoratet og hvilke tanker, menighedsrådet gør sig om det ledige embede. Embedsbeskrivelsen kan læses på Viborg Stifts hjemmeside www.viborgstift.dk og på stiftets sociale medier samt på Præsteforeningens hjemmeside.

Har du lyst til at læse mere om Ranum-Malle-Vilsted Pastorat og hvordan kirkelivet m.v. er i sognene / Pastoratet, kan du også orientere dig på Pastoratets hjemmeside: www.ranum-malle-vilsted.dk.

Stillingen er omfattet af Bekendtgørelse af lov om ansættelse i stillinger i folkekirken m.v. (LBK nr. 864 af 25/6/2013)

Stillingen aflønnes efter løngruppe 1 i aftale om aflønning af tjenestemandsansatte præster i folkekirken.

Ud over selve lønnen ydes et rådighedstillæg med et afrundet grundbeløb pr. 31. marts 2012 for en fuldtidsstilling på kr. 43.000,00 årligt. Ved deltidsansættelse vil der ske beregning af tillægget i forhold til ansættelseskvoten.

Stillingen er omfattet af reglerne om Ny Løn, hvorfor det er muligt at ønske en lønforhandling.

Der er knyttet tjenestebolig til stillingen. Tjenesteboligen ligger på adressen Solbakkevej 8A, 9680 Ranum.

Boligbidraget for tjenesteboligen excl. udgifter til el, vand og varme udgør på nuværende tidspunkt kr. 3731,00. Tjenesteboligen vil blive vurderet inden indflytning, og boligbidraget vil blive fastsat ud fra denne vurdering.

Det forudsættes, at ansøgere har kørekort til almindelig bil (B) og er villig til at bruge egen bil i jobbet.

Er du endnu ikke ordineret, bedes du sende kopi af eksamenspapirer og attest fra Pastoralseminariet sammen med din ansøgning.

Hvis du indstilles til stillingen, vil der blive indhentet børneattest.

Alle kvalificerede ansøgere uanset køn opfordres til at søge stillingen.

Er du interesseret i stillingen og ønsker at sende en ansøgning, bedes du kontakte både menighedsråd og provst for at aftale et tidspunkt for et besøg og en samtale, inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Er det første gang du søger embede, bedes du kontakte biskoppens sekretær for at aftale et tidspunkt for en samtale med biskop Henrik Stubkjær, ligeledes inden ansøgningsfristen udløber.

Ansøgningen skal stiles til Kirkeministeriet, men skal sendes til biskoppen over Viborg Stift pr. mail til: kmvib@km.dk. Ansøgningen skal være biskoppen i hænde senest opslagets udløbsdato kl. 15.00.

jobs.title: Mobile Product Designer
jobs.description:
At Linear, we're building the product development system for teams and agents. AI is fundamentally changing how software gets built, and we’re shaping the tools this new era requires. 

Founded in 2019, Linear has become the platform of choice for more than 30,000 companies (including OpenAI, Coinbase, and Ramp) to plan, build, and ship their products. Today, our team is distributed across North America, Europe, and Australia, and we’re continuing to grow internationally. What unites us is relentless focus, fast execution, and a deep care for software craftsmanship.

Quality is our competitive advantage. Every member of our fully remote team is a maker at heart, caring deeply about the quality and feel of our work. While the industry optimizes for speed and metrics alone, we believe that craft and quality have lasting value. Quality creates gravity — it pulls people toward our team and product rather than requiring us to push. This philosophy drives everything we do, from product decisions to hiring choices.

For this role, we expect robust design skills, sharp product thinking, and the ability to engage in technical discussions. We work in small, autonomous project teams, where engineers are paired tightly with designers to explore ideas, build prototypes, deploy internal builds, and ultimately ship to customers. You will be a key element of projects from beginning to end.

Location & work mode

Linear is a remote-first company, with optional co-working offices in San Francisco, New York, and London. This role is open to candidates based in North America. You can work from anywhere within this region. We value deep focus and async collaboration, with intentional moments to connect in person through team off-sites, optional co-working, and occasional travel.

What you'll do

 - Own the experience of our iOS and Android mobile apps, including guiding the adaptation of desktop features to mobile

 - Pair closely with mobile engineers and product leads to initiate and complete mobile-specific projects, no hand-offs

 - Take opportunities to redesign or refine key screens and flows, as well as smaller quality issues and “paper cuts” as you use Linear

 - Create mockups, prototypes, and high-fidelity visuals to communicate ideas and describe their execution

 - Guide and inspire fellow designers through collaborative critique of work-in-progress across both mobile and desktop platforms

 - Use and improve our lightweight design system components

 - Help with hiring new teammates that can elevate our team and product

What we’re looking for

 - 5+ years experience designing software, with mobile-specific emphasis

 - Courage to ask questions, experiment, and advocate for what you feel is right

 - Humility to accept feedback, adapt your thinking, and iterate toward the best solution

 - Experience with prototyping directly in code, or with tools like Figma, Origami, etc

 - Ability to distill problems and feedback, then design clear, focused solutions

 - Effective written and verbal communication skills — much of our work is async

What we offer

We're a small, focused team that cares deeply about the quality of our work and the people we do it with. Here's what you can expect:

 - Competitive salary and equity

 - Employee-friendly equity terms including early exercise in the US and extended exercise windows

 - Daily meal and coffee stipend on every workday

 - Paid co-working space or desk

 - Health coverage (based on country requirements)

 - 5 weeks paid vacation, plus local statutory holidays

 - 4 months paid parental leave

 - Paid month off after 4 years & every 2 years thereafter

 - Regular team events and off-sites

 - Remote-first with no required commute

Learn how we think and work

 - Part I https://linear.app/blog/a-design-reset and Part II https://linear.app/blog/how-we-redesigned-the-linear-ui of how we redesigned the Linear UI

 - Our hiring process: How we hire at Linear https://linear.app/now/how-we-hire-at-linear

 - Read me https://linear.app/readme a story about our mission

 - Why and how we do work trials https://linear.app/blog/why-and-how-we-do-work-trials-at-linear Linear blog post

 - How we structure our product teams https://www.youtube.com/watch?index=59&list=PLXDU_eVOJTx402DljIPagaDKLibF-qfF0&v=I4vvBidQcck talk by our Head of Product, Nan Yu, at Config 2024

 - Crafting quality that endures https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pCil7YNhNCU Config keynote by our Co-founder & CEO, Karri Saarinen

 - Building for quality: Our Investment in Linear https://accel.com/noteworthy/our-investment-in-linear Accel Series B blog post



Linear is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

jobs.title: Maschinenbautechniker (m/w/d) / Anlagenfahrer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Wir sind AGRANA - und aus deinem täglichen Leben nicht mehr wegzudenken. Unsere Produktpallette reicht von Fruchtzubereitungen zum Beispiel für Joghurts, Fruchtsaftkonzentraten, Stärke für Lebensmittel und technische Anwendungen über Bioethanol als nachhaltiger, umweltschonender Treibstoff bis hin zu Zucker in vielen Varianten. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams sind wir auf der Suche nach qualifizierten und motivierten Mitarbeitenden, die ein Teil von AGRANA werden wollen.

Jeder braucht uns - und wir brauchen dich!

Für unseren Standort in Gmünd suchen wir eine/n einsatzfreudige/n 1 Maschinenbautechniker (m/w/d) / Anlagenfahrer (m/w/d) Deine Aufgaben:

Aufgaben als Maschinenbautechniker (m/w/d):

* Du erkennst und behebst mechanische Störungen an unseren Anlagen in Absprache mit der Produktion.

* Du bist verantwortlich für die Instandhaltung und Wartung unserer mechanischen Anlagenteile.

* Du hältst dabei die Hygiene- und Sicherheitsvorschriften sowie Qualitätsvorgaben der jeweiligen Anlagen ein.

Aufgaben während der Kampagne als Anlagenfahrer (m/w/d) im Schichtbetrieb:

* Du bedienst und überwachst die Produktion im Bereich Restfruchtwassereindampfung vom Leitstand.

* Du bist für die Behebung von allfälligen Störungen verantwortlich.

* Du beauftragst die interne Instandhaltung für Reparaturarbeiten im Bereich.

* Du leitest Korrekturmaßnahmen von Standardabweichungen ein.

* Du achtest auf die Qualität in der Produktion und bist für die entsprechende Dokumentation verantwortlich.

Deine Stärken:

* Du verfügst über eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung als Maschinenbautechniker:in, Schlosser:in, KFZ-Mechaniker:in, Installateur:in oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.

* Du hast Erfahrung in der Instandhaltung von Maschinen und Anlagenteilen. Berufserfahrung als Anlagenfahrer von Vorteil.

* Schweißkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

* Du verfügst über PC-Kenntnisse.

* Du bist gewissenhaft, verantwortungsvoll, selbstständig und flexibel.

Unser Angebot:

* Eine abwechslungsreiche und interessante Tätigkeit in einem krisensicheren, stabilen, familiären und teamorientierten Arbeitsumfeld eines international erfolgreichen Unternehmens

* Intensive Einschulung im neuen Aufgabengebiet durch unsere kompetenten Kolleginnen und Kollegen

* Verschiedene Arbeitszeitmodelle zur Wahl (fixe Arbeitszeiten von Mo-Fr, Option auf wechselweise kurze/lange Woche oder ein attraktives Schichtmodell). Während der Kampagne wird in 4-Schicht gearbeitet.

* Kompetente Kolleginnen und Kollegen, welche dich in der Einarbeitungsphase und darüber hinaus unterstützen

* Deine Mehrwerte bei uns: Werkseigene Kantine, Fahrtkostenzuschuss, Betriebsevents, Gesundheitsprogramme, Prämien und weitere Benefits

* Der überkollektivvertragliche Lohn für diese Position liegt bei monatlich € 2.946,86 brutto (exkl. Zulagen und Zuschläge). Dein Lohn steigt entsprechend der kollektivvertraglichen Regelungen mit zunehmender Betriebszugehörigkeit und durch kollektivvertragliche Erhöhungen.

Kontakt:

Sabine HERZOG (Senior HR Managerin)

Erfahre mehr über https://www.agrana.com/ueber-agrana/unseregeschaeftssegmente/staerke.

Als globales Unternehmen sind wir sehr stolz auf unsere vielfältige Belegschaft und legen großen Wert auf Chancengleichheit und Diversität. jobs.title: Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle"
jobs.description:
As Austria's largest research and technology organisation for applied research, we are dedicated to make substantial contributions to solving the major challenges of our time, climate change and digitalisation. To achieve our goals, we rely on our specific research, development and technology competencies, which are the basis of our commitment to excellence in all areas. With our open culture of innovation and our motivated, international teams, we are working to position AIT as Austria's leading research institution at the highest international level and to make a positive contribution to the economy and society.



The Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is looking for new Ingenious Partners for our location in Vienna. Our Center for Innovation Systems & Policy is a think tank in national and international research and innovation networks, and it is a key partner for public administration, companies, universities, and research institutions.



The Competence Unit Transformation Govern... 1 Master Thesis "Characterizing features of Driving Dynamics on a Motorcycle Probe Vehicle"  * For this master's thesis you will investigate extensive time series of driving dynamics obtained from multiple motorcycle rides by multiple riders on given tracks.
* You will support us in working out characteristic features in driving dynamics that differentiate the different riders.
* You will investigate the possibility of using simulation software (like IPG Motorcycle maker) to use the obtained data for setting up simulations of motorcycle movements.

* Under the guidance of our researchers, you will implement model building approaches to extract characterizing features from motorcyclist data.
* With the support of our team, you will investigate the feasibility of simulating driver movements based on the characterizing features extracted before.
* You will explore different model-building approaches and criteria for selecting the most appropriate one with the guidance of our researchers.

Your qualifications as an Ingenious Partner:

* Ongoing master's studies in the field of Technical Mathematics at TU Vienna
* Good knowledge in R, Python, or MATLAB, willingness to adopt multiple of these languages as needed
* Enjoyment of application-oriented questions of industry
* High level of commitment and team spirit
* English or German skills commensurate with the role - The thesis can be completed in either language



What to expect:

* Duration of the master's thesis project: 6 months
* Start date: as soon as possible, with some flexibility depending on your availability
* EUR 1273 gross per month for 20 hours/week based on the collective agreement.
* Dedicated guidance and supervision from our experienced researchers, who will support you throughout your final thesis - from the initial concept to the final results.
* Highlights of our employee benefits include a canteen and meal allowance, organic coffee, tea and fruit baskets, preventive healthcare benefits and company doctor, additional days off for various life events, leisure subsidies, voucher programme, sports, cultural and socialising events, as well as flexitime models (incl. home office possibilities).





At AIT, we create an inclusive and family-friendly working environment that promotes equal opportunities and actively strengthens diversity across our workforce and in leadership positions. Among other initiatives, we are committed to increasing the proportion of women in our company and therefore particularly welcome applications from female applicants.



Please submit your complete application documents online, consisting of your CV, a cover letter, relevant certificates (transcript of records), as well as a proof of identity.

PhD Position in Forest Regeneration and Nutrient Dynamics
Tree regeneration success is a key determinant of forest resilience and long-term ecosystem
stability. While light availability has been widely studied as a driver of regeneration dynamics,
the role of the forest floor as a regulator of nutrient supply to seedlings has received far less
attention. The Forest floor is the interface between the above- and below-ground parts of forest
ecosystems. It serves as a seedbed and rooting zone for vegetation, and acts as a hub of the
ecosystem where organic matter, nutrients and water are stored, absorbed, and transformed.
In the context of climate change, the Forest floor and its associated ecosystem services appear
as particularly at risk. As part of the research group "Humus layer: Function, dynamics and
vulnerability in transition" (https://gepris.dfg.de/project/457330647), the goal of our project is
to investigate how forest floor characteristics, root and mycorrhizal connectivity to mature
trees, and drought jointly regulate nutrient availability and regeneration performance. For more
information, please contact: emilie.fleurot@boku.ac.at.


Responsibilities
º Conducting lab work (measurement of soil and leaf nutrient concentration,
measurement of 15N concentration, ...)
º Conducting 2 weeks of field work per year in Germany (collecting leaf and soil
samples, measuring the condition and height of the plants)
º Conducting 1 week of fieldwork in an old growth forest (Rothwald) (mapping of forest
soil properties)
º Performing data analysis and writing scientific publications
º Writing and defending a doctoral thesis is desired
Required skills and qualifications


º Diploma degree in MSc ecology, biology, forestry or other equivalent university degree
º Language skills: Strong proficiency in English, both written and verbal
º Training and experience in statistical analysis and the R software
º Experience in field work and motivation to work under harsh conditions
º Experience in scientific writing


Desirable skills and qualifications

º Highly motivated candidate with strong analytical and problem-solving skills and the
ability to work independently and as part of a team
º Driving licence type B

We look forward to receiving your comprehensive online application.

jobs.description:
Atlasi nodrošina Hansavest Latvija SIA (RN.40103542562, kopš 2012.gada) hrnature.eu – personāla vadības un atlases partneris uzņēmumiem visā Latvijā.

Pārstāvot klientu, personāla nomas un darbaspēka risinājumu uzņēmumu, ar pieredzi no 2018. gada, kas nodrošina uzņēmumus ar speciālistiem  gan vietējiem, gan piesaistot no ārvalstīm (piem., Uzbekistānas, Kazahstānas u.c.), paplašinoties aicina pievienoties savai draudzīgajai komandai:

Dokumentu noformēšanas speciālists/-e (Rīgā, Skanstes iela)

Galvenie pienākumi:

  • Ārvalstu darbinieku nodarbinātības un uzturēšanās dokumentu sagatavošana, noformēšana un iesniegšana (uzaicinājumi, darba atļaujas, termiņuzturēšanās atļaujas u.c.);
  • Obligāto veselības pārbaužu (OVP) organizēšana un uzraudzība darbiniekiem;
  • Darba drošības dokumentācijas kārtošana un aktualizēšana;
  • Komunikācija un dokumentu kārtošana ar valsts iestādēm (PMLP, NVA, VDI u.c.);
  • Ar nodarbinātību saistīto dokumentu un formalitāšu uzraudzība, aktualizēšana atbilstoši normatīvajiem aktiem;
  • Atbalsts kolēģiem un klientiem lietvedības dokumentu, t.sk. tipveida līgumu, sagatavošanā;
  • Dokumentu lietvedības kārtošana un atskaišu sagatavošana par iesniegtajiem un izskatāmajiem pieteikumiem;
  • Sadarbība ar komandu darbinieku ierašanās un integrācijas jautājumos.

Prasības kandidātiem:

  • Pieredze deklaranta darbā, importa dokumentu vai citu formalitāšu kārtošanā tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību;
  • Pieredze komunikācijā ar valsts iestādēm tiks uzskatīta par priekšrocību;

jobs.title: VISPĀRĒJĀS PAMATIZGLĪTĪBAS SKOLOTĀJS
jobs.description:
​

Lizuma pamatskola, reģistrācijas numurs 40900019170, aicina pieteikties darbā uz Lizuma pamatskolas angļu valodas skolotāja (profesijas klasifikatora kods 2341 01) amatu uz nenoteiktu laiku sākot ar 2026.gada 1.septembri.

Lizuma pamatskola piedāvā:

  • iespēju strādāt draudzīgā un uz attīstību vērstā kolektīvā;
  • radošu un atbildīgu darbu ar iespēju pilnveidot savu profesionālo pieredzi;
  • stabilu atalgojumu un sociālās garantijas;
  • profesionālo prasmju pilnveidošanas iespējas;
  • iespēju iesaistīties interešu izglītības procesā un projektos;
  • mēnešalga par pilnu slodzi sākot no 1410,00 EUR pirms nodokļu nomaksas.

Galvenie amata pienākumi:

  • Plānot, vadīt un īstenot pamatizglītības programmu angļu valodā atbilstoši valsts standartam un iestādes prasībām.
  • Vispusīgi attīstīt izglītojamo klausīšanās, runāšanas, lasīšanas un rakstīšanas prasmes, veicinot brīvu un pārliecinātu komunikāciju.
  • Integrēt stundās interaktīvās metodes, digitālos rīkus un autentiskus angļu valodas materiālus.
  • Sniegt atbalstu izglītojamajiem atbilstoši viņu spējām, mācīšanās tempam un speciālajām vajadzībām.
  • Aktīvi sadarboties ar izglītojamo vecākiem, atbalsta personālu (logopēdu, psihologu) un kolēģiem mācību un uzvedības jautājumu risināšanā.
  • Organizēt un iesaistīt skolēnus olimpiādēs, konkursos un starptautiskajos projektos (piemēram, eTwinning).
  • Atbildēt par izglītojamo dzīvību, veselību un emocionālo drošību stundu, starpbrīžu un skolas pasākumu

jobs.title: PALĪGSTRĀDNIEKS
jobs.description:
STRĀDNIEKS / MĀCEKLIS

(ar izaugsmi par meistaru)

SIA Eiropas Metāls, reģ.nr. 40103579283 (zīmols LABO LOGU AĢENTŪRA) ar vairāk nekā 10 gadu pieredzi aicina pastāvīgā darbā strādnieku/ mācekli pastāvīgam darbam (profesijas kods 932909 palīgstrādnieks)


Pieredze montāžā nav obligāta. Darba specifiku parādīsim un izstāstīsim, lai tu jau drīz vienkāršākos uzdevumus varētu veikt patstāvīgi.


Atalgojums un bonusi (Bruto):

  • Pamatalga: EUR 1200 – 1800 (7,2-10,8 eur/h) (par kvalitatīvu darbu atkarībā no prasmēm un darba ātruma).
  • Izglītības piemaksa: + EUR 200 no pirmās dienas, ja ir celtniecības/būvniecības izglītība.
  • Transporta piemaksa: + EUR 200 par darba auto vadīšanu.
  • Izaugsme: Pamatalga aug līdz ar Tavām prasmēm. 
    Iemācies strādāt patstāvīgi un kļūsti par meistaru ar algu virs EUR 2000

Prasības:

  • B kategorijas autovadītāja apliecība (obligāti).
  • Iesācēja līmenī prasme strādāt ar rokas un elektroinstrumentiem.
  • Īsta vēlme aktīvi darboties un attīstīties.
  • Novērtēsim, ja tev ir pieredz montāžā un/vai aiļu apdarē vai darbos, kurs jāizmanto instrumenti.

Darba pienākumi:

  • Logu un durvju demontāža, citi palīgdarbi.
  • Darbs pārī ar pieredzējušu meistaru, brigadiera norādījumu izpilde.
  • Palīdzēšana montāžas un apdares darbos (atbilstoši Tavām prasmēm)
  • Darba aizsardzības un kvalitātes prasību ievērošana.

Piedāvājam:

  • Stabilu darbu un objektu plūsmu visu gadu (arī ziemā).

Meil ei ole iga päev sama töö. Iga projekt on erinev ja nõuab mõtlemist ning oma panust. Kui sulle meeldib vaheldusrikas töö ja tahad näha oma töö tulemust päriselt valmiskujul, siis siin sul igav ei hakka.

Ootame kandidaadilt psühholoogi kvalifikatsioonile vastavat kõrgharidust või selle omandamist ning head eesti keele oskust. Oluline on oskus märgata ja mõista õpilaste emotsionaalseid ja sotsiaalseid vajadusi ning pakkuda neile professionaalset tuge. Hindame head kuulamis- ja suhtlemisoskust, empaatiavõimet, süsteemsust ning valmisolekut teha koostööd õpetajate, lapsevanemate ja tugispetsialistidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Kunda Ühisgümnaasium pakub koolipsühholoogile võimalust teha tähenduslikku tööd toetavas ja koostöises koolikeskkonnas.

Samuti toetame töötajate professionaalset arengut ning pakume võimalusi osaleda koolitustel ja enesetäiendamisel. Lisaks pakume stabiilset töötasu, tasustatud tervisepäevi ning töökeskkonda, kus iga spetsialisti panus on oluline ja väärtustatud.

Muud nõuded: Ootame kandidaadilt vastutustunnet, usaldusväärsust ja head pingetaluvust. Oluline on oskus säilitada rahulik ja tasakaalukas hoiak ka keerukates olukordades ning valmisolek teha koostööd erinevate osapooltega. Hindame empaatiavõimet, järjekindlust ja soovi panustada kooli arengusse. Kasuks tuleb varasem töökogemus haridusasutuses või laste ja noortega töötamisel.

jobs.title: Logistics worker - entry-level position with growth opportunities!
jobs.description:
Are you looking for a chance to start a career in logistics, but you have little or no experience? Do you have a less stable work history and want an employer who values motivation and potential over a perfect CV? Then this opportunity could be exactly what you are looking for! In this position, motivation, commitment, and a willingness to learn are more important than an impressive CV.

Your starting point: packaging

You'll begin as a packer within the logistics department. There, you'll be responsible for carefully packing products according to quality and safety standards. Important: this role is performed in a refrigerated environment (cold storage/chilled warehouse).

In short term: growth

Employees who demonstrate commitment, reliability, and strong performance can quickly progress to more advanced logistics roles following positive evaluations.

Possible next steps:

  • Order picker: collecting and preparing customer orders
  • Warehouse worker: loading and unloading trucks

Both these positions are performed in a deep-freeze environment of -22°C with an electrical pallet truck (EPT).

We think motivation and a great attitude are more important than a perfect CV.

This position is perfect for you if you:

  • Don't have any experience in logistics and want to take your first step into warehouse work
  • Have a less stable work experience and want to prove yourself again
  • Really want to learn and grow step by step

What we expect from you:

  • A positive attitude with motivation, strong work ethic, reliability and punctuality
  • No fear of physical work in cold temperatures
  • Own transport to the company in Oostkamp (no public transport nearby)

Do you already have some experience in logistics or with an electrical pallet truck (EPT)? Not a requirement, but still a great advantage!

!! Please note: you need to live in Belgium and have legal permission to work here. Actief cannot help with immigration or provide housing for you. If you don't have an official address or permission to work in Belgium, you don't qualify for this job !!

jobs.title: Product Engineer, New Products
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Product Engineer, you’ll take emerging ideas from concept to polished experiences. You’ll build sophisticated, intuitive user experiences while working across AI models, agentic workflows, and all parts of web infrastructure to ship complete products.




The Goal: Build products that can define major new categories for Replit. You will combine the flexibility of software with the accessibility of presentations, spreadsheets, dashboards, and visual editors, enabling anyone to create powerful, interactive artifacts through natural language.




The Audience: We build for the next generation of creators, knowledge workers, and high-leverage teams. Our users should be able to turn an idea, dataset, or business problem into a polished, editable, and shareable product just by themselves.

Candidates who thrive here often have the product judgment, technical range, and ownership mindset associated with founders. This is a high-visibility role working closely with product leadership.





HOW WE WORK

Structure: We operate as a collective of in-house technical founders, not narrowly specialized engineers. Initiatives are run by lean, autonomous teams built for velocity and technical leverage. Engineers maintain meaningful ownership over technical direction, product quality, and launch success, supported by Product and Design partners.



Cadence: We work in focused three-week sprints, shipping quickly, observing real user behavior, and incorporating feedback into each iteration. We value decisive execution, thoughtful experimentation, and the ability to make progress without perfectly defined requirements.





WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own major product experiences from initial concept through design, implementation, launch, measurement, and continued improvement

 - Invent and build intuitive interfaces for generating, editing, arranging, and collaborating on AI-created presentations, data applications, and visual artifacts

 - Deliver exceptional frontend experiences across interaction design, typography, layout, motion, accessibility, performance, and error recovery

 - Partner directly with users, Product, Design, and AI engineers to understand real workflows, test ideas, and turn feedback into better products

 - Create reusable editing, visualization, and collaboration primitives that accelerate future products across Replit
   
   
   


REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE

 - 4+ years of professional software engineering experience with a strong record of shipping high-quality, user-facing products

 - Understanding of the full agentic software development stack, helping coding agents build, test and review correct code

 - Deep experience with TypeScript, React, HTML, and CSS, along with strong knowledge of browser performance, application state, responsive design, and accessibility

 - Strong product judgment and visual taste, with the ability to balance usability, speed, correctness, polish, and long-term maintainability

 - Comfort working across the full stack, including Node.js, APIs, Postgres, data models, and production debugging

 - Familiarity with agentic software development and how coding agents build, test, review, and operate software
   
   
   


BONUS POINTS

 - Building visual editors, presentation software, creative tools, data applications, developer tools, or collaboration products

 - Working with canvas or graphics systems, rich text, direct manipulation, real-time collaboration, data visualization, or complex interactive interfaces

 - Designing user experiences around AI generation, streaming responses, tool calls, and long-running agent workflows

 - Founding a technical company, working as a founding engineer, or shipping a high-visibility independent project

These experiences are preferred, but not required. We care most about what you have built, the quality of your product thinking, and your ability to learn quickly.





EXAMPLE PROJECTS YOU’LL WORK ON

 - Building on top of our Replit Slides AI-native presentation product where users can generate beautiful decks, directly edit elements, collaborate with others, and reliably export their work

 - Enable Replit Agent to turn raw datasets and natural-language questions into interactive, trustworthy data applications

 - Design visual tools that make AI-generated work feel as precise, editable, and controllable as traditionally authored content

 - Build reusable editing, visualization, collaboration, and artifact-management systems that power multiple new Replit products

 - Develop feedback loops and evaluations that improve the visual quality of Agent-generated artifacts
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

⚕️ Health, Dental, Vision and Life Insurance

🩼 Short Term and Long Term Disability

🏝 Flexible Time Off (FTO) + Holidays

🧑‍💻 Autonomous Work Environment

🖥 In Office Set-Up Reimbursement (In-Office Only)

🚀 Quarterly Team Gatherings

☕ In Office Amenities (In-Office Only)

jobs.title: Commercial Manager to Hutchison Ports Stockholm
jobs.description:
Do you want to take full commercial responsibility in a strategically important container terminal? Are you motivated by driving business growth, building long-term customer relationships, and contributing at management level in an international organization?

We look forward to reviewing your application for the role of Commercial Manager at Hutchison Ports Stockholm.

About the position

As Commercial Manager at Hutchison Ports Stockholm (HPS), you hold the overall responsibility for the company’s commercial agenda. You are a key member of the management team and report directly to the CEO. The role combines strategic commercial development with hands-on execution and stakeholder management.

You are accountable for managing and developing an assigned portfolio of national and international customer accounts. Your mission is to drive volume growth, revenue improvement, and long-term profitability through structured contractual agreements and proactive business development.

The objective of the role is to positively influence and grow customers’ business in order to sustain and strengthen HPS’s long-term profitability, focusing on structured growth initiatives and yield optimization.

The role involves close collaboration with customers, internal departments, third-party stakeholders, and infrastructure partners. You are responsible for ensuring that commercial targets and strategic objectives are met - and exceeded - within agreed cost budgets.

Key responsibilities include:

    

Own and drive the commercial strategy for assigned customer portfolios

    

Negotiate and manage structured commercial agreements at national and international level

    

Drive volume growth and revenue optimization to maximize return on operational assets

    

Develop new business opportunities and expand the customer base

    

Manage stakeholder communication and align expectations across customers and partners

    

Prepare and develop marketing materials (brochures, magazines, handouts, digital content, banners)

    

Organize customer events and promotional activities to strengthen long-term relationships

    

Act as a role model and ambassador for HPS, demonstrating strong business acumen and leadership behaviours

    

Monitor, measure, and exceed strategic business and performance objectives

About you

We are looking for a commercially driven and proactive sales professional who thrives in a dynamic and international environment. You are confident in taking ownership, opening new doors, negotiating at senior levels, and influencing both internal and external stakeholders.

To succeed in the role, we believe you:

    

Hold a Bachelor’s degree (MBA is preferred)

    

Have 4–6 years of experience in a commercial or sales-focused role, ideally within freight forwarding, logistics, shipping, or related industries

    

Have a strong track record of driving business development and creating new opportunities

    

Possess a strong understanding of port operations and supporting functions

    

Have experience working with information systems related to commercial processes

    

Are highly proficient in MS Office

    

Communicate fluently in both Swedish and English, verbally and in writing

As a person, you are business-oriented, relationship-driven, and strongly results-focused. You are not afraid to initiate contact, open new dialogues, and proactively pursue opportunities. You demonstrate integrity, leadership maturity, and the ability to build trust across organizations. You are comfortable representing the company externally and take pride in acting as an ambassador for Hutchison Ports Stockholm. It is considered a merit if you have experience or a good understanding of port operations.

Location

The position is based at the container terminal in Norvik, Nynäshamn. The role involves approximately 100 travel days per year, primarily related to customer meetings, stakeholder engagement, and business development activities at both national and international level.

Contact

In this recruitment process, Hutchison Ports collaborates with Delve Interim & Search.

For further information, please feel free to contact Linus Erwander at +46 729 62 07 67 or linus.erwander@delvegroup.se.

As interviews and candidate selection are conducted on an ongoing basis, we encourage you to submit your application as soon as possible. We look forward to hearing from you.

About Hutchison Ports

Hutchison Ports is one of the key business units of the CK Hutchison Group, headquartered in Hong Kong, employing approximately 300,000 people worldwide. Hutchison Ports is the world’s leading port investor, developer and operator, handling over 80 million containers annually across 52 ports in 26 countries.

In Sweden, Hutchison Ports has signed a 25-year agreement with Stockholms Hamnar to operate the new container terminal in Norvik, Nynäshamn. The facility enables the relocation of container operations from Frihamnen in central Stockholm, supporting long-term regional development.

The Norvik terminal has a capacity of 500,000 TEU at full operation, an 800-meter berth, a water depth of 16.5 meters, and a direct rail connection within the terminal — making it one of the most capable container terminals in the Baltic Sea region.

With global expertise in container port operations and a strong international customer network, Hutchison Ports is well positioned to reshape container shipping in the Baltic region.

Job Summary

Senior Project Manager acts as a proxy Product Manager supporting Agile delivery by managing the product backlog and working closely with squad teams. Translates business and technical requirements into clear specifications and compliant documentation performs impact and feasibility assessments supports testing and releases and ensures audit ready documentation within regulated GxP environments using the Veeva Quality Vault platform.

Responsibilities

1. Work as a proxy Product Manager and responsibility for managing the product backlog and SQUAD

2. Analyze business and technical requirements and translate them into clear structured specifications user stories or functional documentation to support solution delivery.

3. Perform impact and feasibility assessments for system changes identifying risks dependencies and potential impacts on existing processes or data.

4. Support Agile delivery activities including backlog refinement sprint planning and close collaboration with development and testing teams.

5. Act as a bridge between business and technical teams clarifying requirements resolving ambiguities and supporting informed decision making.

6. Support validation testing and release activities including UAT coordination defect analysis and confirmation that delivered solutions meet agreed requirements.

7. Create maintain update and approve technical and process documentation including: System Access Plan System Overview Process Flows Security Matrix Validation Report DTRA Responsible AI etc.

8. Collaborate with cross functional stakeholders (business IT compliance quality) to gather inputs validate content and incorporate feedback into documentation.

9. Ensure documentation readiness for audits and compliance reviews including traceability completeness and alignment with applicable standards and governance requirements.

10. Support continuous improvement of documentation practices identifying gaps redundancies or inconsistencies and proposing enhancements to structure and usability.



Key requirements

1. Veeva White Belt active certification is required

4. Experience working in regulated GxP environment

jobs.title: Equipment Management Database Specialist
jobs.description:
What you'll do
The role is responsible for ensuring that all equipment installed or removed during CMS Long Shutdown 3 (LS3) is accurately recorded in the CMS Equipment Management Database (EMdb). Acting as the interface between the physical inventory and the database, the post-holder ensures data consistency, maintains and enhances the database and its associated applications, and develops tools to improve data visualisation and accessibility.  The role combines strong IT expertise with an understanding of the CMS experiment's equipment and asset management processes. It also provides support to colleagues across the CMS experiment in keeping the database up to date by preparing dedicated documentation and labelling for the services installation campaign, ensuring that equipment can be accurately identified, tracked and managed throughout its lifecycle.

Your responsibilities
Ensure the consistency, accuracy and integrity of the CMS Equipment Management Database by synchronising it with the physical installation and decommissioning of equipment.
Act as the interface between field inventory activities of CMS teams and the Equipment Management Database, ensuring that all equipment installations, removals and modifications are accurately reflected in the system.
Maintain, support and enhance the Equipment Management Database and its applications, ensuring their reliability and long-term sustainability while developing new features, dashboards and visualisation tools for equipment traceability, data quality monitoring and reporting.
Drive continuous improvements to the usability, functionality and efficiency of the Equipment Management Database by streamlining the registration and management of equipment, cables and other assets, and enhancing data management and asset traceability across the CMS experiment.
Supporting work on the field, to ensure that the operational aspects of asset installation run smoothly for the CMS experiment and that there is coherence between installed equipment and services and the database inventory
Collaborate with the CERN Enterprise Asset Management service and ensure the inter-operationality of processes within the CERN-wide infrastructure and applications.

Your profile
Experience with relational databases and SQL.
Experience with web application development, using for example Oracle APEX, PHP, JavaScript, client-oriented APIs.
Experience monitoring data quality and ensuring data consistency between physical assets and the digital inventory system.
Experience with engineering equipment, scientific infrastructure, or large-scale technical installations.
Ability to develop dashboards and application features.
Proactive in improving processes and application functionality.
Familiarity with the CMS Experimental and upgrade program is an advantage.
Ability to bridge operational activities in the field with IT systems and interface CERN asset management procedures.
Master's degree or PhD or equivalent relevant experience in the field of Computer Science or Applied Physics or a related field.

Your skills
Knowledge of database and/or data mining architectures and technologies.
Conceptualising, designing and developing user experiences and interfaces.
Decommissioning and disposal of detector components and systems.
Development of application software.
Defines clear objectives, milestones and deliverables before initiating work/ project.
Builds and maintains constructive and effective work relationships.
Ensures that information, procedures and decisions are appropriately documented.
Addresses complex problems by breaking them down into manageable components.
Proposes ways to improve or streamline existing procedures, processes and methodologies.
Spoken and written English or French, with a commitment to learn the other language.
Medical hazard
Exposure to electromagnetic fields under certain exposure conditions.
Given the occupational health risks associated with this position, the selected candidate must obtain medical clearance before a contract offer is confirmed.

Employment conditions
A valid driving licence.
Interventions in underground installations.
Work in Radiation Areas.
Work during nights, Sundays and official holidays, when required by the needs of the Organization.

Be sure to meet the eligibility criteria
You are a national of a CERN Member State or Associate Member State. Currently, we cannot consider applications from Pakistani, Lithuanian, Latvian, Cypriot and Croatian nationals, as the ceiling defined under Article II.5 of the Associate Membership Agreement has been reached.
You have relevant qualifications and professional experience.
If you have previously held a Staff contract at CERN, you will not be eligible for these positions.
Please pay attention to the additional criteria and requirements for this specific position and mentioned above.

maintaining a strong understanding of software architecture and modern development practices.

applications.

planning, code review, and continuous improvement.

jobs.title: Directeur d'hôtel H/F (H/F)
jobs.description:
Notre client est un groupe hôtelier à taille humaine, multi-enseignes, exploitant plusieurs établissements sous franchises Accor et Louvre Hotels Group en France.
Nous recherchons pour un de leur établissement situé en région lyonnaise, leur futur :

Directeur d'hôtel H/F
CDI - Statut Cadre
Basé à Lyon
Plus de 150 chambres - Hôtellerie économique
Encadrement d'une 20aine de personnes

Vos motivations :
Vous souhaitez relever un véritable challenge de direction au sein d'un actif hôtelier à fort potentiel. Vous appréciez les environnements où tout reste à construire, où votre impact est visible et où les résultats dépendent directement de votre capacité à mobiliser les équipes et à mettre en œuvre des actions concrètes.
Vous aimez les postes terrain, avec une forte dimension opérationnelle, commerciale et managériale. Vous recherchez une structure à taille humaine vous laissant une réelle autonomie dans vos décisions tout en bénéficiant du soutien d'un groupe solide.

Vos missions :
Rattaché à la Direction des Exploitations, votre mission principale consiste à redonner une dynamique de performance à cet actif stratégique du groupe en activant l'ensemble des leviers opérationnels, commerciaux et humains.
- Développement commercial : définir et piloter le plan d'action commercial, développer les partenariats locaux, renforcer la visibilité de l'établissement, optimiser le mix clientèle et contribuer à l'amélioration durable du chiffre d'affaires.
- Revenue management et performance : En relation avec le revenue manager du groupe, suivre les indicateurs clés de performance (taux d'occupation, prix moyen, RevPAR, GOP), analyser les résultats, identifier les axes d'amélioration et mettre en œuvre les actions correctives nécessaires.
- Management : recruter, encadrer, accompagner et fédérer les équipes autour d'objectifs communs. Développer une culture de la performance, de l'engagement et de la satisfaction client.
- Exploitation : garantir le bon fonctionnement quotidien, veiller au respect des standards de marque, assurer la qualité de service et maintenir un haut niveau de satisfaction client.
- Gestion sociale : accompagner les évolutions organisationnelles du site et assurer un dialogue social constructif dans un contexte d'internalisation récente des équipes de ménage.
- Pilotage économique : élaborer et suivre les budgets, optimiser les charges d'exploitation et garantir la rentabilité des établissements.

Votre profil :

jobs.description:

Sukaiba Copenhagen er en eksklusiv restaurant og cocktailbar beliggende på toppen af det ikoniske Bella Sky – med en af Københavns absolut bedste udsigter. Vi kombinerer japansk gastronomi med international cocktailkultur i et ambitiøst, dogmefrit og energifyldt miljø.

Vi søger en erfaren bartender til en deltidsstilling, som vil være en del af vores passionerede og kreative barteam. Du bliver en vigtig del af en arbejdsplads, hvor kvalitet, faglig stolthed og fællesskab er i fokus – og hvor både gæsteoplevelsen og det interne sammenhold er altafgørende.

OM STILLINGEN

Som bartender hos Sukaiba vil du:

  • Skabe cocktails på højeste niveau med markedets bedste råvarer

  • Arbejde i et tæt samarbejde med et stærkt og passioneret team

  • Have mulighed for at præge menukortet og bidrage med dine egne idéer

  • Indgå i en fleksibel vagtplan, der tilpasses din hverdag

Vi tror på, at arbejdsglæde og balance går hånd i hånd. Derfor gør vi os umage for at skabe en hverdag, hvor der er plads til både faglig udvikling og privatliv.

VI FORVENTER, AT DU:

  • Har minimum 2 års erfaring som bartender 

  • Brænder for godt værtskab og cocktails i topklasse

  • Er en holdspiller med positiv energi og et smittende humør

  • Tager ansvar og arbejder struktureret – også når det går stærkt

VI TILBYDER:

  • En dynamisk arbejdsplads med højt til loftet og gode udviklingsmuligheder

  • En konkurrencedygtig løn og fleksible arbejdstider

  • Gode personalefordele på tværs af vores restauranter

  • Et stærkt fællesskab med kollegaer, der løfter hinanden på tværs af Norrlyst koncernen 

HVORFOR VÆLGE SUKAIBA? 

Fordi vi – helt ærligt – har noget særligt. Vores medarbejdere fortæller os, at energien, kulturen og måden, vi er sammen på, skiller sig ud. Hos Sukaiba er fællesskab og gensidig respekt kernen i alt, hvad vi gør – uanset om du står på gulvet, i køkkenet eller bag baren.

jobs.title: Directeur-rice Centre Les Jonquilles - Xonrupt-Longemer (H/F)
jobs.description:
La Ligue de l'enseignement - Fédération des Œuvres Laïques de la Moselle (FOL57) recrute un(e) Directeur(rice) pour son centre d'hébergement permanent ouvert toute l'année « Les Jonquilles », situé à Xonrupt-Longemer, au cœur du massif des Vosges. D'une capacité de 250 lits, le centre accueille principalement des classes de découverte, des séjours de vacances pour enfants et jeunes, ainsi que des groupes d'adultes, familles et individuels.
En tant que directeur(rice), vous serez le garant du bon fonctionnement de l'établissement, de la qualité de l'accueil et de la mise en œuvre du projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
Vous partagez pleinement les valeurs de l'éducation populaire, de la laïcité, de l'engagement citoyen et de l'accès aux vacances pour tous en conjuguant vision stratégique, sens du collectif et capacité d'action.
Au sein du centre, le(la) directeur(rice) s'appuie sur une équipe permanente composée notamment de deux directrices adjointes, d'une cheffe de cuisine, d'une seconde de cuisine, d'une animatrice environnement, d'un agent technique et de personnels saisonniers et occasionnels ainsi que les services de la fédération.
Il(elle) assure la direction d'une équipe pluridisciplinaire, favorise le travail collaboratif et veille à la qualité du service rendu aux différents publics accueillis.

VOS MISSIONS
DIRECTION ET PILOTAGE DE L'ETABLISSEMENT
- Mettre en œuvre et faire vivre le projet éducatif de la Ligue de l'enseignement.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement général du centre et la continuité du service.
- Veiller au respect des normes d'hygiène, de sécurité et de la réglementation applicable.
- Représenter le centre auprès des partenaires institutionnels et locaux.
- Veiller à la qualité de l'accueil et de la communication du centre.
- Promouvoir le centre et développer nos partenariats
MANAGEMENT DES EQUIPES
- Diriger, animer et accompagner les équipes permanentes et saisonnières.
- Organiser et répartir le travail des différents services.
- Favoriser la montée en compétences des personnels
- Mettre en œuvre le recrutement et veiller à l'intégration des personnels saisonniers et occasionnels.
ORGANISATION ET DEVELOPPEMENT DES SEJOURS
- Travailler en étroite collaboration avec le service Vacances/Classes du siège de la fédération
- Accompagner les adjointes dans la préparation et le suivi des classes de découverte, des colonies et accueils de groupes.
- Développer les relations avec les prestataires d'activités et les partenaires locaux.
- Contribuer au développement de l'activité du centre et à la qualité de séjours proposés.
GESTION TECHNIQUE ET SECURITE

jobs.title: Pakettiautohuolto -franchisingyrittäjä Tampereelle
jobs.description:
Pakettiautohuolto on erikoistunut pakettiautojen huolto- ja korjauspalveluihin. Ketjun toiminnan perustana ovat laadukas palvelukokemus, asiantuntijuus ja tulevaisuuden rakentaminen. Ketju keskittyy erityisesti yritys- ja ammattiasiakkaisiin, yhtenä merkittävä kilpailuetuna mm. huollon sijaispakettiautot. Tällä hetkellä toimintaa on kolmella eri paikkakunnalla Suomessa, ketjun laajentuminen tulee tapahtumaan Suomen kaikkiin kasvukeskuksiin. Kasvunäkymät ovat vahvat ja konseptin mukaisella toiminnalla sekä ketjun vahvalla tuella on erinomaiset mahdollisuudet kannattavaan sekä laadukkaaseen yritystoimintaan. Ketju hyödyntää alan uusinta teknologiaa ja panostaa jatkuvaan kehitykseen, jotta palvelut pysyvät kilpailukykyisinä ja laadukkaina.

Franchising-yrittäjänä vastaat oman yksikkösi ja yhtiösi päivittäisestä toiminnasta. Tehtäviisi kuuluvat erityisesti asiakaspalvelu, huoltotöiden organisointi sekä henkilöstön johtaminen. Yrittäjänä olet myös vastuussa liiketoiminnan kehittämisestä, paikallisesta markkinoinnista ja asiakassuhteiden rakentamisesta. Työ on monipuolista ja käytännönläheistä päivät voivat sisältää sekä teknistä työtä että yrityksen hallinnollisia tehtäviä. Ketjun tuki ja selkeät toimintamallit auttavat sinua onnistumaan yrittäjänä.Yrittäjällä tulee olla taloudellisesti mahdollista panostaa yrittäjyyteen. Yrittäjän alkuinvestointi on 20.000€-50.000€ ja tyypillisesti omarahoitusosuus on 20-30% alkuinvestointimäärästä.

Menestyvä Pakettiautohuollon yrittäjä on:

1. Yrittäjähenkinen ja toimialasta kiinnostunut Kokemus autoalalta on hyödyksi, mutta tärkeintä on halu ja motivaatio oppia sekä kasvaa yrittäjänä Riskinkantokyky ja vastuunotto yrityksen toiminnasta

2. Asiakaslähtöinen ja myyntihenkinen Asiakaspalveluhenkinen, asiakaslähtöinen ajattelutapa ja myynnillinen ote

3. Tiimin ja tiimityöskentelyn johtaja Yhteistyökykyinen ja luotettava tiimipelaaja Rekrytoi ja kehittää henkilöstöä

4. Toiminnan kehittäjä ja laadun varmistaja Järjestelmällinen ja pitkäjänteiseen kehittymiseen sitoutuva Myönteinen ketjuasenne ja ketjun konseptin mukaiseen toimintaan sekä laatuvaatimuksiin sitoutuva

5. Taloudelliset edellytykset omaava Vakaa ja hyvä taloudellinen tilanne, mahdollisuus rahoittaa alkuinvestointi joko vapaana omana pääomana tai ulkopuolisella rahoituksella. Yksikön alkuinvestointivaatimus on: 20.000-50.000€ Yrityksen talouden ymmärrys ja tarkka talouden hallinta


Miksi yrittäjäksi Pakettiautohuolto-ketjuun:

1. Valmis konsepti ja toimintamallit

2. Tunnettuutta ja luottavuutta omaava Pakettiautohuollon brändi

3. Kilpailukyiset hankintasopimukset ja pakettiautoihin erikoistuminen. Lopputuloksena suoraviivainen ja tehokas korjaamotoiminta, onnistunut asiakaspalvelukokemus ja kannattava yritystoiminta

4. Markkinoinnin ja myynnin tuki ketjulta, ketjun valmiit asiakasrekisterit ja valtakunnalliset asiakkuudet

5. Ketjun kattava perehdytys, tärkeät tukipalvelut, valmiit järjestelmät ja jatkuva koulutus

6. Yhteistyö muiden yrittäjien kanssa


Yhteisössämme jokainen yrittäjä saa olla osa suurempaa joukkoa, jossa apua ja kannustusta on aina saatavilla yksin ei tarvitse pärjätä ja yrittää. Aloitus on helppoa, autamme liikepaikan löytämisessä ja sopimusneuvotteluissa. Koneiden ja työkalujen hankinnan osalta meillä on valmiit paketit olemassa.

Mikäli kiinnostuit, lue lisää ja jätä hakemus: https://ketju.fi/fi/ketju/429/pakettiautohuolto tai soita Ketju.fi rekrytointikonsultti Katja Makkonen, rekrytointi@ketju.fi, 020 730 7490

(HUOM! Etsimme yrittäjää, emme työntekijää.)

www.ketju.fi - sivusto on yrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneiden henkilöiden ja uusia yrittäjiä hakevien ketjujen kohtaamispaikka. Ketju.fi tarjoaa ketjuyrittäjyydestä kiinnostuneille ainutlaatuisen mahdollisuuden tutustua erilaisten ketjujen tarjoamiin yrittäjämahdollisuuksiin.

jobs.title: Ögonspecialist sökes till ögonmottagningen, Varberg
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och utveckla framtidens ögonsjukvård i Halland? Vi söker nu en engagerad ögonläkare som vill bli en del av vårt kompetenta och sammansvetsade team i Varberg – där kvalitet, samarbete och utveckling står i fokus. Här får du möjlighet att växa i din roll och göra verklig skillnad för våra patienter varje dag.

Om arbetet

Som ögonläkare på ögonmottagningen i Varberg behöver du ha en bred kompetens inom allmän oftalmologi. Här kommer du arbeta teambaserat tillsammans med flera olika professioner, till exempel ögonsjuksköterskor, undersköterskor och optiker.

I arbetet ingår mottagningsarbete och sedvanliga administrativa arbetsuppgifter som journalföring, granskning av bilder, sjukintyg och receptförskrivning.

Tjänstgöringsgraden bestämmer vi tillsammans och arbetstiderna är förlagda vardagar under dagtid. Som anställd i Varberg har du numera möjlighet att ingå i beredskapen då vi har 2 timmars inställelsetid till vår akutverksamhet i Halmstad.

Om arbetsplatsen

Ögonkliniken Halland har tre utbudspunkter med mottagningar i Kungsbacka, Halmstad och Varberg.

Ögonkliniken i Halland fortsätter att växa och så även uppdraget till våra Halländska invånare inom specialiserad ögonvård. Vi behöver bli fler för att fortsatt ha en stor tillgänglighet för våra patienter i Halland.  

Hos oss finns hög kompetens hos våra läkare, ögonsjuksköterskor, undersköterskor, optiker, ortoptister och medicinska sekreterare. Detta bidrar till en fin och nära relation mellan alla yrkesgrupper vilket i sin tur genererar till ett gott och utvecklande arbetsklimat.

Självklart arbetar vi aktivt med förbättringsarbeten både lokalt på mottagningen men också som helhet på ögonkliniken Halland. Här vill vi att du ska vara med oss i vårt fortsatta arbete framåt för att vi skall bli ännu bättre och vara i framkant!

Kvalifikationer

Vi söker dig som är specialistläkare/överläkare och är trygg i din yrkesroll, med några års erfarenhet inom allmän oftalmologi.

För att trivas i rollen behöver du tycka om att arbeta i team och självständigt du ser det som en självklarhet med ett gott bemötande mot både patienter och kollegor. Det är därför viktigt att du är kommunikativ och har god förmåga att uttrycka dig i tal och skrift på svenska. Du har viljan och drivkraften att påverka utvecklingen inom oftalmologin både på kort och lång sikt. 

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet. 

Varmt välkommen med din ansökan!

I denna rekrytering tillämpar vi löpande urval och intervjuer vilket innebär att du kan komma att kallas till intervju innan sista ansökningsdag.

Vårt erbjudande

För oss är det viktigt att du ska trivas och utvecklas i ditt arbete.

Läs mer om vilka förmåner Region Halland kan erbjuda dig som läkare här.

Om Hallands sjukhus

Vår målsättning är att erbjuda Sveriges bästa akut- och specialistsjukvård. På Hallands sjukhus arbetar närmare 4 000 personer, inom fler än 100 olika professioner. I Halmstad och Varberg finns akutsjukvård och planerad specialistvård. I Kungsbacka finns planerad specialistvård inom flera områden.

Verksamheter på Hallands sjukhus

Här hittar du information om våra kliniker och övriga verksamheter. Det ges även en inblick i kulturen, arbetsklimatet och vad som är unikt för varje verksamhet. Dessutom möter du några av våra medarbetare som berättar om hur de upplever sitt jobb. Verksamheter på Hallands sjukhus

Övrig information

Referenstagning är en del av vår rekryteringsprocess. Om du är eller tidigare har varit anställd i Region Halland kan vi komma att ta interna referenser från nuvarande eller tidigare chef. Referenstagning föregås alltid av dialog med dig som sökande.

Om Region Halland

Region Halland är till för alla som bor och arbetar här i Halland. Vi är över 8 000 medarbetare inom 370 olika yrken som alla arbetar för att erbjuda en god hälso- och sjukvård och att främja tillväxt och utveckling. Vi ansvarar också för kollektivtrafiken i Halland och driver frågor inom områden som näringsliv, kultur och utbildning. Vår vision är ”Halland ­ – bästa livsplatsen” och med det menar vi att Halland ska bli den bästa platsen att bo på, utbilda sig, arbeta och driva företag i. Vi har kommit en bra bit på vägen, välkommen att följa med oss på vår resa! Läs mer om Region Hallands organisation, vårt uppdrag och vår vision.

Strävan efter jämställdhet, mångfald och likvärdiga villkor är både en kvalitetsfråga och en självklar del av Region Hallands värdegrund.

Region Halland krigsplacerar all tillsvidareanställd personal.

Region Halland följer främst det centrala kollektivavtalet HÖK (Huvudöverenskommelsen) med bilagor som AB (Allmänna bestämmelser), i vissa fall kan även avtalet BEA användas. HÖK med bilagor hittar du på www.skr.se

Till bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag och till dig som är försäljare:

Vi undanber oss vänligt men bestämt direktkontakt med bemannings- och rekryteringsföretag samt försäljare av ytterligare jobbannonser. Region Halland har upphandlade avtal.
