jobs.title: Data Engineer, SCOT Fulfillment Optimization (m/f)
jobs.description:
Data Engineer, SCOT Fulfillment Optimization
Job ID: 10479913 | Amazon EU Sarl

Description

When you order items on Amazon, there are practically thousands of ways we can fulfill that order. Which Fulfillment Center do we ship from, what carriers do we use, what boxes do we combine items in — now scale that question to billions of items shipped annually worldwide. At Amazon's Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT), we are tasked with fulfilling every customer order in the most intelligent way possible while making sure customers get their orders on time.

Within SCOT, the Fulfillment Optimization organization owns the artificial intelligence, optimization, and simulation systems that decide how Amazon's outbound network is planned and operated. Our team is a new horizontal team responsible for the data foundations that power every Fulfillment Optimization product — from long-range planning to day-of execution. Our customers are the Applied Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, Data Scientists, and Software Development Engineers building those products, and the leaders who depend on trustworthy data to make multi-billion-dollar planning decisions.

We are looking for a Data Engineer to help us build that foundation. You will work alongside more senior Data Engineers, Software Development Engineers, and Applied Scientists to design, build, and operate the data pipelines, models, and warehouses that our products and analytics depend on. You will take well-defined requirements, build a solution, and deliver it on schedule. You will learn the team's data architecture deeply, contribute to its evolution, and grow into an autonomous owner of significant pieces of it.

This role is a great fit for someone who is excited about working with large-scale, complex data, who cares about getting the details right, and who wants to grow under the mentorship of an experienced data engineering team.

Key job responsibilities

Build and optimize physical data models and ETL pipelines for datasets that serve our products and analytics, using Amazon's data platforms (Redshift, EMR, Spark, S3, Hive, etc.)
- Take well-defined requirements from Data Scientists, Business Intelligence Engineers, and Software Development Engineers, and deliver tested, documented, and maintainable data solutions on schedule
- Troubleshoot, root-cause, and resolve issues in existing datasets and pipelines, leaving them better and easier to maintain than you found them
- Measure and improve dataset quality — completeness, freshness, correctness — and contribute to the team's monitoring and SLA framework
- Write secure, stable, testable, and well-documented code in SQL and Python (or Scala), and submit it for code review
- Classify, store, and handle data in accordance with Amazon's security and privacy policies
- Participate in team design, scoping, and prioritization discussions; learn the business context behind the team's data architecture and the products it supports
- Collaborate with peers across Fulfillment Optimization and partner teams to integrate data sources and unblock downstream consumers

A day in the life

You will spend your day writing SQL and Python, designing tables and pipelines, reviewing teammates' code, and pairing with data scientists and engineers to understand what they need from the data. You will start with well-scoped pieces of work — a new dataset, an optimization to an existing pipeline, an investigation into a data quality issue — and grow your scope as you build context. You will be supported by a team that values mentorship, code review, and writing things down.

About the team

The Fulfillment Optimization organization owns and operates the artificial intelligence, optimization, and simulation systems that plan and run Amazon's outbound fulfillment network. The organization is spread across the United States and Europe and is multi-disciplinary — Research Science, Applied Science, Business Intelligence, Product Management, Data Engineering, and Software Development. Our team is a newly formed horizontal team responsible for the data foundations that all Fulfillment Optimization products and analytics depend on. Come join us as we build that foundation from the ground up.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in data engineering
- Experience with data modeling, warehousing and building ETL pipelines

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience with AWS technologies like Redshift, S3, AWS Glue, EMR, Kinesis, FireHose, Lambda, and IAM roles and permissions
- Experience with non-relational databases / data stores (object storage, document or key-value stores, graph databases, column-family databases)

jobs.description:
Senior Regional Construction Manager, EMEA, Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) – Construction, EMEA
Job ID: 10479395 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Description

The Global Real Estate and Facilities (GREF) team provides real estate transaction expertise, business partnering, space & occupancy planning, design and construction, capital investment program management and facility maintenance, and operations for Amazon's corporate office portfolio across multiple countries. We partner with suppliers to ensure quality, innovation, and operational excellence with Amazon's business and utilize customer driven feedback to continuously improve and exceed employee expectations.

GREF's Workplace Design and Construction team is looking for a Senior Regional Construction Manager in EMEA (Europe, Middle East, & Africa) to drive construction services on projects, including tenant improvements, new builds, expansions, and renovations of Amazon corporate facilities. Responsible for delivery of projects from outset of design through operational turnover, this individual must be comfortable operating on both strategic and tactical levels, simultaneously acting as a visionary, an internal ambassador, educator, analyst, solutions architect, and implementer. This role collaborates with leadership and other stakeholders to set a budget and schedule, then drive project objectives, scope, space allocation, cost, prioritization, and sequencing of requests all within the set parameters. All of this is accomplished by building strong design and construction project teams that thrive and excel through collaboration. The role also involves managing contractor performance to ensure timely completion, compliance with cost requirements, organizational standards, and other requirements and regulations.

The ideal candidate will collaborate with regional teams to make decisions that find the right balance between frugality and Value Engineering without impacting customer experience, continuously research and provide innovative solutions to enhance best design practices across EMEA, interface with design and construction leads in APAC, EMEA, and AMER to transfer knowledge and best practices to EMEA, and collaborate with all EMEA GREF key players/leaders and key stakeholders (Legal, IT, EHS, ACS, Finance Procurement).

At Amazon, we believe that in-person collaboration is essential to our culture and innovation. While we allow flexibility for personal circumstances, we generally expect employees to work from our offices five days a week. This approach has consistently shown that spontaneous interactions, rapid problem-solving, and the energy of in-person teamwork lead to better results for our customers. In particular, our data shows that teams working together in person are more effective at making complex decisions, onboarding new team members, and fostering the kind of creative collaboration that has driven Amazon's success. The serendipitous hallway conversations and impromptu whiteboarding sessions that happen naturally in an office environment have proven invaluable to our invention process and maintaining our high bar for excellence. Additionally, this position requires travel of up to 40% in assigned region, as well as some travel outside region.

Key job responsibilities

• Lead and manage a team of construction professionals and their career development in the Europe, Middle East, and Africa regions.
• Strategically plan for future growth, establishing short term and long-term processes and team goals to enable speed to market with low capital costs.
• Develop and monitor project budgets, track costs, and prepare forecasts.
• Identify and mitigate project risks, ensure compliance with contracts and regulations, monitor safety standards and requirements, and resolve project issues.
• Hold landlords accountable to lease terms, including premises delivery timing and condition.
• Oversee with real estate team extensive lease terms to determine scope of Landlord and Amazon work, associated costs and responsibilities, planning and building permits and approvals, and other legal documents across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
• Participate in reviews of project risks and opportunities to drive cost efficiency through Value Engineering.
• Audit contractors to check that they are competent and financially and procedurally fit to undertake the work on which they will be deployed.
• Work closely with teams to identify resources and collaborate in the planning and implementation of projects across the entire network.
• Lead complex, mission-critical projects from initiation through delivery.
• Responsible for the overall performance of project and teams in relation to budget and schedule, through coordinating and leading the resolution of issues and concerns.

Basic Qualifications

- Experience in one or more of the following areas: construction or engineering project management, real estate development, or architecture/design
- Speak, write, and read fluently in English
- Experience in team management and building (including coaching and mentoring)
- Highly competent with personal computers and productivity software, including Microsoft Office, MS Project, and SharePoint.
Preferred Qualifications
- University/undergraduate degree in construction management, business administration, engineering, architecture, interior design, or a similar discipline.
- Keen understanding of sourcing/procurement, building systems and maintenance, vendor management, and customer service.
- Demonstrates comfort with legal terms and structures for standard commercial contracts and leases.

Description

The Amazon Leo European Operations team is looking for a Field Quality Assurance and Compliance Lead who will be responsible for embedding quality standards and training excellence across Field Service Providers in Europe. Amazon Leo is an initiative to increase global broadband access through a constellation of 3,236 satellites in low Earth orbit (LEO). Its mission is to bring fast, affordable broadband to unserved and underserved communities around the world. Amazon Leo will help close the digital divide by delivering fast, affordable broadband to a wide range of customers, including consumers, businesses, government agencies, and other organizations operating in places without reliable connectivity.

A successful candidate will be a detail-oriented quality professional with a passion for driving consistency and excellence across distributed service operations. We are looking for someone with experience in quality assurance frameworks, compliance, and audit management, ideally within telecommunications, utilities, or field service industries. The ideal candidate will ensure that Leo's policies and procedures are embedded across all Field Service Providers, driving consistent customer standards across every territory and bringing B2B processes into full scope.

Job ID: 10450199 | Amazon Europe Core Sarl

Embark on an exciting journey at Amazon as a Specialised Software Development Engineer! Join our cutting-edge teams working on innovative technologies that impact millions of customers worldwide.
Pioneer the future of AI and Machine Learning at Amazon by developing cutting-edge ML solutions that power Amazon Q, optimize European-wide operations, revolutionize retail search matching for millions of EU customers, or enhance Amazon Music recommendations worldwide.

jobs.description:
Language: English (UK)
Location Luxembourg
Country: Luxembourg

Role Type: Open Position

Job (internal): Research scientist


About the SnT
The University of Luxembourg is an international research university with a distinctly multilingual and interdisciplinary character.
The Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust (SnT) at the University of Luxembourg is a leading international research and innovation centre in secure, reliable and trustworthy ICT systems and services.
We play an instrumental role in Europe by fueling innovation through research partnerships with industry, boosting R&D investments leading to economic growth, and attracting highly qualified talent. We look for researchers from diverse academic backgrounds to contribute to our projects in areas such as: Network Security, Information Assurance, Model-driven Security, Cloud Computing, Cryptography, Satellite Systems, Vehicular Networks, and ICT Services & Applications.
The successful candidate will become a member of the Interdisciplinary Centre for Security, Reliability and Trust within the Signal Processing and Communications Research Group (SIGCOM) under the supervision of Prof. Symeon Chatzinotas at the University of Luxembourg.
Ever-evolving intelligent connectivity systems require increasingly efficient systems to transmit, analyze, and reconstruct high-quality data. The SIGCOM group at SnT conducts research aimed at designing, emulating, and testing new high-performance systems for the future of mobile and satellite communications. Fields of applications range from 6G telecommunications to satellite-based internet connectivity and quantum internet. The SIGCOM group works across the entire spectrum of blue-sky research and applied research to conceive future communication networks. Prospective researchers will find a large and vibrant team of over 100 members fostering a collaborative atmosphere. The group consistently publishes in top 10% venues, approaching 200 papers per year, supported by 60 running research projects.

Your role
• Conduct research and technology transfer in the area of advanced and intelligent wireless communications networks, with emphasis in the next-generation 6G cellular networks and non-terrestrial components
• Have the potential to build/lead a research team within the SIGCOM Research Group at SnT
• SIGCOM conducts research in close collaboration with the industry/government partners and is engaged in a number of European/International projects. The candidate will contribute to the definition, acquisition, and management of research projects together with other faculty or as a principal investigator
• Supervise PhD students in relevant topics with other faculty or as principal supervisor
• Ensure continuity in the laboratory/experimental research activities, international visibility and recruitment efforts
• Design and deliver Bachelor and Master level classes in computer science, wireless communications and/or optical-quantum communications, in the Bachelor in Engineering, or at the Masters belonging to FSTM Faculté des Sciences, des Technologies et de Médecine

The candidate detailed mission is to:
• Acquire, manage and contribute to research, innovations, and technology transfer activities with private and public partners
• Disseminate scientific results in top 10% conferences/journals
• Independently supervise PhD candidates and junior research associates
• Prepare and contribute to European and National research proposals to sustain the group's strategic research

Your profile
• PhD in Engineering, Computer Science, Physics or other relevant field
• At least 4 years of PostDoc research experience in relevant research area(s). Documented research expertise in:
o next-generation wireless communications and networking paradigms, non-terrestrial communications, quantum and optical communications, edge computing, telecom artificial intelligence, multi-functional systems (communications, sensing, positioning, computing), antenna and beamforming design and practical validation of technologies in Lab environment
• Proven track record in carrying a leading role in research project acquisition and project management
• Experience in research collaboration with industrial and international partners
• Experience in supporting PhD candidates in their research

Language requirements: The University of Luxembourg is set in a multilingual and multicultural context. The person hired for this position must demonstrate an excellent command of English (C1). The University encourages its staff to learn French or German and provides access to language courses to this end.

We offer
• A modern, dynamic university with a personal and inclusive atmosphere. Multilingual and international character. Staff coming from more than 90 countries. Member of The Guild of European Research Intensive Universities
• An exceptional research environment, supported by skilled staff and high-quality equipment. Strong links to professional sectors and the Luxembourg labour market. A unique urban campus with excellent infrastructure
• A partner for society and industry. Cooperation with European institutions, innovative companies, the Financial Centre and a wide range of non-academic partners including ministries, local governments, associations, and NGOs

How to apply
Applications should include:
• CV; you may include any periods of absence from work, such as family-related leave or career breaks, if you consider them relevant for the fair assessment of your experience
• Cover letter detailing your motivation for applying to the advertised research topic and/or project, including how your background, interests, and career goals align with its objective
• Short description of profile, key achievements and impact, summarizing main publications and projects
• Lists of publications, research projects, PhD theses supervised and subjects taught if applicable
Additional documents required:
• Research statement and research plan for the next five years, including proposed research projects in the framework of the theme and mission of the profile
• Names, contact information and current position of up to 3 referees who can, upon request, provide an assessment of the application. Please indicate their relationship to you

The University of Luxembourg embraces inclusion, diversity and gender equality as essential for academic excellence. We are fully committed to removing discriminatory barriers in recruitment and career progression and to advance gender balance among academic staff. Should candidates present equivalent CVs, preference will be given to female candidates in all departments where gender parity is not yet achieved.

• Work Hours: Full Time 40.0 Hours per Week
• Location: Kirchberg Campus

jobs.title: Compatibility
jobs.description:
CompatibilityWorking at Stripe is not for everyone

Not everyone finds success at Stripe. Those who do tend to share a few things in common.

The right people donât always think theyâre right

Successful Stripes are rigorous thinkers who appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. We want people who are not afraid to be wrong, who can enthusiastically back proposals they initially opposed, and who know how to support decisions with numbers and narrative. We operate in situations of substantial uncertainty and cannot afford either timidity or recklessness.

The global financial system can seem like a mystifying domain. It isnât. Itâs made of people and computers, like many other systems youâve worked on. Most Stripes donât come from finance, and theyâve thrived by bringing fresh perspectives. We want generalists who can parachute anywhere into our operations, learn a new field quickly, and execute competently beyond their formal remit.

We know that we canât be successful without nurturing the careers of both generalists and experts. People who thrive in high-conflict work environments often do not enjoy the experience here. We try to embrace kindness while still encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Who is Stripe for?

Ambitious builders

Weâre building solutions without clear precedent, solving problems with far-reaching consequences. The people here find that energizing, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Adaptable problem solvers

AI is changing how the global economy works, how our customers work, and how Stripes work. The people who thrive here adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities.

Rigorous thinkers

We argue from first principles, question assumptions, and donât stop at good enough. At Stripe, craft isnât a nice-to-haveâitâs the standard.

The most successful Stripes are the people who have the intellectual horsepower, the curiosity to learn a very complicated business, and the humility to get up every day and realize thereâs a huge amount of things they donât know.

Conor McNamaraHead of EMEA

What all Stripes have in common

Weâre dedicated to our work and optimistic about the world. We believe entrepreneurship and free markets do good, and building what supports them matters. If thatâs you, read on.

Motivated by our mission

Stripe is on a mission to grow the GDP of the internet.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see free markets and entrepreneurship as powerful forces for advancing progress?
  • Does enabling entrepreneurship and helping to unlock the internet economyâs full potential seem like a compelling use of my time and talents?

Embody our operating principles

âUsers firstâ is a cornerstone principle. Our users trust us to provide an essential service, and itâs a heavy responsibility that we take very seriously.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I motivated to move mountains to protect and support businesses that depend on Stripe?
  • Am I driven to overcome obstacles and take on big things to drive progress, or do I feel overwhelmed by the sheer scale and breadth of sometimes nebulous opportunities?

Energized by change

The pace of change at Stripe and in the broader economy is accelerating. Youâll work outside your domain, take on problems that didnât exist a year ago, and be expected to adapt as quickly as the world does.

Ask Yourself:

  • Do I see a fast-moving environment as an opportunity rather than an obstacle?
  • Am I comfortable taking on problems outside my domain or experience?

Collaborative, multidisciplinary work

Building programmable financial infrastructure from first principles is inherently complex. It means that everything we create requires deep, collaborative, multidisciplinary work: technically, organizationally, and geographically.

Ask Yourself:

  • Am I excited by navigating complexity at scale?

How we operate

Youâll bring high standards to everything you do and find others who do the same.

Users first

We serve millions of businesses and a meaningful fraction of global GDP. We have a weighty responsibility to those businesses and to society. We work backwards from our usersâ needs, indexing especially on feedback from the most innovative. Everyone at Stripe talks to users.

Create with craft and beauty

With careful thought, anything can be made surprisingly great. Across every part of Stripe, we are committed to doing so. Well-crafted work indicates care for the user, and beautiful work indicates care for the world.

Move with urgency and focus

We move with speed on what matters most and take the time to invest in what will make us faster tomorrow. Whereas many companies get slower until theyâre eventually mired in mediocrity, we aspire to become the worldâs fastest company.

Collaborate egolessly

We work as one team: no fiefdoms, no hoarding information, no ânot my problem.â We question assumptions, debate energetically, and abandon ideas when better ones emerge. Weâre generous with credit and stingy with blame. We learn from mistakes together.

Stay curious

Stripe is an applied exercise in learning about how businesses tick and how the world works. Since the details and possibilities are infinite, we are always seeking to learn. Weâre energized by the unfamiliar, preferring the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

Obsess over talent

Itâs every Stripeâs responsibility to help hire the best and to push for excellence everywhere. Managers must relentlessly uphold our high talent bar, lead their teams with clarity and context, foster development, and ultimately support Stripes in accomplishing the best work of their careers.

Our culture

Like all great workplaces, Stripe has its own working culture, with norms that can surprise, delight, and occasionally perplex.

Friday Fireside

Friday Fireside is a weekly Stripe-wide forum hosted by Patrick and John. We hear from a Stripe user and get their unvarnished feedback, invite Stripes to chat about (or demo!) their recent work, and welcome external experts to discuss timely and relevant topics.

Convergence

Every December, Stripes come together for Convergenceâa full-day event and Stripe tradition dating back to 2014. Itâs a chance to reflect on the past year, hear about our priorities for the next year, learn from each other, and poke fun at ourselves.

How we show up in the world

  • Cheeky Pint

Ideas meet the pub hang. In this podcast series, John Collison sits down with founders, builders, and leaders to discuss their craft over a pint.

Watch Cheeky Pint

  • Stripe Press

Stripe Press publishes books about ideas for economic, technological, and scientific progress. We print works we think can be broadly useful.

Find Stripe Press titles

  • Works in Progress

Stripeâs online and print magazine focuses on scientific, technological and economic advancement.

Read about Works in Progress

  • Frontier

Launched in 2022, Frontier is Stripeâs advance market commitment to buy an initial $1.8B of permanent carbon removal by 2040.

Learn about Frontier

  • Intercept

A new initiative focused on dramatically reducing the burden of respiratory viruses.

Learn about Intercept

Frequently asked questions

What is it actually like to work at Stripe day to day?

Fast-paced, intellectually demanding, and creative. The volume is high, and the problems are high stakes. But you wonât be doing it aloneâwe work with egoless collaboration. Most Stripes will tell you the caliber of their teammates is one of the things they value most, and that it raises their own standard of work.

How does Stripe invest in your growth?

Through the work itself, mostly. Stripe gives people stretch projects early, which means youâre solving problems that are hard and consequential to the business. Beyond that, we offer mentorship, direct feedback, and an annual education stipend for courses, conferences, and resources that move your career forward. The expectation is that youâll grow quickly here. Weâre set up to support you.

How does AI shape the work here?

AI is embedded in how everyone at Stripe builds, analyzes, and operates. Engineers use AI tools daily to accelerate development. Teams across product, design, and operations are building AI-powered features for the businesses and consumers who rely on Stripe. We think carefully about where AI creates real value versus where it introduces risk.

What does it mean to do your best work here?

Stripe is a place to do career-defining work. The stakes are high: millions of businesses rely on Stripe. Itâs a responsibility that requires combining urgency with high standards, an often demanding mix. In exchange, you'll have the support and opportunity to pursue big ideas and change how things work, with a high degree of autonomy.

More on careers at Stripe

  • Get our perspective on why what we build matters.

Opportunity

  • Start your career at the center of the global economyâsee what we offer for early career opportunities.

Emerging talent

  • Weâre hiring. Explore our open roles and submit your application.

Open roles

jobs.title: Menu
jobs.description:
As Abraham Lincoln once said, âThe best way to predict the future is to create it.â If you want to advance your career but donât know where to start, here are some things you can do to get promoted at work.

By Michele Reynolds

  • Be a Model Employee

Rule number one for being a good employee is to always be on time and ready to go. Even if you work in a culture that runs behind schedule, itâs better to be on timeâor even earlyâeach day and to every meeting.

If youâre leading the meeting, show up with an agenda and be an active timekeeper. Itâs a sign that youâre organized, respect peopleâs time, and serve as a role model to peers. At the end of the meeting, give a quick recap and identify next steps.

  • Solve Problems, Donât Just Identify Them

One of the best ways to stand out as a budding leaderâregardless of your current roleâis to be self-sufficient and demonstrate solid judgment. Doing so wonât just set you apart as a critical asset to your team but also serve as a tactic to further develop your leadership skills. A helpful mantra is, âBe a problem solver, not a problem identifier.â

When you raise an issue to your boss, also propose a solution. Busy leaders often get bogged down by solving every problem their team faces. Do your boss a favor and find workarounds rather than just surface issues.

  • Respect Your Bossâs Time

Be considerate of your bossâs time. Before asking for help, consider the level of urgency and try solving the problemâor at least brainstorm a plan of action to run by your manager. Making an attempt first will demonstrate you know how to take initiative.

For things that require your bossâs intervention but arenât time-sensitive, keep a running list of items to discuss. Ask if you can get some time on your managerâs calendar and outline what youâd like to discuss in your meeting invite so you both come prepared.

  • Donât Be a Squeaky Wheel

Perhaps most important is a can-do attitude. Anything you can do to minimize your bossâs workload will likely benefit you in the long run. You can help by volunteering to take on something new or brainstorm solutions when a crisis pops up.

Baseball great Wade Boggs once said, âA positive attitude causes a chain reaction of positive thoughts, events, and outcomes. Itâs a catalyst, and it sparks extraordinary results.â

So, whatever you do, donât be a whiner. Even if youâre feeling stressed, save your venting for a friend and present a positive front to your boss.

  • Serve as a Vault

Earn trust by keeping information about confidential or sensitive subjects to yourself. Beyond that, donât gossip or backstab at the water cooler. By being a stand-up employee, youâll earn trust and respect.

  • Make Your Boss Look Good

Staying organized and moving quickly can make you, and your boss, look good. But donât move too fast. Getting things done efficiently is important, but quality matters, too.

Ensure your work represents your company well. If you take on additional responsibilities, confirm they align with whatâs expected of you. Your work reflects on your boss, so make sure theyâre proud of you and your product.

  • Ask for Advice

It may seem counterintuitive, but asking your boss for advice can yield dividends. According to research (pdf) by Harvard Business School Professor Alison Wood-Brooks, âIndividuals perceive those who seek advice as more competent than those who do not.â

Timed right, asking your boss for guidance can work to your advantage.

  • Speak Up

As Aristotle said, âThereâs only one way to avoid criticism: Do nothing, say nothing, and be nothing.â Since youâre reading this article, you clearly want to stand out, so speak up.

Confidently sharing your views and expertise in conversations or meetings allows you to demonstrate your knowledge and skills. You can also make an impression on your colleagues and superiors.

  • Project Confidence

Being a strong communicator is more than what you say. How you say itâboth in your body language and tone of voiceâmay matter more than the words themselves.

Albert Mehrabian, a professor at the University of California, Los Angeles, and an expert in nonverbal communication, proved through his research that what you say is negligible compared to how you say it. Body language and inflection matter more.

âNonverbal elements are particularly important for communicating feelings and attitude, especially when theyâre incongruent: If words and body language disagree, one tends to believe the body language,â Mehrabian told the site Right Attitudes.

That said, you can look like a leader through confident body language, such as your posture, stance, handshake, eye contact, and smile.

  • Advance Your Education

What else can you do to propel your career growth? If you want to sharpen your skills but donât have the time or resources to go back to school full- or even part-time, consider taking an online course.

According to HBS Professor Das Narayandas, thereâs a plethora of options that can benefit you and your employer.

As Narayandas said to the Harvard Business Review, âThe good news is that the growing assortment of online courses, social and interactive platforms, and learning tools from both traditional institutions and upstartsâ¦offers a solution. [Theyâre] flexible and immediately accessible, and it enables employees to pick up skills in the context in which they must be used. In effect, itâs a 21st-century form of on-the-job training.â

There are many affordable online business courses that can work around your schedule. Your employer might even cover the cost.

One to consider is Leadership Principles. It features interactive exercises to help you if youâre an early- or mid-career professional preparing for a leadership role.

jobs.title: Director of Strategic Communications & PR
jobs.description:
Director of Strategic Communications \& PR  
To strengthen its public voice and institutional positioning, the foundation is creating the position of Director of Strategic Communications \& PR, based in Zurich or Bern and a member of the Senior Leadership Team.  
The role. As the foundation's most senior communications leader, you shape and carry its public voice: institutional communications, media relations, political and policy\-related dossiers, and thought leadership on mission\-driven business. You lead a team of three (design and communications), act as the liaison with the foundation's think tank and research activities, and leverage an excellent personal network across Swiss media, institutions and the impact economy ecosystem.  
Key responsibilities  
Define and drive the foundation's overall communications and PR strategy, aligned with its mission and institutional positioning  
Lead institutional communications towards partners, public authorities (Confederation, cantons), academia and the wider ecosystem  
Position the foundation on mission\-driven business topics: purpose\-led companies, sustainable and regenerative economy, corporate responsibility  
Steer political and policy\-related dossiers from a communications perspective: monitoring, messaging, positioning papers, public consultations  
2  
Build and activate a strong network of journalists and editors across German\- and French\-speaking Switzerland  
Act as senior media contact and spokesperson coordination point, in close alignment with the CEO  
Prepare and place op\-eds, interviews, keynotes and public interventions for the CEO and leadership team  
Manage issues and reputation: anticipate sensitive topics, prepare positions, coordinate responses  
3  
Serve as the communications interface with the foundation's think tank and research activities  
Translate research findings, barometers and studies into compelling public narratives, publications and campaigns  
Orchestrate flagship publication launches and public events with the research and programme teams  
Ensure consistency of messaging between research outputs, institutional positions and programme communications  
4  
Lead, develop and inspire a team of 3 (designer and communications professionals)  
Oversee all channels: website, newsletters, social media, publications and brand consistency  
Manage the communications budget, agencies and external providers (PR, content, translation)  
Define KPIs and report regularly on communications performance to the Senior Leadership Team and the Board  
Your profile  
Essential qualifications  
Senior communications experience — minimum 8 years in strategic communications, PR or public affairs, including at least 3 years in a leadership role with team responsibility (foundation, NGO, international organisation, think tank, corporate affairs or agency at director level)  
Excellent network — established personal relationships with Swiss media, federal and cantonal institutions, and the sustainability/impact ecosystem  
Political and institutional literacy — proven experience handling policy\-related dossiers, public affairs or political communications in the Swiss context  
Trilingual fluency — DE and EN fluent (working languages for media and institutions), FR fluent (Suisse romande community and partners)  
Outstanding writing and storytelling — ability to craft institutional messaging, op\-eds and public narratives at native\-level quality in German, and confidently in English and French  
Leadership — experience managing and developing a small multidisciplinary team (content, design)  
Highly valued  
Knowledge of the Swiss philanthropy and foundation ecosystem, and of the B Corp / mission\-driven business movement  
Experience working with or within a think tank, research institution or evidence\-based advocacy organisation  
Experience in organisational transitions (rebranding, repositioning, mergers)  
Familiarity with digital communications analytics and modern content operations (CRM, marketing automation, AI\-assisted workflows)  
Personal qualities  
Strategic mind, hands\-on attitude — comfortable moving between Senior Leadership Team discussions and drafting a press release  
Credibility and presence — a trusted counterpart for editors\-in\-chief, senior officials and board members  
Sound political judgement — non\-partisan, balanced and rigorous on sensitive public topics  
Calm under pressure — composed handling of media dynamics and sensitive dossiers  
Genuine commitment to the foundation's mission — communications as a lever for a sustainable and regenerative economy  
Conditions  
Compensation — according to seniority and experience  
Contract — permanent, full time or 80 % depending on the candidate's preference  
Location — Zurich or Bern, majority on\-site with hybrid flexibility (1 day/week); regular travel across Switzerland  
Start date — as soon as possible  
Governance — member of the Senior Leadership Team, reporting directly to the CEO  
Equipment and development — laptop, digital tools and an annual professional development budget  
Benefits — 25 days of annual leave, partial remote work, mission\-driven environment  
Why this role  
A rare opportunity to shape the public voice of a leading Swiss mission\-driven foundation at a pivotal moment of its development — with a seat at the leadership table, a talented team, and direct influence on how mission\-driven business and policy topics are debated in Switzerland.  
Your application should include:  
CV (. 2 pages)  
Cover letter focusing on:  
a communications or PR strategy you designed and led, and its measurable impact;  
a sensitive political, institutional or media dossier you managed (context, role, outcome);  
your motivation for putting your network and expertise at the service of the foundation's mission.  
Availability (starting date, envisaged workload)  
1–3 professional references  
Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and treated in strict confidence.  
Selection process  
Pre\-qualification — 30\-minute call  
In\-depth interview — 60 min (track record, key experiences, fit) with the CEO and a member of the Senior Leadership Team  
Practical case study — 60 min, based on provided materials (scenario: positioning the foundation on a sensitive policy topic, incl. media Q\&A)  
Final conversation — with the CEO and a representative of the Board of the foundation

jobs.description:
Un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire à Rogliano, en Italie, cherche son nouvel orthophoniste H/F pour un CDI.

Les conditions
- CDI
- Temps plein
- Répartition sur 5 ou 6 jours
- 38 heures par semaine

La structure
Vous rejoindrez un établissement médical pluridisciplinaire implanté à Rogliano, à proximité de Cosenza, en Calabre. L'établissement est spécialisé dans le diagnostic, le traitement, la prévention et la réadaptation, avec une prise en charge personnalisée reposant sur des technologies modernes et une équipe multidisciplinaire. En outre, le service de médecine physique et de réadaptation est conventionné avec le Service national de santé italien et prend en charge les pathologies du système musculo-squelettique et du système nerveux. Les patients bénéficient d'examens d'imagerie réalisés sur place et d'un parcours de rééducation intégrant thérapies manuelles et techniques modernes.

La rémunération
- Rémunération selon la convention collective nationale italienne CCNL AIOP RSA, niveau D2

Les missions
- Prendre en charge les troubles de la communication, du langage, de la parole et de la déglutition
- Évaluer les patients et établir des bilans orthophoniques précis
- Mettre en place des programmes de rééducation personnalisés
- Collaborer avec les équipes médicales et paramédicales dans une approche multidisciplinaire
- Suivre l'évolution des patients et adapter les prises en charge
- Contribuer à la qualité et à la continuité des soins

Les avantages
- Logement pris en charge pendant les 6 premiers mois
- Accompagnement administratif pour faciliter l'installation en Italie
- Contrat à durée indéterminée proposé en priorité avec possibilités de collaboration indépendante selon profil
- Équipe pluridisciplinaire et prise en charge personnalisée des patients
- Accès à l'imagerie et aux techniques de rééducation sur site
- Aménagement du temps de travail sur 5 ou 6 jours selon l'organisation

Le petit truc en plus
Rogliano bénéficie d'un emplacement proche de Cosenza, ville universitaire et culturelle, et offre un accès rapide à la diversité des paysages de la Calabre, entre zones littorales et massifs intérieurs, pour des sorties nature et une qualité de vie agréable.

This technical assistance service aims to provide expertise in DevOps engineering and Cloud Infrastructure for the benefit of the organization. You will provide technical expertise on CI/CD chain tooling and infrastructure automation, in order to strengthen the security and efficiency of deployment environments.

The service covers technical support in the following areas: maintenance and optimization of CI/CD tools (Jenkins, SonarQube, JFrog Artifactory); design and implementation of infrastructure automation solutions (Terraform, AWS, EC2); support on Kubernetes environments and observability practices (Grafana).

jobs.title: KotiAvustajat - yrittäjä
jobs.description:
KotiAvustajat ovat palvelleet asiakkaita 15 vuoden ajan Seinäjoella ja vuosien varrella laajentaneet toimintaansa Alavudelle, Ilmajoelle, Kuortaneelle, Kaustiselle, Veteliin, Hausjärvelle, Hyvinkäälle, Körkölään, Mäntsälään, Riihimäelle, Lempäälään, Nokialle, Pirkkalaan, Sastamalaan, Tampereelle, Ylöjärvelle, Helsinkiin, Espooseen, Kauniaisiin ja Vantaalle

Haemme itsenäisiä KotiAvustaja - yrittäjiä ympäri Suomen, jotka toimivat yhteistyössä KotiAvustajien kanssa uniikin toimintamallin mukaisesti omalla asuinpaikkakunnallaan.

KotiAvustajana voit vaikuttaa omalla työlläsi siihen, että asuinpaikkakuntasi ikäihmiset saavat hyvää hoivaa ja huolenpitoa sekä konkreettista apua kotona asumiseen. KotiAvustajana autat ja huolehdit asiakkaan hyvinvoinnista antaen ohjausta terveydentilan ja toimintakyvyn ylläpitämiseksi. Kotikäynnit keskittyvät arkipäiviin ja sinulla on aikaa kohdata asiakas.

Kaikki KotiAvustajat toimivat uniikin KotiAvustajat® brändin mukaisesti, joka luo paremmat toimintaedellytykset yrityksellesi sekä mahdollisuuden kehittyä paremmaksi osaajaksi. Asiakkuudet ovat pääsääntöisesti pitkäkestoisia ja se tuo turvaa yrittäjyyteen. Sinulla on hyvät mahdollisuudet erittäin hyviin ansioihin, joka luonnollisesti riippuu sinusta ja aktiivisuudestasi.

Asiakastyötä tulet tekemään omalla persoonallasi ja täydellä sydämellä. Avoimuus, kyky kuunnella ja halu auttaa ovat tärkeimpiä ominaisuuksiasi. Lähtökohta toiminnallesi on hyvä asiakaspalvelu, jossa työtä teet aina asiakkaalle.

Sinulla on terveysalan koulutus (esim. sairaanhoitaja, terveydenhoitaja, toimintaterapeutti, farmaseutti, fysioterapeutti jne.), hygieniapassi, auto omaan käyttöön sekä hallitset erinomaisesti suomen kielen.

Saat yrittäjyyteen vankan tuen ja asiantuntevia neuvoja sekä ohjeita alkumetreiltä lähtien, "Liikkuvaan junaan" ja osaajien joukkoon on nyt helppo hypätä mukaan!

jobs.title: Data Entry Administrator
jobs.description:
About PulseMediaNL

PulseMediaNL is a forward-thinking digital media company committed to delivering high-quality content, innovative marketing solutions, and exceptional customer experiences. We value accuracy, efficiency, collaboration, and continuous improvement. As our team grows, we are seeking a highly organized and detail-oriented Data Entry Administrator to support our daily operations by maintaining accurate and reliable data across multiple platforms.

Position Overview

The Data Entry Administrator is responsible for accurately entering, updating, verifying, and maintaining company data while ensuring the highest standards of quality and confidentiality. This role requires excellent attention to detail, strong organizational skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. The successful candidate will help ensure that business records remain complete, accurate, and accessible, contributing directly to operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Accurately enter data into company databases, spreadsheets, and internal management systems.
  • Review and verify information for completeness, accuracy, and consistency before submission.
  • Update existing records with new information while maintaining data integrity.
  • Identify and correct errors, inconsistencies, or duplicate entries.
  • Organize and maintain digital files, records, and documentation.
  • Perform routine data quality checks and audits.
  • Generate reports and summaries as requested by management.
  • Assist with importing and exporting data between various software platforms.
  • Maintain confidential information in accordance with company policies and applicable privacy regulations.
  • Collaborate with internal departments to obtain missing or updated information.
  • Prioritize tasks to meet deadlines while maintaining a high level of accuracy.
  • Support administrative projects and perform additional data-related tasks as assigned.

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent; an associate's or bachelor's degree is an advantage.
  • Previous experience in data entry, administrative support, or office administration preferred.
  • Excellent typing skills with a high level of accuracy.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to producing error-free work.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel and Word.
  • Experience using Google Workspace, including Google Sheets and Google Docs.
  • Comfortable learning and using new software and database systems.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Reliable internet connection and a suitable remote work environment.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with CRM or ERP software.
  • Familiarity with database management systems.
  • Knowledge of data privacy and information security best practices.
  • Experience working remotely in a professional environment.
  • Basic analytical and problem-solving skills.

Key Skills

  • Data entry accuracy
  • Time management
  • Organization
  • Attention to detail
  • Communication
  • Problem-solving
  • Computer literacy
  • Multitasking
  • Confidentiality
  • Team collaboration

What We Offer

  • Fully remote work environment.
  • Competitive salary.
  • Flexible working schedule where applicable.
  • Paid time off and company holidays.
  • Opportunities for professional development and career growth.
  • Supportive and collaborative team culture.
  • Ongoing training and skill development.
  • Performance recognition and advancement opportunities.
  • Access to modern digital collaboration tools.

Success in This Role

The ideal candidate consistently delivers accurate work, meets deadlines, maintains confidentiality, communicates effectively with colleagues, and demonstrates a proactive approach to improving data quality and administrative processes.

Equal Opportunity Employer

PulseMediaNL is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where all employees are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities.

If you are a detail-oriented professional who enjoys working with data and thrives in a remote environment, we encourage you to apply and become part of the PulseMediaNL team.

jobs.title: Senior HEOR Manager Patient-Reported Outcome  m/f/d
jobs.description:
Senior HEOR Manager Patient\-Reported Outcome (12 months contract) m/f/d  
At Bayer we're visionaries, driven to solve the world's toughest challenges and striving for a world where ,Health for all, Hunger for none' is nolonger a dream, but a real possibility. We're doing it with energy, curiosity and sheer dedication, always learning from unique perspectives ofthose around us, expanding our thinking, growing our capabilities and redefining 'impossible'. There are so many reasons to join us. If you'rehungry to build a varied and meaningful career in a community of brilliant and diverse minds to make a real difference, there's only one choice.  
Senior HEOR Manager Patient\-Reported Outcome (12 months contract) m/f/d  
As a Senior HEOR Manager COAs/PROs, you are at the forefront of clinical outcome assessment (COA) activities and projects across various therapeutic areas within our organization, always prioritizing a 'patient\-first' mindset. Your role is pivotal in COA strategic planning and execution, ensuring high impact and scientific integrity. You will collaborate and lead internal cross\-functional teams and external vendors to successfully implement COA initiatives, including patient\-reported outcomes (PROs), clinician\-reported outcomes (ClinROs), and other COA assessments for clinical programs. Your mission is to enhance the patient experience from trial design to final reporting, ensuring commercial and regulatory success of products that include COAs in their endpoint measurement strategy across clinical lifecycles.  
YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES:  
Lead the development and execution of strategic COA plans for products across therapeutic areas, owning the COA Strategy Document for each program;  
Guide internal teams in selecting appropriate COAs for clinical trials and provide input into clinical documents throughout the trial lifecycle;  
Lead the scientific execution of COA projects with external vendors and internal stakeholders;  
Provide guidance to project teams, ensuring adherence to COA regulatory requirements and best practices;  
Oversee COA validation and interpretation, ensuring psychometric evidence meets regulatory and HTA criteria;  
Collaborate on COA data analysis and reporting, preparing regulatory or scientific documents as needed;  
Prepare COA\-related regulatory and scientific submissions, leading relevant sections for regulatory agencies;  
Stay current with COA\-related scientific organizations and methodologies, incorporating advances into programs.  
WHO YOU ARE:  
At least a master's degree in Life Sciences, Psychology, Sociology, Psychometrics, Pharmacy, Biostatistics, or a related field. A Ph.D. is preferred;  
5\+ years of applied experience in health outcomes research, with demonstrated leadership and expertise in COA/PRO methodology and regulatory requirements;  
Strong ability to analyze and validate COA data, apply COA validation methodologies, and derive regulatory\-ready insights;  
Ability to develop strategies and implement tactics for optimal clinical outcome strategy addressing market access or regulatory needs globally;  
Excellent leadership skills with experience leading cross\-functional teams and managing external vendors;  
Understanding of electronic COA migrations and latest eCOA implementation standards;  
Proven ability to interact effectively with internal and external stakeholders, navigating competing priorities;  
High degree of empathy and inclusive mindset to work with diverse external stakeholder groups. jpid1c7d667jm jit0731jm jiy26jm

jobs.description:
Stellvertretende/\-r Chef/\-in Führungsdienst  
Bern \| 80\-100%  
Diesen Beitrag können Sie leisten  
Den Chef Führungsdienst Armee und Kommando Operationen bei Abwesenheit oder in besonderen Lagen vollumfänglich vertreten und den Bereich Vorlagenmanagement personell, fachlich und organisatorisch führen  
Den Führungsdienst für Operationen, Einsätze und Unterstützungsleistungen der Armee im Kommando Operationen verantworten sowie den Stabssteuerungsprozess über die Phasen Aktionsplanung, Lageverfolgung und Aktionsnachbereitung end\-to\-end planen, steuern, überwachen und weiterentwickeln  
Die Informationsverarbeitung zur militärischen Entscheidungsfindung koordinieren, verbindliche Vorgaben, Verfahren, Vorlagen und Produkte etablieren sowie die Führungsbereitschaft und den sicheren Einsatz der Führungs\- und Informationssysteme gewährleisten  
Das operative Datenmanagement im Stab Kommando Operationen steuern, Datenqualität und Data Governance sicherstellen sowie Local Data Stewards, Data Owner, IT\-Service\-Provider und Fachapplikationsverantwortliche koordinieren; Vorgaben zu Datenschutz und Informationssicherheit durchsetzen  
Komplexe und interdisziplinäre Projekte zu Führungsdienst, Stabsprozessen und Digitalisierung leiten, die Interessen des Kommando Operationen in JOPG, Ausschüssen und Fachgremien vertreten sowie Mitarbeitende in Führungsdienstverfahren, Informationsmanagement und digitalen Arbeitsmethoden ausbilden  
Das macht Sie einzigartig  
Bachelorabschluss einer Fachhochschule oder Universität, vorzugsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Sicherheitsmanagement, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Systems Engineering, oder eine gleichwertige Ausbildung mit funktionsrelevanter Berufserfahrung  
Mehrjährige Führungserfahrung, idealerweise mindestens drei Jahre in der Leitung eines Teams oder einer Organisationseinheit, sowie mindestens zwei Jahre Erfahrung im klassischen oder agilen Projektmanagement; Erfahrung in einer sicherheitsrelevanten Organisation ist von Vorteil  
Ausgewiesener militärischer Werdegang als Offizier/\-in der Armee mit mindestens drei bis fünf Jahren Erfahrung in der militärischen Führungsarbeit, beispielsweise als Chef Führungsdienst, S6, S3 oder Kommandant/\-in auf Stufe Kompanie oder höher; Generalstabsausbildung erwünscht  
Ausgeprägtes Verständnis militärischer Führungs\- und Stabsprozesse, starke analytische, konzeptionelle und organisatorische Fähigkeiten sowie überzeugende Kommunikations\-, Kooperations\- und Führungskompetenz in komplexen und dynamischen Lagen  
Hohe digitale Affinität und Kenntnisse militärischer Führungs\- und Informationssysteme, Microsoft M365 sowie vorzugsweise Jira, Confluence, Acta Nova, BPMN und HERMES oder IPMA; Deutsch C2, ösisch B2, Italienisch B1 und Englisch B2\.  
Auf den Punkt gebracht  
Sie wollen die operative Führungsfähigkeit der Armee mitgestalten und behalten auch in komplexen Lagen den Überblick? In dieser Schlüsselfunktion verbinden Sie Stabssteuerung, Informations\- und Datenmanagement, Digitalisierung und Führung \- und sorgen dafür, dass Entscheidungen auf operativer Stufe zeitgerecht auf verlässlichen Informationen beruhen.  
Das bieten wir  
Arbeiten für die Schweiz Wir setzen uns für das Erfolgsmodell Schweiz ein und arbeiten zum Wohl der Bevölkerung.  
Gelebte Vielfalt Dank Chancengleichheit entfalten wir unsere Kompetenzen und bringen unterschiedliche Perspektiven ein.  
Gesund am Arbeitsplatz Wir unterstützen und beraten unsere Mitarbeitenden im Bereich der physischen und psychischen Gesundheit.  
Alle Benefits  
Ihr Einsatz für Sicherheit und Freiheit  
Das Kommando Operationen (Kdo Op) ist für alle militärischen Operationen und Einsätze der Armee verantwortlich. Zum Kdo Op gehören u. a. die Luftwaffe, das Heer, die vier Territorialdivisionen, das Kompetenzzentrum SWISSINT, das Kommando Spezialkräfte sowie die Militärpolizei. Rund 40 % der ca. 2'500 Mitarbeitenden sind zivil angestellt – von Ingenieur/\-innen über Luftfahrzeugmechaniker/\-innen bis hin zu Analyst/\-innen.  
Die Armee beschäftigt über 9'000 Mitarbeitende in vier militärischen und rund 200 zivilen Berufen – und dies an 110 Standorten schweizweit. Auch für den Nachwuchs ist gesorgt: Die Armee bildet in über 30 Berufen Lernende aus.

jobs.title: Legal Counsel / Contracts Specialist for ETH Zurich | Space
jobs.description:
ETH Zurich is one of the world’s leading universities in the fields of science and engineering. Through its strategic initiative, ETH Zurich │ Space is systematically expanding its activities in space research and technology. A unique environment for innovation is being created through the recruitment of high-calibre researchers of international standing and the expansion of collaborations with leading partners from academia, space agencies and industry.

Within the Vice-Presidency for Knowledge Transfer and Corporate Relations, the Research Contracts Group supports researchers in ensuring that their projects with national and international partners are built on a solid legal foundation.

To strengthen our team, we are seeking, with immediate effect or by agreement, a committed, solution-oriented and strong negotiator to take on the role of Legal Counsel for ETH Zurich │ Space.
Job description

Your role at the interface between space research and law

In this role, you will be the key legal point of contact for the research activities of ETH Zurich │ Space and ETH Swiss GeoLab. You will be part of a strong team of around 20 legal professionals in the Research Contracts Group, where you will benefit from their broad expertise and mutual exchange of ideas. Your personal focus will be on independently managing the space-related portfolio. Against the backdrop of a steadily growing number of collaborations, you will facilitate and promote the conclusion of contracts between ETH researchers and space-related organisations – ranging from industrial companies and start-ups to international space agencies, as well as academic and public institutions. You will advise researchers and management on the drafting and negotiation of complex research contracts and help to ensure that innovative research projects are implemented in a legally sound and efficient manner. This encompasses both traditional space technologies (e.g. hardware) and Earth observation, the processing of geo-information and the use of space data on Earth. In doing so, you also act as a bridge to Swiss stakeholders in government bodies and the business sector.

You will support scientists with their projects from the initial idea for collaboration right through to the conclusion of a contract and lay the legal foundations for world-class international research in a highly dynamic environment.

Your key responsibilities

- You will independently review, draft and negotiate complex national and international research and development contracts, in particular Research Collaboration Agreements, Consortium Agreements, Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs) and other research and cooperation agreements.
- You will manage projects with international space agencies, research institutions and industry partners, particularly within the context of the European Space Agency (ESA), NASA, the Jet Propulsion Laboratory (JPL) and other international space and research partners.
- You will advise researchers and project managers on legal issues relating to international research collaborations, intellectual property, liability matters and other contractual risks.
- You will provide support on matters relating to export controls and dual-use goods, working closely with the relevant compliance units at ETH Zurich.
- You will provide proactive and solution-oriented advice to researchers and project managers throughout the entire project lifecycle – from project initiation to successful completion.
- You will further develop contract templates, guidelines and standard processes for the efficient and legally compliant management of space and research projects.
- You will work closely with ETH transfer, compliance units and other internal and external stakeholders.
- You will make a significant contribution to ensuring that international research collaborations are legally sound, whilst at the same time safeguarding the research community’s ability to act.

Profile
We are looking for someone who can quickly grasp complex issues, develop pragmatic solutions and takes pleasure in supporting researchers in a world-class international research environment.

- Education: You hold a university degree in law (or equivalent legal qualification) combined with a strong understanding of technical contexts.
- Experience: You have at least 5 years’ relevant professional experience in international contract law or research management – ideally gained in an international organisation, a company in the tech/space sector, a space-related authority or at a university. Experience with contracts from space agencies (e.g. ESA) or space companies is a strong advantage.
- Expertise: You have in-depth knowledge of Swiss and international contract law. Experience in intellectual property law, technology transfer or research law is an advantage.
- Space law: Knowledge of international space law, regulatory issues relating to the space sector, and the science policy context of international research collaborations would be an advantage.
- Export control & regulation: Experience in export control law (particularly ITAR/EAR), in dealing with dual-use goods or in comparable regulatory environments is particularly welcome. Knowledge of ESA or NASA-related regulatory frameworks is an additional advantage.

This position is centered on mass spectrometry data, with a primary focus on bioinformatics analysis and interpretation in support of researchers at the FGCZ. The unit maintains a portfolio of commercial and open-source applications operating on our infrastructure and establishes novel data processing and analysis pipelines.  An integral part of the work is integrating the data into our data management system and ensuring the reproducibility of the analysis.

jobs.title: Tiiminvetäjä – Ota seuraava askel myyntiurallasi
jobs.description:
**Haluatko siirtyä myyjästä valmentajaksi ja rakentaa omaa tiimiäsi?**

Etsimme tavoitteellista ja yrittäjähenkistä tiiminvetäjää johtamaan kasvavaa B2C-asiakashankintatiimiämme.

Tämä voi olla ensimmäinen esihenkilöroolisi – aikaisempaa kokemusta tiiminvetäjänä ei välttämättä tarvita. Tärkeintä on, että sinulla on halu kehittyä, innostaa muita onnistumaan ja rakentaa uraasi myynnin parissa.

Jos olet valmistumassa tai olet jo kartuttanut kokemusta myyntityöstä ja etsit seuraavaa askelta urallasi, tämä tehtävä voi olla juuri sinua varten.

**Mitä tiiminvetäjä tekee?**

Vastaat noin 10 hengen B2C-asiakashankintatiimin arjen onnistumisesta.

Tehtäväsi sisältää muun muassa:

- uusien tiimiläisten perehdyttämisen ja kouluttamisen


- tiimin päivittäisen valmentamisen ja motivoinnin


- myyntitulosten seuraamisen ja tavoitteiden saavuttamisen tukemisen


- hyvän tiimihengen rakentamisen


- uusien toimintatapojen kehittämisen yhdessä myynninjohdon kanssa


Tiiminvetäjän työ on käytännönläheistä. Noin puolet työajastasi työskentelet myös itse uusasiakashankinnan parissa. Näin pysyt mukana arjen tekemisessä, kehität omaa osaamistasi ja johdat tiimiä esimerkillä.

**Et jää yksin**

Saat tehtävääsi vahvan tuen kokeneelta myynninjohdolta.

Perehdytämme sinut tehtävään ja autamme sinua onnistumaan niin myynnissä kuin tiimin johtamisessakin. Tavoitteemme on auttaa sinua kasvamaan myynnin seuraavan tason ammattilaiseksi.

**Kenelle tehtävä sopii?**

Voit olla esimerkiksi:

- myyntityössä jo kokemusta kartuttanut tekijä, joka haluaa seuraavan urastepin


- AMK-opiskelija tai vastavalmistunut liiketalouden, myynnin tai muun soveltuvan alan koulutuksesta


- kunnianhimoinen henkilö, joka haluaa oppia johtamaan ihmisiä käytännössä


Aikaisempi kokemus esihenkilötehtävistä ei ole välttämätöntä.

**Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen esimerkiksi:**

- puhelinmyynnistä


- B2C-myynnistä


- asiakashankinnasta


- tavoitteellisesta myyntityöstä


**Mitä odotamme sinulta?**

Toivomme, että olet:

- tavoitteellinen ja yrittäjähenkinen


- innostava ja helposti lähestyttävä


- valmis ottamaan vastuuta


- kiinnostunut ihmisten valmentamisesta


- motivoitunut kehittämään sekä itseäsi että tiimiäsi


Haluamme rakentaa pitkäjänteisesti kasvavaa tiimiä, joten arvostamme sitoutumista ja halua tehdä asioita yhdessä.

**Ansainta**

Tehtävä on tulosperusteinen ja yrittäjähenkinen.

Ansiosi muodostuvat sekä:

- omasta myyntityöstäsi


- oman tiimisi onnistumisista


Alkuvaiheessa tyypillinen ansiotaso on noin **2 000–4 000 €/kk**, ja osaamisen sekä tiimin kehittyessä ansaintamahdollisuudet kasvavat merkittävästi.

**Rakenna urasi meidän kanssamme**

Tämä tehtävä on erinomainen ponnahduslauta myynnin johtamiseen.

Onnistumisten myötä sinulla on mahdollisuus edetä esimerkiksi:

- suurempien myyntitiimien vetäjäksi


- B2B-myynnin vaativiin asiantuntijatehtäviin


- asiakkuuksien kehittämiseen


- myynninjohdon ja liiketoiminnan kehitystehtäviin


Me uskomme siihen, että parhaat johtajat kasvavat tekemisen kautta.

**Työskentelymalli**

Tehtävä toteutetaan yrittäjähenkisellä mallilla työsuhteessa tai voit toimia esimerkiksi kevytyrittäjänä tai oman yrityksesi kautta laskuttaen. Käymme yhteistyömallin läpi yhdessä valitun henkilön kanssa.

Haluatko rakentaa seuraavan askeleesi myyntiuralla?

Etsimme ennen kaikkea hyvää tyyppiä – henkilöä, jonka kanssa voimme rakentaa kasvua pitkäjänteisesti.

Jos haluat päästä vaikuttamaan, oppimaan ja johtamaan omaa tiimiäsi, lähetä hakemuksesi jo tänään.

Kerro meille, kuka olet, millaista kokemusta sinulla on ja miksi juuri sinä haluaisit ottaa seuraavan askeleen urallasi.

Olemme yhteydessä sopivimpiin hakijoihin ja kerromme mielellämme lisää tehtävästä sekä mahdollisuuksista kasvaa yhdessä kanssamme.

Jätä hakemuksesi osoitteessa: https://www.intensive.fi/tyopaikat/

jobs.description:
Type: Full time

Salary: Location-dependent (UK: Â£30,000âÂ£35,000 GBP / Canada: CAD $48,000â$57,000) + share options

Location: UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only)

Meet The Guru

Resource Guru is a blissfully simple scheduling tool that helps busy teams stay on track.

We boost efficiency, improve resource utilisation, and increase project profitability - while promoting a healthy work/life balance.

Weâre proud to be one of the leaders in our category, trusted by customers in over 100 countries - including top creative agencies like Publicis, TBWA, Grey, BBH, and M&C Saatchi, as well as household names like NASA, Accenture, CNN, Kraft Heinz, and the NHS. They rely on Resource Guru to manage one of their most valuable assets - their peopleâs time.

Weâre a small, fully remote team based across the UK and Europe. We collaborate mainly via Slack, with occasional meetups to connect, plan, and celebrate. See if this is the right place for you.

â­ï¸ The role

Weâre looking for a Customer Support Specialist to join our team.

As more teams use Resource Guru and as we continue to support larger, more complex customers we want to make sure every customer receives fast, clear, thoughtful and genuinely helpful support.

This role is primarily about helping customers by email, understanding their questions, troubleshooting issues, and making sure they get the best possible experience from Resource Guru.

Youâll work closely with Dana, our Senior Customer Support Specialist, and collaborate with our product and engineering teams when customer questions, bugs or feature requests need to be investigated further. We see Customer Support as a core part of building a great product, so youâll work closely with the rest of the team to help improve Resource Guru, not just answer support tickets.

This is a great role for someone with some experience in SaaS or online customer support who wants to keep developing their technical, communication and customer-facing skills in a friendly, remote-first team.

What Youâll Be Doing

Learning Resource Guru inside out

  • In your first few months, you'll get to know Resource Guru inside out - how customers use the product, what common questions come up, and how to guide people towards the right answer.

Responding to customer questions

  • Help customers with day-to-day support questions, including product usage, account setup, billing enquiries, troubleshooting and general "how do Iâ¦?" queries.
  • Most support is handled by email, though you may occasionally join a phone or video call when that would help resolve something more quickly.

Troubleshooting problems

  • Investigate customer issues carefully and methodically - asking the right follow-up questions, checking account settings, trying to reproduce a problem, looking for browser-related issues, or escalating a bug to engineering with clear notes.

Working with the wider team

  • Work closely with Dana and the wider Resource Guru team to understand customer questions, resolve issues, and make sure useful feedback is shared with Product and Engineering.
  • Help create clear internal reports when customers report bugs or technical issues, and tag/categorise feature feedback so the team understands what customers need.

Improving our help content

  • Help keep the Help Centre useful and up to date - updating existing articles, writing new ones, recording simple walkthroughs, or suggesting improvements when you notice customers asking the same questions repeatedly.

Using our support tools

  • Use tools such as Front, Recurly, Customer.io, HubSpot and other internal systems to manage customer conversations, billing questions and account information. We don't expect you to know all of these already, but you should be comfortable learning new software quickly.

Helping customers feel looked after

  • A big part of this role is making sure customers feel heard, understood and helped. We care about support that is accurate and efficient, but also warm, human and thoughtful.

What Weâre Looking ForEssential experience

  • 1-3 yearsâ experience in online customer support, ideally for a B2B SaaS or similar software company
  • Excellent written and spoken English and the ability to explain things clearly, simply and warmly
  • A calm, patient and empathetic approach to helping customers
  • Good attention to detail, especially when dealing with billing, account or technical questions
  • A practical approach to troubleshooting and problem-solving
  • Confidence learning new software tools and understanding how web-based products work
  • Some familiarity with basic technical concepts such as browsers, cache, cookies, internet connection issues and permissions
  • The ability to work independently in a remote team and manage your time well
  • A collaborative and conscientious attitude and willingness to share useful customer feedback with product, engineering and the wider team
  • Comfort with asynchronous communication and keeping written conversations clear, concise and on track

You donât need to be a developer, but you should be curious about technology and comfortable investigating how things work.

Bonus (not required)

It would be a bonus if you have experience with any of the following:

  • Supporting a SaaS product
  • Helping customers with billing, subscriptions or invoices
  • Writing Help Centre articles or customer-facing guides
  • Using support tools such as Front, Intercom, Zendesk, HubSpot or similar
  • Working in a fully remote team
  • Recording short customer help videos or walkthroughs
  • Supporting customers across multiple time zones, especially APAC-friendly hours
  • Comfortable using AI tools to improve the quality and efficiency of your work

Working Hours

This is a remote role, for people based in either the UK or Canada (Atlantic Time Zone only). Youâll also need regular overlap with the UK team for training, collaboration and handovers.

The exact working pattern will depend on your location and the coverage we agree, but you should be clear in your application about where youâre based and what working hours you would expect to keep.

â Our Hiring Process

  • Meet with Imogen (Talent/People Ops): 25-30m video call. Imogen will tell you a bit more about what itâs like to be on Team Guru. Please come prepared with any questions about our ways of working or team structure.
  • Meet with Dana (Customer Support): 60m video call. Dana will talk with you about your previous support experience, your communication style, your technical troubleshooting skills, and any experience you have with billing or invoice-related enquiries.
  • Meet with Percy (cofounder): 30m video call. This will follow a typical interview format with an opportunity for you to ask questions and learn more about the role.
  • Reference checks
  • Offer! â¨

â­ï¸ What Weâre Offering

  • A great salary
  • Stock options
  • Work from anywhere you like - co-working space will be provided if necessary
  • 30 days paid holiday + Dec 24 - Jan 1 company holiday
  • Birthday off + house move day off
  • Flexible hours
  • Annual training and conference allowance - Â£3,000
  • A home office equipment contribution upon joining (then every 3 years) - Â£1,000
  • Budget to visit local or international colleagues
  • Monthly health & wellbeing contribution - to be used as you see fit - Â£100

jobs.description:
Meille autonasentajaksi?

Haemme vakituiseen työsuhteeseen ammattitaitoista ja ahkeraa autonasentajaa, jolla on hyvä työasenne. Pystyt huoltamaan ja korjaamaan itsenäisesti henkilö- ja pakettiautoja. Sinulta onnistuu vianhaku, diagnosointi sekä haastavammatkin huolto- ja korjaustyöt.

Mitä toivomme hakijalta?

- autoalan koulutusta ja vähintään 1 vuoden työkokemusta alalta
- omatoimisuutta, huolellisuutta sekä tehokasta otetta työntekoon
- hyviä vuorovaikutustaitoja ja joustavuutta
- Autofutur-ohjelmiston käyttökokemus on eduksi

Mitä tarjoamme sinulle?

- monipuolisen työn, jossa pääset kehittämään ammattitaitoasi
- mukavan ja rennon työporukan, jossa on helppo pyytää työkaverilta tarvittaessa apua
- kilpailukykyisen ja oikeudenmukaisen palkan (2 550 - 3000 euroa/kk)
- säännöllisen työajan ma-pe klo 8.00-16.30
- kattavan tapaturmavakuutuksen koskien myös vapaa-aikana sattuvia vahinkoja
- mahdollisuuden halutessasi korjata ja fiksata omia autojasi tiloissamme viikonloppuisin

Lähetä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian!

Lähetä vapaamuotoinen hakemuksesi, jossa kerrot itsestäsi sekä aiemmasta työkokemuksestasi ja osaamisestasi. Lähetäthän hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian, sillä työt alkavat sopimuksen mukaan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

Lisätietoja tehtävästä antaa toimitusjohtaja Eero Eloranta p. 045 872 3934, sähköposti: eero.eloranta@tampereenautolasipalvelu.fi.

Keitä me olemme?

Olemme paikallinen perheyritys. Meille on tärkeintä työntekijöidemme hyvä viihtyvyys sekä erinomainen asiakaspalvelu laadukkaan työnjäljen lisäksi. Kuulumme valtakunnallisiin Autofit ja First Stop -ketjuihin, jotka takaavat mahdollisuudet esim. lisäkoulutuksiin työntekijöiden oman kiinnostuksen mukaan. Työllistämme tällä hetkellä neljä autonasentajaa, kaksi työnjohtajaa ja kaksi tuulilasiasentajaa. Yrityksen virallinen nimi on Tampereen Autolasipalvelu Oy, joka on toiminut jo vuodesta 1993 alkaen. Yrittäjinä ovat toimineet vuodesta 2011 alkaen ylöjärveläiset Eero ja Katri Eloranta.
