jobs.title: Job i Barcelona - Vil du videre fra Telemarketing og arbejde som Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?
jobs.description:
Vi søger en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist til vores internationale kontor i Barcelona. 

Har du arbejdet med salg eller Telemarketing i mere end et år, og er du klar til det næste skridt i den karriere? Eller brænder du for digital markedsføring og er du kreativ og vil gerne blive certificeret rådgiver der kan hjælpe andre med at lave succesfulde digitale kampagner? Hvis du er teknisk, kreativ og udadvendt og kan få tingene gjort i et tempofyldt, hurtigt skiftende miljø, har vi måske det perfekte job til dig!

Hvad laver en Google Ads Sales and Onboarding Specialist?

Du arbejder tæt sammen med ambitiøse virksomheder, der skal onboardes til digital vækst. Du rådgiver om Pay-Per-Click-kampagner (PPC), identificerer vækstmuligheder og skaber langsigtet værdi. Med forståelse for markedsdynamik og strategisk tænkning styrker du system integrering og kundeloyalitet — med effekt og relation i centrum.

Skaber vækst og digitale resultater

Du udvikler og optimerer kampagner, opsøger kunder via telefon og video, og identificerer løsninger, der matcher deres unikke behov. Du opbygger tillid og sikrer, at dine kunder får det fulde udbytte af deres digitale investeringer — både på kort og lang sigt.

Styrker kunderejser og partnerskaber

Du håndterer et højt volumen af kunder og rådgiver i komplekse kontekster. Du arbejder med strategier, der øger ROI og kampagnespend, og bistår med integration på tværs af platforme. Du bruger AI-værktøjer i din dagligdag og kommunikerer effektivt med forskellige interessenter — altid med respekt for datasikkerhed og GDPR.

Du bliver en del af et globalt team i hjertet af Barcelona, hvor teknologi og marketing mødes. 

Engelsktalende arbejdsmiljø er standard, og du får fuldt betalt oplæring, personlige coaches og adgang til certificeringer. Stillingen åbner døre til intern karriereudvikling og spændende projekter inden for digital markedsføring.

Dit ansvar:

  • Onboarding af kunder og opbygning af langsigtede relationer over telefon og videomøder

  • Udvikling af performance-drevne PPC-strategier

  • Proaktivt salg og kampagneoptimering

  • Opdatering og vedligeholdelse af kundedata

  • Rådgivning om digital positionering og annoncering

  • Forståelse for ROI og integration med andre platforme

  • Support og strategisk planlægning på nordisk niveau

Dine kvalifikationer:

  • Dansk og engelsk på minimum C1

  • Bachelorgrad eller relevant erfaring i marketing/salg/Telemarketing

  • Kendskab til Google Ads, CRM og datastyring

  • Proaktiv og strategisk tilgang til kundeopgaver

  • Evne til at navigere i komplekse stakeholder-miljøer

  • Passion for digital markedsføring og forretningsudvikling

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav — hvis rollen vækker din interesse, opfordrer vi dig stadig til at søge!

Benefits:

  • Fast fuldtidsstilling (39 timer/uge) med hybridmodel i Barcelona

  • Flyttepakke med flybillet og indkvartering i privat studie

  • Privat sygeforsikring og sundhedsfokus

  • Bonus for at anbefale en ven

  • Certificeringer og løbende kompetenceudvikling

  • Arbejdsmiljø med sociale aktiviteter og teambuilding

  • Kontor med havudsigt i World Trade Center, Barcelona

Hvad får du ud af at tage afsted?

Barcelona byder på solrige dage, strandliv og kreativ energi. Her kan du nyde tapas ved havet, arbejde med banebrydende teknologi og udvikle dig både personligt og professionelt i et byliv, der aldrig står stille. Derudover får du:

  • Lavere leveomkostninger end Danmark

  • Kunst, musik, tech og kultur i dynamisk samspil

  • Fokus på trivsel og diversitet

  • Internationale brands og karrieremuligheder

  • Åben og inkluderende atmosfære

Professionel udvikling:

  • Indsigt i digital markedsføring og internationale arbejdskulturer

  • Specialiseret viden om Google Ads og online strategi

  • Fuld oplæring og adgang til certificeringer

  • Karriereveje inden for tech, salg og rådgivning

  • Mulighed for at arbejde med kunder fra hele Europa

Personlig vækst og karriere:

Forestil dig at starte dagen med café con leche, arbejde med digitale strategier under palmerne og slutte af med live-musik ved stranden. Hos TP får du ikke bare et job — du får muligheden for at bygge en karriere, forme fremtiden og leve livet fuldt ud.

Barcelona er stedet, hvor arbejde og livskvalitet går op i en højere enhed.

jobs.title: Service Locator
jobs.description:
Building a sustainable tomorrow

KierBAM are a Joint Venture (JV) partnership between Kier and BAM UK & Ireland - BAM UK & Ireland's infrastructure segment is currently delivering the redevelopment project at a Royal Navy site located in Plymouth and we are seeking an experienced Service Locator.


The Service Locator will carry out the physical check and survey of all of the underground services within the area that is being investigated, the Service Locator will have the following responsibilities. You will use various geophysical techniques to locate the service, once they have been found, the services will be marked/spray painted onto the ground in the appropriate colour, defining the type and depth of the service. You will also maintain the contents of the permits on site, making sure the workforce remains compliant with conditions and processes outlined within the permits.

Due to the site being a high-security military naval base, additional security checks will be required a BPSS level of security clearance is necessary. These checks can take up to 8 weeks to process. Only candidates holding EU, NATO, 5 Eyes, or MISWG member passports and who have been UK residents for the last 5 years can be considered for this role.

Your team
  • Location: Devonport Dockyard, Plymouth
  • Contract: Permanent, 42.5 hours a week
Making Possible

In this role as Service Locator, you will be working in a live MOD facility. Your day-to-day tasks will include:

  • Authorise Permit to Break Surface
  • Ensure compliance with and enforcement of the project permit for the Break Ground procedure
  • Review method statements tailored to specific tasks
  • Mark all services within the work boundaries to protect colour standards
  • Provide teams with an overview of the services within their designated work boundaries and discuss methods for working around those affected services.
  • Implement an 8-point checklist during work gang briefings
  • Enforce any designated exclusion zones surrounding affected services
  • Obtain the required signatures for permit approval from the works team and the Project Engineer
  • Notify the BOSC of any discrepancies in the records
  • Investigate uncharted services as directed by the BOSC
  • Inform the BOSC of any services that have been removed from the work area, ensuring the service drawings are updated accordingly
  • Attach the most current SMD CAD drawing to the permit-to-dig
  • Ensure that no work gang operates under an expired permit for breaking ground or in an area lacking a permit.
  • Maintain service markings for the duration of the permit as well as incremental scans as excavations progress
  • This profile is not exhaustive. From time to time, you may be required by the Company to perform other tasks, which are not included in the above description, but are within your capabilities and, where necessary, training, and full support will be given
What do you bring to the role?

Essential:

  • We are seeking a candidate who can handle multiple tasks, show flexibility, and become a key contributor to our team
  • A CSCS Card is required (this must be obtained before commencing work)
  • Familiarity with Electromagnetic location and ground penetrating radar is essential
  • A solid understanding of industry practices and standards related to utility detection, including PAS 128 and TSA, is important
  • Candidates should have a proficient working knowledge of surveying equipment, such as GPR, CAT, and Genny utility detection tools
  • The ability to collaborate and communicate effectively within a team and interact with clients on-site is required
  • Knowledge of HSG-47 and GS-6

Desirable

  • Experience in the Nuclear environment would be considered beneficial
  • QCF Level 3 or Level 5 certification in utility mapping is preferred
  • Applicants should possess a minimum of 2-3 years of utility surveying experience
Whats in it for you?
  • Competitive salary
  • A wide range of family-friendly policies
  • Company car/car allowance/travel allowance
  • 8 % matched pension contributions
  • Private healthcare
  • Life assurance
  • 26 days holiday
  • 2 wellbeing days
  • 1 volunteering day
  • Personal and professional development
About BAM

Building a sustainable tomorrow. Thats our mission and our promise at BAM. Its how we engineer vital infrastructure and construct high-quality buildings as one of the largest construction companies in Europe.

We strive to create an environment where everybody feels welcome and valued. Were on an exciting journey to employ the best talent to join us regardless of social background, race, colour, religion, national or ethnic origin, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability or other characteristics.

jobs.title: Údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů, Obsluha strojů a zařízení na výrobu a zpracování papíru
jobs.description:
Společnost EKOBAL ROŽNOV s.r.o. hledá údržbáře - mechanika - seřizovače stáčecích kelímkovacích strojů
Jsme stabilní a rostoucí výrobní společnost s dlouholetou tradicí na trhu. Zakládáme si na kvalitě našich produktů a efektivitě výrobních procesů. Přidejte se k týmu, který udržuje naše klíčové výrobní linky v chodu.
Jsi zručný mechanik s technickým myšlením a složité stroje ti nejsou cizí? Máte rád, když věci šlapou jako hodinky a umíte je rychle najít a opravit, když se něco zadrhne? Pak hledáme přesně Vás!

Co bude Vaše hlavní náplň práce?
•    Preventivní a operativní údržba a opravy poloautomatizovaných kelímkvacích strojů (mechanická, pneumatická, elektrická část). Budete mozek a ruce našich poloautomatických kelímkovacích stroje.
•    Přestavba a seřizování kelímkovacích strojů při přechodu na jiný typ a velikost kelímku. Preciznost je klíč.
•    Diagnostika a odstraňování závad kelímkovacích strojů a  periférních zařízení. Vedení evidence oprav a údržby v SW Klid
•    Zajištění plynulého chodu výroby a minimalizace prostojů. Starat se o to, aby naše stroje jely nonstop a bez poruch (servis, mazání, kontrola – prostě prevence).
•    Spolupráce s oddělením výroby, technologie a kvality. Žádné stereotypy, každý den je jiný problém k vyřešení!
•    Drobné zámečnické práce a práce s nástroji. Výběr a udržování pohotovostního skladu náhradních dílů. Úzká spolupráce s externími firmami při zajišťování speciálních dílů a dalších prací.
Co od Vás očekáváme?
•    Minimálně SŠ/SOU v oboru mechanik, provozní zámečník, elektrikář, mechatronik nebo jiném relevantním technickém oboru.
•    Praxe na obdobné pozici (údržba/seřizování výrobních nebo balicích linek) je velkou výhodou a Vaše eso v rukávu.
•    Znalost elektrotechniky, mechaniky, pneumatiky/hydrauliky.
•    Platná vyhláška 50/1978 Sb.
•    Schopnost číst technickou dokumentaci a výkresy.
•    Samostatnost, spolehlivost a ochota pracovat ve směnném provozu.
Co Vám nabízíme?
•    Stabilní zaměstnání na hlavní pracovní poměr ve firmě s pevnou pozicí na trhu.
•    Motivační finanční ohodnocení a systém prémií dle dosažených výsledků
•    4 týdny dovolené a zaměstnanecké benefity (stravenkový paušál/ příspěvek na penzijní připojištění, firemní akce).
•    Možnost profesního rozvoje a odborných školení.
•    Moderní pracovní prostředí a technické vybavení.

jobs.title: Chief Operating Officer
jobs.description:
Description

The Chief Operating Officer (COO) is the senior operational leader of U.S. Hunger, responsible for translating enterprise strategy into daily execution. This role owns P&L performance across all business lines â Full Cart, Hunger Projects, and the Data/Intelligence engine â ensuring the organization's earned-income model (97%+ of total revenue) operates with precision, accountability, and scalability.

The COO must bring the instincts of an entrepreneur and the discipline of a corporate operator: connecting dots others miss, asking tough questions that drive clarity, and building the systems that allow talented leaders to perform at their highest level. Operational excellence and mission-aligned impact are not in tension here â they are the same thing.

Enterprise Operations & P&L Execution

  • Own P&L execution across all business lines â each engine must meet its margin, revenue, and impact targets.
  • Establish and drive the operating cadence â monthly reviews, quarterly business performance reporting, and clear accountability across departments.
  • Make resource allocation decisions across competing priorities â deploying people, capital, and attention against the highest-value opportunities.
  • Present operational performance, capacity, and growth execution to the Board of Directors.
  • Partner with the CEO on scenario planning, structural growth strategies, and enterprise-wide decision-making.

Program Leadership â Full Cart & Hunger Projects

  • Provide executive oversight of Full Cart and Hunger Projects â ensuring delivery excellence, measurable outcomes, and scalability.
  • Partner with program directors to evaluate, evolve, and scale programs in response to partner needs, market opportunities, and operational realities.
  • Drive integration between program design, data infrastructure, and client-facing delivery â ensuring mission impact and revenue execution are operationally connected.
  • Oversee supply chain and logistics operations to ensure consistent, high-quality program delivery at scale.

Revenue Growth & Partner Execution

  • Own enterprise revenue execution across health plan partnerships, corporate engagement, and strategic growth opportunities â ensuring acquisition and retention targets are consistently met.
  • Drive strategies that deepen existing partner relationships and expand engagement across multiple service lines, maximizing long-term value and organizational sustainability.
  • Represent U.S. Hunger externally with payors, partners, and stakeholders â translating operational insight into compelling value propositions that differentiate USH in the market.
  • Leverage buyer-side CSR experience and existing relationships across the corporate social impact and food access ecosystem to accelerate partner acquisition and deepen engagement.

Cross-Functional Alignment & Executive Leadership

  • Partner with the Chief Technology Officer to define business requirements, program design priorities, and operational needs that shape the technology and data roadmap â ensuring platform delivery enables execution across all business lines.
  • Manage the VP of Finance & Enterprise KPIs and VP of People & Culture â two executives who maintain direct visibility to the CEO through their seat at the executive table â ensuring fiscal discipline, enterprise analytics, and workforce strategy are aligned with operational goals.
  • Actively contribute to organizational governance, strategy, and enterprise-wide decision-making as the CEO's primary operational counterpart.

Team Leadership & Development

  • Build, lead, and develop a high-performing operational leadership team â setting clear expectations, driving accountability, and coaching leaders who are growing into executive-level roles.
  • Develop performance metrics and accountability systems that connect individual and team outcomes to enterprise financial and impact objectives.
  • Promote a culture of rigorous inquiry, collaboration, and continuous improvement â where leaders are expected to think critically, challenge assumptions, and own their outcomes.
  • Foster an environment where staff understand both the business drivers of USH's earned-income model and the transformative impact of their work on the communities served.

These essential job functions are not to be construed as a complete statement of all duties performed. Employees will be required to perform other duties as required.

Requirements

  • 10+ years of progressive leadership in operations, business management, or revenue execution â with direct P&L ownership.
  • Experience building, running, or scaling a business â including sales growth, client retention, and financial performance accountability.
  • Proven ability to lead and develop directors and VPs â coaching strong operators into executive-level leaders while holding them accountable to outcomes.
  • Demonstrated pattern of connecting dots across functions â seeing how operational, financial, people, and program decisions impact each other.
  • Experience at the board level â presenting performance, defending strategy, and engaging C-suite stakeholders directly.
  • Experience in mission-driven, earned-income environments where market discipline and social impact must coexist.
  • Strong communication across corporate, nonprofit, healthcare, and community sectors â direct, polished, and confident.
  • High emotional intelligence, with the courage to ask tough questions, the polish to challenge constructively, and the vision to see what's possible before it's obvious.
  • Background check is required for this role

Essential Physical Skills

  • Repetitive finger motion as used in computer use.
  • Extensive work with computer screens
  • Everyday requirements of bending, grabbing, holding, and lifting light objects
  • Work on Hunger Projects requires heavy lifting (up to 50 lbs), moving objects, pushing, and pulling, bending and kneeling
  • Up to 50% travel time

jobs.title: Human Resources Coordinator
jobs.description:
Job Snapshot

Location: Remote - California (San Diego or Southern California Preferred)

Employment Type: Full-Time

Compensation: $28-30 per hour

Schedule: Full-Time

Work Environment: Remote

Reports To: Human Resources Manager

About Pacific Health Group

At Pacific Health Group, we care deeply about the people and communities we serve. We meet individuals with kindness, respect, and understandingâlistening first, honoring each person's journey, and offering support without judgment.

Through compassionate, person-centered healthcare, behavioral health services, and social supports, we walk alongside people as they work toward healing, stability, and a healthier, more hopeful life.

Our Core Values

  • Speak with integrityâclear, respectful, and honest in every interaction
  • Embrace innovation, trying new ideas, learning fast, and improving care.
  • Own our roles, staying accountable for outcomes and documenting accurately
  • Build genuine connections with members, families, and teammates through empathy and cultural sensitivity
  • Lead with trust by being consistent, transparent, and following through
  • Celebrate wins together, recognizing individual and team achievements
  • Collaborate with purpose, partnering across departments and with community providers to solve problems
  • Ask for support and offer support, because thriving together is how we serve our members best

Role Overview & Impact

The Human Resources Coordinator provides administrative and operational support across the Human Resources department. This entry-level position supports onboarding, employee records, HR system transactions, recruitment coordination, employee communications, and general HR department operations.

The HR Coordinator serves as an initial point of contact for routine employee and applicant questions and ensures that requests are directed to the appropriate HR team member. The successful candidate will be highly organized, service-oriented, comfortable using technology, and committed to maintaining the confidentiality and accuracy of employee information.

Key Responsibilities

Core Responsibilities

Recruitment & Talent Coordination

  • Support candidate communications using approved templates
  • Track candidate status and documentation in the applicant tracking system
  • Assist with pre-employment requirements
  • Maintain accurate recruiting records and candidate files
  • Support job fairs, community outreach, internship activities, and recruiting events
  • Provide a professional, timely, and welcoming candidate experience

Onboarding & Offboarding

  • Coordinate pre-employment and onboarding activities after an offer has been accepted
  • Send new-hire forms, instructions, orientation schedules, and required notices
  • Track completion of pre-employment requirements, background checks, employment documents, and onboarding tasks
  • Coordinate the timely completion and retention of Form I-9 documentation in accordance with established procedures
  • Coordinate with hiring managers, Payroll, Information Technology, Learning and Development, and other departments to support new-hire readiness
  • Confirm that new employees receive appropriate system access, equipment information, schedules, and introductory materials
  • Support new-hire orientation logistics and attendance tracking
  • Follow up on incomplete forms or onboarding requirements
  • Initiate separation checklists after receiving appropriate authorization
  • Schedule exit interviews or distribute exit questionnaires

HR Compliance & Documentation

  • Assist with personnel-file, I-9, benefits, training, and HR data audits
  • Track required documents, acknowledgments, certifications, and renewal dates
  • Assist with preparing records for internal and external audits
  • Follow established HR policies, procedures, record-retention requirements, and confidentiality standards
  • Escalate incomplete, inconsistent, or potentially noncompliant documentation
  • Maintain current versions of approved HR forms, templates, notices, and resources
  • Support the distribution and tracking of required employee notices

Benefits & Employee Support

  • Route plan interpretation and eligibility questions to the HR Generalist or appropriate team member
  • Support annual Open Enrollment communications, scheduling, and administrative preparation
  • Assist with routine employee reminders and documentation follow-up
  • Maintain confidentiality of medical and benefits information
  • Support benefits and leave audits as requested

HR Operations & Administrative Support

  • Provide general administrative support for the HR team, including scheduling meetings, tracking training completion, and preparing reports
  • Assist with HR initiatives such as employee engagement events, training programs, and performance review cycles
  • Maintain organized HR documentation and assist with reporting needs as requested by leadership

Success Measures

  • Accurate and timely recruitment coordination and onboarding completion
  • Compliance with California labor laws and HR documentation standards
  • High responsiveness and professionalism in employee communication
  • Well-maintained, audit-ready personnel records
  • Efficient support of HR initiatives and department operations

Skills That Set You Apart

Required Qualifications

  • High school diploma or equivalent required
  • One year of administrative, customer service, office, recruiting, payroll, healthcare, or Human Resources support experience preferred
  • An associate degree, bachelor's degree, Human Resources coursework, internship, or relevant professional training may substitute for some experience
  • Entry-level candidates with strong administrative and customer-service capabilities are encouraged to apply
  • High level of professionalism, discretion, and ability to handle confidential information
  • Proficiency in Google Workspace (Docs, Sheets, Drive, Slides)
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a remote team

Benefits

Time Off & Leave

  • Paid Time Off
  • Holidays
  • Volunteer time
  • Bereavement

Health & Wellness

  • Medical coverage
  • FSAs or other wellness benefits
  • Disability and EAP

Financial & Professional

  • 401(k)
  • Stipends
  • Professional development

Culture & Perks

  • Employee discounts
  • Team events
  • Growth opportunities

Equal Opportunity Employer

Pacific Health Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where all individuals are treated with dignity and respect. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, and related medical conditions), gender, gender identity or gender expression, sexual orientation, national origin or ancestry, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, medical condition (including cancer and genetic characteristics), age (40 and over), marital status, military or veteran status, genetic information, or status as a victim of domestic violence, assault, or stalking. We value diversity in all forms and encourage individuals from historically underrepresented communities to apply.

Job Application & Offer Disclaimer

Pacific Health Group is committed to maintaining a transparent, lawful, and secure hiring process in compliance with California labor laws and employment standards. Employment offers are contingent upon meeting role qualifications and successfully completing all required recruitment steps, which may include:

  • Submission of an internal application
  • Recruiter pre-screen
  • Skills assessment if applicable
  • Final interview with hiring leadership
  • Formal verbal offer from authorized hiring representatives

Important Notice: Any communication claiming to represent Pacific Health Group that bypasses this process is not authorized.

AI & Human Interaction in Recruitment

Pacific Health Group uses AI tools to assist with resume matching based on qualifications, skills, and location. All qualified applications are reviewed by our recruiting and HR team to ensure fair, equitable, and human-centered hiring decisions.

jobs.title: Senior Credit Structurer - Large Corporates (M/F)
jobs.description:
Description de tâches:

Founded in 1856, Banque Internationale à Luxembourg is the oldest multi-business bank in the Grand Duchy. From its foundation, the BIL has always played an active role in the development of the Luxembourg economy. It currently operates in retail, private and corporate banking, as well as on major capital markets. Employing more than 2 000 people, BIL is present in the financial hotspots that are Luxembourg, Switzerland, and China.

As a major player in Luxembourg's finance industry and as a signatory of the UN Principles of Responsible Banking, BIL is committed to handing over a responsible and sustainable bank to future generations.

Your next challenge:

The Senior Credit Structurer is responsible for assessing and evaluating the feasibility of credit request and providing structuring solutions within acceptable credit /risk parameters, while developing the Bank's lending portfolio in line with the Bank's strategy and risk appetite

Your will:

• Analyze complex credit requests (Large Corporates) and develop solutions within acceptable credit/risk parameters.
• Provide the credit rating for requests.
• Ensure credit structuring/granting is aligned with Bank's Risk appetite, limits, Policy, and Procedures.
• Within the Delegation Authority Framework, decide on credit files.
• Responsible for business development and revenues growth remaining within Bank's Risk Appetite.
• Play a key role in credit approval process and follow up on the implementation of credit files in line with the decision.
• Check the data quality of the credit request (in the systems and in the credit sheet).
• Follow up of the annual revision of customers (GEC) and ratings

Your skills:

• Credit & Financial Instruments expertise (T24 / Globe / Internal Rating Tools / RAROC application)
• Minimum 5 years of experience in a similar position
• Fluent in English and French
• Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills to identify potential risks, assess their impact, and recommend appropriate risk mitigation measures.
• Working either in the Front Office or in credit risk management within the banking industry.
• Expertise in : Credit, Legal, analytical skills, decision taking, Relationship Management
• A bachelor's or master's degree in finance or a related field and / or equivalent professional experience (minimum 2 years)
• Good understanding of credit activities.
• Good understanding of the corporates segment (SME Lux, Large Corp)
• Ability to maintain a balance between marketing and credit risk roles.
• Ability to identify credit opportunities and develop innovative solutions.
• Ability to interact with clients

BIL offers a broad range of challenging projects and a huge choice of career paths. We will assist you in finding the one that best meets your skills and expectations. Your personal development is our priority and we greatly encourage you to dive into different business areas for the broadest possible experience.
BIL is firmly of the opinion that diversity & inclusion contribute towards increasing the collective performance of the Bank. We are committed to creating a culture of inclusion that encourages individual development with equal opportunities for all.

NB: The selected candidate will be asked to provide an extract from the criminal record (no.3) as evidence of integrity and justified with regard to the specific needs of the position to be filled.

jobs.title: Actuarial Associate (m/f)
jobs.description:
Actuarial Associate
Luxembourg

Line of Service Assurance
Industry/Sector Not Applicable
Specialism Assurance
Management Level Associate
Job Description & Summary

Meet your future team

You will join PwC Luxembourg's Actuarial Services team, part of our broader advisory practice supporting insurance and reinsurance clients. You will work closely with actuaries, risk specialists and accountants on cross functional projects in a collaborative, hands on environment.

What your role will look like

As an Associate, you contribute to actuarial and regulatory projects that help insurers navigate complex requirements and make informed decisions. Your work supports both client delivery and internal collaboration, with exposure to a wide range of insurance topics and project types.

• Contribute to Solvency II assignments by supporting quantitative analyses, calculations and monitoring activities that inform risk and capital decisions
• Analyse regulatory and accounting frameworks (Solvency II, IFRS, Lux GAAP) and support the recalculation of technical provisions and experience studies
• Support multi disciplinary projects such as M&A and due diligence engagements, risk and capital modelling, IFRS 17 implementation and actuarial outsourcing
• Participate in insurance and reinsurance set up or restructuring projects, including feasibility studies and portfolio transfers
• Collaborate with senior team members to translate technical outputs into clear insights for clients and internal stakeholders
Your growth and opportunities
You will progressively take ownership of workstreams while expanding your technical actuarial and regulatory expertise. The role offers broad exposure to insurance advisory topics and close coaching from experienced professionals, enabling you to grow in responsibility and confidence over time.

The skills you bring

• University degree with a specialisation in actuarial science, mathematics, statistics or quantitative finance
• Initial professional experience in actuarial or insurance related work (internships or full time)
• Modelling skills with R or Python at a working knowledge level
• Solid understanding of insurance concepts and interest in regulatory and accounting topics
• English: fluent (C1)

Ways of working

• Analyse information logically and structure quantitative outputs to support sound conclusions
• Demonstrate curiosity and a willingness to continuously learn across actuarial, regulatory and insurance topics
• Work collaboratively with colleagues from different disciplines to deliver shared outcomes
• You act with integrity, handle confidential information with care, and uphold high ethical standards in every situation

Take your next step

Step into a role where your analytical skills contribute to meaningful client outcomes and your development is supported from day one. Build your actuarial expertise, work alongside experienced professionals, and help shape solutions in a changing insurance landscape. Grow here. Go further.

PwC Luxembourg (www.pwc.lu) is the largest professional services firm in Luxembourg with over 3,600 people employed from 90 different countries. PwC Luxembourg provides audit, tax and advisory services including management consulting, transaction, financing and regulatory advice. The firm provides advice to a wide variety of clients from local and middle market entrepreneurs to large multinational companies operating from Luxembourg and the Greater Region. The firm supports its clients in creating the value they are looking for by contributing to the smooth operation of the capital markets and providing advice through an industry-focused approach.

At PwC, we help clients build trust and reinvent so they can turn complexity into competitive advantage. We're a tech-forward, people-empowered network with more than 364,000 people in 136 countries and 137 territories. Across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals and consulting, we help clients build, accelerate, and sustain momentum. Find out more at www.pwc.com and www.pwc.lu.

jobs.title: KONOBAR/ICA
jobs.description: Café Allegri - SLOBOŠTINA Posjedujemo ugostiteljske objekte diljem Hrvatske, a koji su pozicionirani u sklopu supermarketa i radnim vremenom prilagođeni istima, te su ugodno i toplo uređeni. Velika pozornost pridaje se kvaliteti usluge i stručnosti osoblja s naglaskom na srdačnost! Visoku razinu kvalitete održavamo kontinuiranim ulaganjem u naše djelatnike, prostor i ponudu, što nam se višestruko vraća kroz zadovoljne djelatnike i stalne goste. Ukoliko i Vi želite postati dio našeg tima od 150 zadovoljnih djelatnika, javite se na naš natječaj! Ako i nemate radnog iskustva te bi Vam ovo bilo prvo zaposlenje, rado ćemo Vas uzeti u obzir kao potencijalnog kandidata, te Vam pomoći u stjecanju iskustva i usvajanju novih znanja i vještina! Za dodatne informacije o našoj ponudi i uvjetima rada možete se javiti na broj 099 168 5677 ili posao@celka.hr. Naš tim proširujemo osobom koja ima želju za učenjem i kontinuiranim usavršavanjem na radnom mjestu: Ugostiteljski djelatnik (m/ž) Što ćete raditi? - posluživati goste sukladno propisanim pravilima i standardima - održavati čistoću i urednost radnog prostora i opreme - osiguravati primjenu propisanih i zadanih standarda u ugostiteljstvu - predstavljati organizaciju u najboljem svjetlu te izgrađivati prijateljske odnose sa gostima i kolegama Što nudimo? - stimulativne uvjete - rad u uspješnoj i stabilnoj tvrtki - dinamičnu i ugodnu radnu atmosferu

jobs.title: Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) (Medizinphysiker/in)
jobs.description:
Wollen Sie die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens mitgestalten? Wir bei Siemens Healthineers setzen auf Menschen, die ihre Energie und Leidenschaft diesem Ziel widmen – das sagt schon unser Unternehmensname. Siemens Healthineers steht für Pioniergeist unserer Mitarbeitenden, gepaart mit unserer langen Tradition als weltweit führender Technologiekonzern in der stets dynamischen Gesundheitsbranche.
Wir bieten ein flexibles und dynamisches Umfeld voller Gelegenheiten, über sich hinaus zu wachsen, um sich persönlich und beruflich weiterzuentwickeln. Klingt das interessant für Sie?

Dann werden Sie Teil unseres globalen Teams als Project Radioprotection Spezialist*in (w/m/d) und unterstützen Sie uns dabei, die Zukunft der Präzisionstheranostik aktiv mitzugestalten und gleichzeitig die Patientenversorgung weiter voranzubringen. Diese Position richtet sich an ambitionierte Fachkräfte, die den nächsten Schritt in ihrer Karriere gehen möchten. Sie bietet die Möglichkeit, Strahlenschutzaktivitäten über alle Projektphasen hinweg zu verantworten – von der Standortplanung über Genehmigungsverfahren und Abschirmungskonzepte bis hin zu regulatorischer Compliance und Projektumsetzung für neue und bestehende radiopharmazeutische Einrichtungen.

Wählen Sie den besten Ort für Ihre Arbeit - im Rahmen dieser Stelle ist es in Abstimmung mit Ihrer Führungskraft möglich, bis zu einem durchschnittlichen Volumen von 60% der jeweiligen Arbeitszeit mobil (innerhalb Deutschlands) zu arbeiten.
Noch mehr Flexibilität? Mobiles Arbeiten aus dem Ausland ist unter bestimmten Voraussetzungen und in ausgewählten Ländern für bis zu 30 Tage im Jahr möglich.

Diese Position kann an den Standorten Erlangen (Deutschland), Venafro (Italien) oder Barcelona (Spanien) besetzt werden.

Ihre Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten:

- In enger, bereichsübergreifender Zusammenarbeit begleiten Sie Projekte von der Standortkonzeption bis zur Inbetriebnahme und steuern die fachliche Entwicklung sämtlicher relevanter Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Prozesse und ‑Verfahren.- Sie sind verantwortlich für die Erstellung, Einreichung und fortlaufende Betreuung aller Genehmigungsunterlagen für den Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen, einschließlich der erforderlichen behördlichen Korrespondenz.- Sie entwickeln Abschirmungskonzepte für neue Anlagen, neue Anwendungen sowie neue Zyklotron‑Installationen.- Sie führen Abschirmungsüberprüfungen sowie verifizierende und bestätigende Messungen durch.- Sie leisten Vor‑Ort‑Unterstützung, um die korrekte Umsetzung der erforderlichen Strahlenschutz‑ und EHS‑Programme für einen erfolgreichen Anlagenbetrieb sicherzustellen.- Sie prüfen und reichen sämtliche erforderlichen Unterlagen für Stilllegungen ein.- Sie unterstützen Vor‑Ort als verantwortliche*r Lizenznehmer‑Stakeholder, um eine erfolgreiche Durchführung von Stilllegungsaktivitäten zu gewährleisten.- Sie steuern Projekte und stellen sicher, dass alle relevanten Fristen eingehalten werden.- Sie begleiten Standorte bei behördlichen Inspektionen, um Genehmigungen zu sichern und aufrechtzuerhalten.

Mehr über dieses Geschäftsfeld erfahren Sie unter Radiopharma (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de-ch/molecular-imaging/radiopharma)

Ihre Qualifikationen und Erfahrung:

- Sie verfügen über einen Masterabschluss in Medizinischer Physik, radiologischer Gesundheit, Strahlenschutz, Ingenieurwesen, Chemie, Pharmazie oder einem verwandten naturwissenschaftlichen Studiengang.- Sie bringen fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit radioaktiven Stoffen sowie zu EHS‑regulatorischen Rahmenbedingungen mit, idealerweise aus einem regulierten industriellen oder pharmazeutischen Umfeld.- Sie verfügen über mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in radiochemischen oder radiopharmazeutischen Betrieben oder im angewandten Strahlenschutz mit offenen radioaktiven Stoffen.- Sie besitzen ein ausgeprägtes Verständnis für GMP‑regulierte Umgebungen und die damit verbundenen regulatorischen Anforderungen.- Sie haben nachweisliche Erfahrung im Projektmanagement und sind in der Lage, Zeitpläne, Prioritäten und bereichsübergreifende Liefergegenstände effektiv zu steuern.- Sie verfügen über sehr gute Anwenderkenntnisse der Microsoft‑365‑Tools.- Wir freuen uns auch über Bewerbende mit Bachelor-Abschluss oder abgeschlossener Berufsaus- und Weiterbildung in Verbindung mit zusätzlicher Berufserfahrung in diesem Bereich.

Ihr Profil und Ihre Fähigkeiten:

- Sie verfügen über ausgezeichnete schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und können technische sowie regulatorische Inhalte klar und verständlich für unterschiedliche Stakeholder aufbereiten.- Sie zeichnen sich durch eine kooperative, proaktive Arbeitsweise aus und arbeiten effektiv in bereichsübergreifenden sowie remote organisierten Teams – bei gleichzeitig hoher persönlicher Verantwortungsübernahme.- Sie fühlen sich in einem hybriden Arbeitsumfeld wohl.- Sie sprechen fließend Englisch; weitere Sprachkenntnisse sind ein großer Vorteil.- Sie sind flexibel und bereit, bis zu 30 % pro Jahr innerhalb Europas, des Vereinigten Königreichs und Indiens zu reisen.- Sie sind bereit, in Deutschland, Frankreich, Spanien oder Italien zu leben bzw. bei Bedarf umzuziehen.

Unser globales Team:
Siemens Healthineers ist ein weltweit führendes Medizintechnikunternehmen. Mit mehr als 74.000 engagierten Mitarbeitenden in über 70 Ländern gestalten wir die Zukunft des Gesundheitswesens. Jeden Tag profitieren etwa fünf Millionen Patient*innen weltweit von unseren innovativen Technologien und Dienstleistungen aus den Bereichen Diagnostik und therapeutische Bildgebung, Labordiagnostik und molekulare Medizin sowie von unseren digitalen Gesundheits- und Unternehmensdienstleistungen.

Unsere Kultur:
Unsere Unternehmenskultur schätzt verschiedene Blickwinkel, offene Diskussionen und den Willen, Konventionen in Frage zu stellen. Ständiger Wandel gehört zu unserem Arbeitsalltag. Wir wollen in unserer Branche Veränderungen vorantreiben, statt nur darauf zu reagieren. Deswegen laden wir Sie ein, sich neuen Herausforderungen zu stellen, eigene Ideen auszutesten und Erfolge zu feiern. Besuchen Sie auch unsere Karriere-Seite unter https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers (https://www.siemens-healthineers.com/de/careers)
Wir legen Wert auf Diversität und Chancengleichheit und freuen uns über Bewerbungen mit vielfältigen Hintergründen und insbesondere von Menschen mit Behinderung. #myabilityshs
Sie möchten mehr erfahren und erste Fragen gern persönlich klären – Sprechen Sie uns an: recruitinggersupport.func@siemens-healthineers.com. Kontaktperson dieser Stellenausschreibung ist SALIMA BOURHANI.
Wir nehmen den Schutz Ihrer Daten und die Einhaltung der DSGVO und anderer Datenschutzgesetze ernst. Deshalb bitten wir Sie, uns Ihren Lebenslauf nicht per E-Mail zu schicken. Bitte legen Sie ein Profil in unserer Talent Community an, um Ihren Lebenslauf hochzuladen. Daran erkennen wir, dass Sie an Karrieremöglichkeiten bei uns interessiert sind und können Sie zu relevanten Stellen benachrichtigen. Klicken Sie hier (https://jobs.siemens-healthineers.com/de_DE/searchjobs/RegistrationMethods) , um ein Profil anzulegen.

An alle Personalvermittlungsagenturen:
Die Personalbeschaffung bei Siemens Healthineers wird intern verwaltet. Externe Unterstützung ist nur dann gestattet, wenn eine qualifizierte Agentur einen formellen Vertrag mit uns abgeschlossen hat. Unaufgeforderte Bewerbungen und Empfehlungen von Kandidatenprofilen ohne aktuelle Lieferantenvereinbarung begründen keine Zustimmung und sind somit nicht gebührenpflichtig. Wir löschen und vernichten nicht angeforderte Informationen und empfehlen, von derartigen Praktiken abzusehen. Wir danken Ihnen für die Einhaltung unserer Richtlinien.

Siemens Healthineers Deutschland wurde mit dem Zertifikat Great Place to Work® ausgezeichnet.

jobs.title: PEÓN SALA BLANCA EN INDUSTRIA CÁRNICA
jobs.description:
Funciones y tareas: * Deshuesado y preparación: Las piezas (previamente deshuesadas y limpias de corteza y grasa amarillenta) se preparan en mesas de trabajo dentro de la zona estéril. * Loncheado (corte): Se realiza a máquina o por cortadores profesionales que separan y combinan distintas partes de la pieza (maza, babilla, punta y jarrete) para obtener platos equilibrados en sabor y grasa infiltrada. También se lonchean aquí embutidos como lomo, salchichón o chorizo. * Envasado al vación o en atmósfera modificada: Las lonchas se distribuyen en bandejas o platos y se envasan inmediatamente al vacío o con una inyección de gas inerte para evitar la oxidación y extender su vida útil hasta los 90 días. * Etiquetado y trazabilidad: Se registra cada lote. Cada sobre recibe una etiqueta con el tipo de ibérico (bellote, cebo, etc.), porcentaje racial, ingredientes, peso, lote, y fecha de caducidad, asegurando el cumplimientod e la normativa. Desinfección continua: Los cuchillos y herramientas se desinfectan de manera constante, pasando incluso por armarios de ozono para garantizar la esterilidad Perfil del candidato: * No se requiere formación previa, pero será valorable haber tenido experiencia en sala de loncheo. Condiciones laborales: * Contrato indefinido con periodo de prueba, a jornada completa. * Horario: De mañana y tarde * Salario: Según convenio. Observaciones: OFERTA ACOGIDA AL DECRETO 29/2024. Referencia al artículo UNICO, seis del decreto 124/2025, de 9 de septiembre, por el que se modifica el Decreto 29/2024, de 2 de abril, por el que se establecen las bases reguladoras de las subvenciones destinadas a fomentar el empleo estable y reducir los costes laborales de las empresas en la Comunidad Autónoma de Extremadura y se aprueba la primera convocatoria que recoge los requisitos específicos de cada programa. Nota: Si hay un número suficiente de candidatos/as se dará por finalizado el plazo de prese.

CONTROL DE COSTES (SEGUIMIENTO DE DESVIACIONES), CONTROL DE LA CALIDAD Y TRAZABILIDAD DE LOS DATOS, VALIDACIÓN DE IMPUTACIONES DE COSTES ENTRE DEPARTAMENTOS, SEGUIMIENTO DE PLANES DE ACCIÓN, ANÁLISIS DE CAUSAS DE DESVIACIONES DE COSTES, REPORTE DE AVANCE DE PLANES DE ACCIÓN A DIRECCIÓN, SEGUIMIENTO PRESUPUESTO (REAL VS PRESUPUESTO), ELABORACIÓN CUADRO DE MANDO DE LA COMPAÑÍA Y DEPARTAMENTOS, APOYO AL CIERRE CONTABLE-FINANCIERO (VERTIENTE ANALÍTICA), ACTUALIZACIÓN DE FORECASTS (TRIMESTRAL), ELABORACIÓN DEL PRESUPUESTO ANUAL Y MENSUAL (CONTABLE+ANALÍTICA), REVISIÓN Y MEJORA DE KPIS, DISEÑA, VALIDA Y SUPERVISA LOS ESCANDALLOS, ESTUDIOS AD HOC DE RENTABILIDAD DE PROYECTOS
¿QUÉ NECESITAMOS QUE APORTES?
-TITULACIÓN UNIVERSITARIA EN ECONÓMICAS, ADE O SIMILAR.
-EXPERIENCIA EN EL PUESTO COMO MÍNIMO TRES AÑOS EN AUDITORIA O DEPARTAMENTO DE CONTROLLING EN GRAN EMPRESA

Dine muligheder afhænger af, hvornår du vil afsted, og hvor længe du kan være væk. Mange virksomheder ansætter uden erfaring, mens andre har specifikke krav – det gennemgår vi sammen.

Er du gået i stå i din karriere i Danmark, måske er det tid til at du tager på det senere sabbatår i udlandet?

Vi hjælper danskere med at tage til udlandet for at finde ro, livskvalitet og en anderledes hverdag.

En af vores kandidater på 64 år, med 30 års ledererfaring havde altid drømt om at arbejde i Grækenland. Han troede, det var for sent – men fra i år sidder han i kundeservice med udsigt til Middelhavet og lever sin drøm. Hans historie viser, at det aldrig er for sent at tage springet, og at erfaring og livserfaring er en styrke, som virksomheder i Sydeuropa værdsætter højt.

Du får mulighed for at opleve en ny kultur, et mildere klima og en anderledes livsstil. Du kan bruge dine eksisterende kompetencer i kundeservice, rejsebranchen eller hospitality – eller prøve noget helt nyt. Mange virksomheder tilbyder oplæring, betalt ferie og interne udviklingsprogrammer, så du kan vokse i jobbet.

Du skal have en mindre opsparing med, da du ofte først får fuld løn efter en måned. Der kan være udgifter til depositum og husleje, som skal betales ved ankomst. Vi hjælper dig med at afklare kontraktforhold, boligmuligheder, sundhedsforsikring og opsigelsesvilkår. Det er vigtigt at tale med en professionel karrierecoach, så du får den rette sparring og undgår dyre fejl.

Dansktalende Kundeservicerådgiver for Audi.

Opstart den 20. august og 3. september - Med firmabolig. Vi mangler 4 medarbejdere, så du kan starte alene eller sammen med en af dine venner.

Er du klar til at tage springet og blive en del af en global digital organisation, der leverer support i verdensklasse?

Vi søger tekniske supportere til en spændende rolle med Audi – en af Europas mest ikoniske bilproducenter. Stillingen er 100 % remote fra Portugal, og du bliver en nøglespiller i et internationalt team, der sikrer en ekstraordinær kunderejse for Audi’s brugere.

Hvad laver en Kundeservicerådgiver?

Som Kundeservicerådgiver er du kundens direkte kontaktpunkt og hjælper med alt fra bilteknologi til digitale funktioner og serviceydelser. Du skaber en professionel oplevelse med struktur, empati og høj kvalitet i centrum.

Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Besvarelse af henvendelser via telefon, e-mail og chat

  • Fejlsøgning af tekniske problemer og vejledning i bilsystemer

  • Registrering af kundeinteraktioner i CRM-systemet

  • Opdatering på Audi’s produkter og politikker

  • Aktiv deltagelse i teamets deling af best practices

Dine kvalifikationer:

Vi leder efter dig, hvis du:

  • Taler og skriver dansk + har et minimum B2-niveau i engelsk

  • Har erfaring med kundeservice – gerne fra bilbranchen

  • Har teknisk flair og interesse for digitale løsninger

  • Kan kommunikere tydeligt, løse problemer og skabe tillid

Du behøver ikke opfylde alle krav – vi opfordrer dig stadig til at søge!

Vi tilbyder:

  • Professionelle udviklingsmuligheder

  • Privat sundhedsforsikring

  • Mulighed for karriereudvikling inden for kundeservice, salg og rejsebranchen

  • Adgang til et netværk af internationale kolleger og brancheeksperter

  • Erfaring med moderne digitale værktøjer til kundehåndtering

Dette er en unik mulighed for at kombinere en stærk erhvervserfaring med en fleksibel arbejdsmodel.

Fordele ved at arbejde fra Portugal

  • Mildt klima året rundt – Portugal har et behageligt middelhavsklima med varme somre og milde vintre, hvilket gør det til en attraktiv destination for dem, der ønsker at bo og arbejde i et solrigt land

  • Lavere leveomkostninger – Sammenlignet med mange andre europæiske lande er leveomkostningerne i Portugal relativt lave, hvilket giver mulighed for en høj livskvalitet til en rimelig pris.

  • Høj livskvalitet – Portugal er kendt for sin afslappede livsstil, gode mad og venlige lokalbefolkning, hvilket skaber et positivt og behageligt arbejdsmiljø.

  • Internationale karrieremuligheder – Arbejde i Portugal giver mulighed for at udvikle internationale færdigheder og samarbejde med kolleger fra forskellige nationaliteter, hvilket kan være en fordel for din fremtidige karriere.

  • God infrastruktur og moderne faciliteter – Portugal har en stærk digital infrastruktur, moderne kontorfaciliteter og gode transportmuligheder, hvilket sikrer en behagelig arbejdsdag.

  • Adgang til smukke strande og natur – Portugal tilbyder nem adgang til fantastiske strande, naturskønne områder og en rig kulturarv, som kan opleves både i fritiden og weekenderne.

  • Attraktiv skattepolitik for udlændinge – For internationale medarbejdere findes der skattefordele, der kan gøre det økonomisk fordelagtigt at arbejde i Portugal.

  • Voksende erhvervsliv og økonomi – Portugal har en blomstrende erhvervssektor, hvor flere internationale virksomheder etablerer sig, hvilket skaber gode jobmuligheder og karriereveje.

  • Stærkt netværk af expats og internationale virksomheder – Mange internationale virksomheder har kontorer i Portugal, hvilket gør det nemt at integrere sig i et globalt arbejdsmiljø.

Arbejdet i Portugal giver både professionel og personlig udvikling samt mulighed for at opleve en spændende livsstil med stor kulturel og økonomisk værdi.

jobs.title: Outcomes Growth Strategy and Programs Lead
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE:

Notion’s global Outcomes organization is focused on helping customers achieve business objectives with Notion. As the Growth Strategy & Programs Lead, you will help design and scale the programs, operating rhythms, and cross-functional initiatives that make install-base growth more explosive and repeatable globally.

This is a high-impact strategy and programs role. You will create the clarity, structure, and execution systems that help the business grow existing customers more deliberately.

You will bring analytical rigor to how we understand growth, translate insights into scalable programs, and help teams execute with consistency while still allowing for local market nuance. The ideal candidate is equally comfortable building a model, writing a crisp recommendation, aligning executive stakeholders, and turning a strategy into a practical field motion.

 

This role will be based in San Francisco. We work from our offices on Mondays, Tuesdays and Thursdays (our Anchor Days) because we do our best thinking and building together in person. We’re looking for someone who’s excited to work alongside the team during those days. 




IN YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS, YOU WILL:

 - Learn Notion's post-sales operating model, regional execution model, and current install-base growth priorities.

 - Partner with RevOps, Data Science, Finance, Sales, Outcomes, and Services leaders to develop a practical view of the key drivers and leading indicators behind retention and expansion.

 - Identify a focused set of priority growth programs or plays to support the business in the near term.

 - Build the initial program plans, success metrics, stakeholder map, and operating cadence for those priority initiatives.

 - Partner with regional teams to understand how global programs should be adapted for local execution.

 - Create clear documentation, field-facing materials, and executive-ready updates that help teams align and act.

 - Establish a repeatable rhythm for reviewing progress, capturing learnings, and improving




WHAT YOU'LL ACHIEVE:

 - Help build a clear, shared view of the drivers behind expansion and adoption across Notion's customer base.

 - Design and scale global programs that support customer adoption, value realization, cross-sell, upsell, and durable growth.

 - Partner with regional and functional leaders to turn local learnings into repeatable playbooks, programs, and operating cadences.

 - Create measurement, reporting, and review mechanisms that help teams understand what is working and where to focus.

 - Support the design of customer growth motions that connect Sales, Services, and Partners.

 - Help codify best practices so growth becomes part of the standard operating rhythm, not a set of one-off campaigns.

 - Bring structure to ambiguous, cross-functional initiatives and drive them from idea to operational execution.




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING: 

 - Experience in management consulting, investment banking, business operations, or post-sales GTM operations.

 - Strong analytical and structured problem-solving skills; you can turn ambiguous business questions into clear frameworks, insights, and recommendations.

 - Proven ability to design and manage cross-functional programs from strategy through execution.

 - Strong stakeholder management across senior leaders and operating teams, with the ability to align people around a shared plan.

 - Excellent written communication, including crisp strategy docs, program plans, executive updates, and field-facing materials.

 - Comfort working in a global organization where programs need a strong central strategy and room for regional adaptation.

 - Ability to operate autonomously, prioritize effectively, and bring structure to fast-moving, ambiguous work.

 - Strong business judgment and curiosity about what drives customer adoption, retention, and expansion.




NICE TO HAVES:

 - Familiarity with usage-based, consumption-based, or product-led growth models.

 - Experience building or scaling global programs across multiple regions or customer segments.

 - Exposure to pricing, packaging, services, partners, or monetization initiatives.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco, the estimated base salary range for this role is $250k - $280k per year.

#LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. jobs.title: Voice Over Artist
jobs.description:
We are one of the leading tech-driven media and entertainment companies, producing uplifting content in 17 languages for audiences of all ages. Known for the award-winning digital publisher boredpanda.com and the Crafty Panda DIY channel, we fight the worldâs boredom at scale - reaching 160 million site views per month and 62 billion video views per year. Our team consists of around 350 creative professionals from 36 countries, with 2 offices in Vilnius, Lithuania.

Spike, the global animated series, is searching for talented voice actors to bring its characters to life! Our YouTube channel has reached over 1 billion views, entertaining children worldwide with universal, character-driven stories. We're casting our two lead roles: Spike, an imaginative, curious, and fearless 7-year-old whose creativity turns everyday moments into adventures; and Sparkle, his confident, attention-loving 5Â½-year-old sister with unmistakable main-character energy. Additionally, we are seeking versatile utility players who can perform multiple recurring characters - from the know-it-all giraffe girl, Poem, and the scared but loyal elephant boy, Muddles, to the bully rhino twins, Storm and Thunder, and the local mad scientist lion, Professor Roar, to name a few. Plus, there are loving parents, friends, foes, and all the colorful citizens that make Spike's world so vibrant.

What You Will Do:

  • Bring recurring characters to life with expressive performances that match the show's playful and energetic tone;
  • Help shape memorable voices and personalities for the faces of a global IP;
  • Deliver engaging voice performances that support clear storytelling in fast-paced 3â5 minute episodes;
  • Perform dialogue that enhances visual comedy and elevates emotional moments;
  • Maintain consistent character voices and performances across multiple episodes;
  • Take direction well, adjusting pacing, emotion, and delivery as needed;
  • Record clean, broadcast-quality audio from a professional home studio;
  • Attend directed recording sessions via remote call, if required;
  • Work efficiently to deliver recordings on schedule as part of Spike's consistent weekly production cadence;
  • Collaborate with directors and sound supervisors to create polished, world-class voice performances for each episode.

What We Expect:

  • Professional voice acting experience in animation, games, children's media, dubbing, or similar productions;
  • Strong character acting skills with distinctive, believable, and consistent voices;
  • Strong acting instincts and an understanding of how voice performance supports visual storytelling;
  • Ability to take direction while bringing your own creative ideas to deliver the strongest performance possible;
  • Clear diction, vocal control, and emotionally authentic performances;
  • Fluency in English and mastery of American accents;
  • Spike is worldwide, so an understanding of globally accessible performances that communicate character and emotion across cultures;
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, digital-first production environment;
  • A reliable home recording setup capable of delivering broadcast-quality audio;
  • Professionalism, responsiveness, and the ability to meet deadlines while collaborating effectively with the creative team.

Compensation: 40-120 eur/gross per episode.

jobs.title: Tugiisik
jobs.description:
Tööülesanded: Kas tunned, et soovid teha tööd, millel on päriselt tähendus? Kas lastega suhtlemine toob sulle rõõmu ning soovid olla kellelegi toeks tema igapäevases kasvamises ja arengus?
Meie meeskond ootab endaga liituma tugiisikuid, kes soovivad panustada laste heaolusse, turvatundesse ja enesekindluse kasvamisse. Sinu roll tugiisikuna: olla lapsele igapäevane toetaja ja julgustaja; aidata kaasa lapse arengule ja iseseisvuse kujunemisele; luua turvaline ja hooliv keskkond; teha koostööd pere ja spetsialistidega.

Omalt poolt pakume: Püsivat tööd;
Toetavat meeskonda ja sisekoolitusi; Tähendusrikast ja südantsoojendavat tööd; Toetavat meeskonda ja juhendamist; Võimalust päriselt midagi muuta ühe lapse elus.

Muud nõuded: Otsime tugiisikuid, kes sobivad hästi lastega, on kohusetundlikud ja peavad kinni kokkulepetest ning on soovitavalt läbinud tugiisiku koolituse või valmis seda läbima.
Ootame sind, kui: hoolid lastest ja soovid nendega töötada; oled kannatlik, empaatiline ja usaldusväärne; suudad märgata lapse vajadusi ja pakkuda tuge; oled valmis õppima ja arenema. See ei ole lihtsalt töö – see on võimalus olla kellelegi oluline tugi ja turvatunne.

väljaõppe töökohal kogenud juhendajate käe all; väärilise motivatsioonipaketi; huvitava töö ühes juhtivas tööstuskontsernis; võimaluse osaleda kaasaegsete projektide elluviimisel ning areneda oma erialal; sporditoetuse 100 eurot kvartalis või täiendava tervisekindlustuse; toetava ja sõbraliku kollektiivi; tasuta transpordi Kohtla-Järvelt, Jõhvist, Ahtmest.

kutsekeskharidus (soovitavalt mehhaanika valdkonnas) ja tehniline mõtlemine; kogemus lukksepatööde tegemisel tehnoloogilisel seadmel. Keevitusoskused on suureks eeliseks. Kui oled tehniliselt taiplik ja oskad loogiliselt mõelda, saad selle tööga hästi hakkama!

jobs.title: Gestionnaire de Parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel (H/F)
jobs.description:
Gestionnaire de parc - Régisseur Technique Événementiel:
Type de contrat
CDI temps plein 35h
Lieu de travail
Conflans-Sainte-Honorine (78)
Salaire
2 000 à 2 300 euros brut par mois selon profil et expérience

Description de l'entreprise
We Rise est une société spécialisée dans la prestation technique événementielle basée en Ile-de-France. Nous accompagnons nos clients sur des événements professionnels, institutionnels, culturels et privés grâce à nos expertises en sonorisation, éclairage, vidéo, captation, murs LED et location de matériel.
Description du poste
Dans le cadre de notre développement, nous recrutons un Assistant Chargé de Production Technique & Gestionnaire de Dépôt. Ce poste est central dans l'organisation des prestations de l'entreprise.
Le titulaire du poste assurera la gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel, participera à la préparation technique des événements, coordonnera les ressources nécessaires à la bonne réalisation des prestations et assurera le suivi des sous-locations et fournisseurs.
Ce recrutement peut faire l'objet d'une POEI (Préparation Opérationnelle à l'Emploi Individuelle) en partenariat avec France Travail pour les candidats éligibles.

Missions principales
Gestion du dépôt et du parc matériel : suivi des entrées et sorties, organisation du dépôt, préparation des commandes, contrôle des retours, inventaires, suivi SAV et réparations, maintenances préventives, gestion des consommables.
Préparation technique des prestations : analyse des besoins techniques, construction des listes de matériel dans Rentman, vérification des disponibilités, identification des besoins en sous-location, préparation des dossiers techniques et briefs équipes, rédaction des feuilles de route.
Coordination opérationnelle : planification des équipes techniques, organisation des chargements et déchargements, suivi opérationnel des projets, circulation des informations entre les intervenants.
Gestion des sous-locations et fournisseurs : identification des besoins, consultation des fournisseurs, suivi des devis, organisation des retraits et retours de matériel sous-loué.

Profil recherché
Expérience indispensable dans la prestation technique événementielle, acquise chez un prestataire technique audiovisuel ou une structure événementielle. Une expérience en préparation de matériel, exploitation, régie, sonorisation, éclairage ou vidéo constitue un atout.
Formation souhaitée : BTS Métiers de l'Audiovisuel, BTS Techniques du Spectacle, Licence Professionnelle ou formation équivalente dans les métiers de l'événementiel.

Compétences requises
Bonne connaissance de l'environnement de la prestation technique événementielle. Bonne culture générale des métiers du son, de l'éclairage et de la vidéo. Excellente aisance informatique et appétence pour les logiciels métiers. La connaissance de Rentman constitue un plus. Organisation, rigueur, sens des responsabilités, esprit d'équipe et capacité d'apprentissage.
Evolution du poste
Selon les compétences et l'autonomie acquises, des évolutions vers les fonctions de Chargé de Production Technique, Coordinateur Technique ou Responsable Exploitation Technique sont envisagées.

Avantages
Heures supplémentaires rémunérées ou récupérées. Formation et accompagnement à la prise de poste.

Candidature
Merci de lire cette annonce jusqu'au bout avant de postuler.
Pour que votre candidature soit étudiée, vous devez impérativement remplir le formulaire de candidature à l'adresse suivante :
https://forms.gle/63tGZx4rHBMD3SQm8
Les candidatures transmises sans formulaire complété ne seront pas traitées.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About SuperPlane

SuperPlane is an open source software factory engine: the system that lets AI agents build, test, and ship code while engineers focus on design and decisions. This is going to be how all software gets built, and we're building the engine underneath it.

The Role

We are hiring a product engineer to join the team and own meaningful projects end to end.

This is a remote role. We currently work across GMT+2 to GMT-3 and welcome candidates in that range.

At SuperPlane, we don't split engineering into frontend and backend. Everyone is a well-rounded builder who moves across the stack, makes product and technical calls, asks for help when needed, and delivers features from start to finish. You might spend one day building an API endpoint or workflow engine improvement, and the next day polishing a React surface that users touch every day.

We're looking for someone at a mid-level to senior level: you've shipped real products, you can work independently, and you're ready to grow fast in a high-trust, high-pace environment. You don't need to have done everything before, but you need to learn quickly and take ownership of what you build.


What We Are Looking For

  • You are genuinely full-stack.

  • Your workflow is AI-driven and you know how to stay fast without getting sloppy.

  • You have strong backend experience in a systems-oriented language. While we use Go, we don't expect you to be an expert already, just to ramp up fast.

  • You have solid systems judgment. APIs, data models, reliability, and trade-offs matter to you.

  • You're comfortable with TypeScript and React -- the modern frontend stack.

  • You are comfortable with cloud-native tooling and modern software delivery.

  • You want ownership, not a narrow lane.

  • You want an early-stage company where the pace is high, the standards are high, and the upside is big.


How To Apply

We care more about proof of work than polished applications, and we want to see how you show up in open source.

Before you apply, submit at least one pull request to superplanehq/superplane. It can be small and it does not need to be merged.

When you apply, send your GitHub username and a link to your pull request. We verify both, and applications missing either field will not move forward.


Why You'll Love Working at SuperPlane

  • Build a frontier product used by engineers across the globe.

  • Meaningful equity and real ownership.

  • Small team, fast feedback loops.

  • Remote role that lets you focus and create.

jobs.title: Client Onboarding Manager
jobs.description:
Who Connecteam is:

Connecteam is the leading platform for managing deskless teams, trusted by over 80,000 businesses worldwide.

We built Connecteam for real operators - the people running shifts, jobs, and teams across stores and sites. The kind of work that doesnât happen behind a desk, and doesnât have time for messy spreadsheets, scattered group chats, or tools that donât talk to each other.

Connecteam brings daily operations and team communication into one intuitive app - from hiring and scheduling to training, tasks, and day-to-day coordination. It gives teams the clarity and control to run the day, shift after shift, job after job.

Backed by $220M+ from Insight Partners, Stripes, and Tiger Global, Connecteam is rapidly expanding worldwide - empowering frontline teams to work smarter, stay connected, and operate with greater efficiency.

About The Role

The Onboarding Manager guides new customers who come from a partnership, through the implementation of Connecteam, from initial handoff and kickoff through a successful payroll launch. This is a customer-facing, hands-on implementation role combining project management, system configuration, payroll-process understanding, customer training and cross-functional coordination.

The Onboarding Manager works closely with customers, in collaboration with the partnerâs Implementation Managers and internal Connecteam teams to ensure employee data, time tracking, PTO, payroll rules and payroll system integrations are configured and validated correctly. The primary goal is to deliver a smooth onboarding experience while ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time.

Implementations are payroll-first and planned around the customerâs first clock-in date, payroll schedule and go-live timeline. Depending on account size and complexity, the Onboarding Manager may continue supporting the customer through the first one to three payroll cycles.

Success in this role requires more than technical knowledge. The Onboarding Manager must be highly perceptive, able to read people and situations quickly, and skilled at navigating complex interpersonal dynamics while maintaining trust across multiple internal and external teams.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own the customer onboarding process
    • Manage a book of business of customers that came from the partnership, from internal handoff through go-live and initial payroll stabilization.
    • Build implementation plans around first clock-in, payroll periods, training requirements and payroll-processing deadlines.
    • Lead kickoff, setup, training and clientâs payroll.
    • Maintain clear timelines, responsibilities, next steps, risks and customer communication throughout each project.
  • Lead discovery and solution design
    • Understand the customerâs workflows.
    • Translate business requirements into a practical Connecteam setup.
    • Identify complex requirements and suit the right solution with the design of the relevant setup.
  • Configure integrations
    • Configure relevant Connecteam account settings
    • Set up and manage the integration.
  • Deliver training and manage stakeholders
    • Train clients on Connecteam platform and integration process.
    • Train managers on time tracking and payroll workflows using Connecteam.
    • Adapt the training plan to customer size, structure and complexity while keeping sessions practical and process-focused.
    • Work closely with the assigned partner Implementation Manager.
    • Coordinate clearly across customers, partner, Sales, Support, Product, Integrations and leadership.
  • Troubleshoot, escalate and document
    • Investigate issues across the full workflow.
    • Determine issue owner and route it appropriately
    • Escalate payroll-impacting risks with clear documentation
    • Maintain accurate account records, architecture decisions, risks, next steps and handoff documentation.
Experience & Skills

  • 2+ years of experience in implementation, onboarding, customer facing SaaS role with SMB & Mid Market client sizes.
  • Strong project management skills with the ability to manage multiple customer implementations and priorities simultaneously.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and training skills with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.
  • Tech-savvy with the ability to quickly learn software, troubleshoot issues, and understand integrations and data flows.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and a customer-first approach when managing complex implementations.
  • Ability to build trusted relationships with customers, internal teams, and external partners in a fast-paced environment.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, sound judgment, and the ability to navigate ambiguity and changing customer needs.

Preferred Experience

  • Experience with payroll, HRIS, workforce management, scheduling, time & attendance, or employee management platforms.
  • Experience supporting payroll implementations, PEO environments, or multi-location/multi-entity organizations.
  • Experience working in a partner-led or channel-based customer environment.

Benefits:

    • Medical, dental, & vision coverage
    • Paid time off for vacation, sick days
    • 401k
Salary: $90K

We are accepting applications from employees working in the following states: Texas, New York, New Jersey, South Carolina, North Carolina, Colorado, Florida, Utah, and Georgia.

Joining Connecteam Is The Smart Move:

  • We build our people up. Every team member is treated as a long-term investment and we recognize the value in always nurturing and training them so they can go above and beyond in their skills and job duties.
  • We make an impact on our customerâs business. We are on a mission to provide managers of all business types and sizes with the tools they need to communicate, operate, engage, and run their deskless workforce. Our product offers them an effective and affordable solution to run their business.
  • We get the job done. Connecteam employees are passionate in executing their job duties so they can drive the company forward and provide real value to our customers.
  • We have fun! From weekly happy hours to holiday parties, we always enjoy each otherâs company (and good food, of course). Connecteam is like one big, happy family!
  • Everyone is welcome. Connecteam is committed to building an encouraging, caring, and supportive environment. We share a responsibility to support our team and enrich their lives.

Together we will shape the future of work!
