jobs.title: Occupational Nurse
jobs.description:
Scania is undergoing a transformation from being a leading supplier of trucks, buses, and engines to providing complete and sustainable transport solutions. Together with TRATON and our sister brands MAN, Volkswagen Truck & Bus, and International, we are working to shape the future of mobility with innovative and environmentally conscious solutions.  



Our values – customer first, respect, team spirit, responsibility, and elimination of waste – are at the heart of everything we do. Together, we are at the forefront of creating a sustainable future.



Role Summary

Would you like to work in an organization where health, work environment, and sustainable productivity are at the forefront? Scania Occupational Health Provider in Södertälje is now seeking an Occupational Nurse who wants to work both operationally and consultatively with our internal customers. As an Occupational Nurse, you will work in a consultative role with a strong customer and business focus. You will operate at the individual, group, and organizational levels and collaborate closely with other occupational health professionals.

Job Responsibilities

    Work consultatively with customers, providing occupational health expertise at individual, team, and organizational levels.
    Collaborate proactively with customers to identify and mitigate workplace risks while promoting a safe, healthy, and inclusive work environment.
    Support rehabilitation and return-to-work processes through clinical expertise and effective stakeholder management.
    Conduct occupational health consultations and assessments with employees.  
    Deliver high-quality support and advice through telephone and call centre services.  
    Participate in daytime emergency response activities and provide crisis intervention support during critical incidents.  
    Act as a trusted advisor to managers, offering guidance on occupational health and employee wellbeing matters.  
    Plan, develop, and deliver training sessions, workshops, and presentations related to occupational health.
    Conduct pre-employment medical assessments, health surveillance, and statutory medical examinations.
    Lead and contribute to internal projects focused on service development, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.

Who You Are

We are looking for a Registered Occupational Nurse or a Registered Nurse with experience in occupational health services who is passionate about promoting health, well-being, and preventive care in the workplace.

As a person, you are proactive, relationship-oriented, and committed to delivering high-quality support and guidance. You enjoy working independently while collaborating effectively with colleagues and stakeholders across the organization.

To succeed in this role, you will have:

    A valid nursing qualification and registration as an Occupational Nurse or Registered Nurse
    Experience in occupational health services or a strong interest in workplace health and well-being
    Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to build trust and establish positive relationships
    A proactive mindset and the ability to work independently and take initiative
    A commitment to continuous learning, professional development, and service improvement
    Fluency in English, both written and spoken
    Good digital literacy and confidence using IT systems and Microsoft Office applications

This Is Us

Scania Occupational Health Provider is an internal support organization and forms part of Scania’s global HSE organization (Health, Safety & Environment). The service consists of four multidisciplinary teams of occupational health nurses, occupational physicians, and psychologists operating in Södertälje, Oskarshamn, and Luleå. You will become part of one of the teams in Södertälje and will also work closely with ergonomists and work environment engineers to support our customers.

Scania Offers

We offer a dynamic and engaging workplace where collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement are part of everyday life. You will be part of a strong team environment that encourages knowledge sharing and close cooperation across functions.

With a structured development plan and a wide range of training opportunities, Scania supports your professional growth both locally and internationally.

Benefits include access to our health center in Gröndal or a wellness allowance, result bonus, flexible working hours, and company car leasing. Scania also arranges events for employees and their families, and for those living in Stockholm, convenient commuting is supported through direct Scania Job express buses to Södertälje.

Application

We look forward to receiving your application, consisting of your CV and kindly ask you not to share a cover letter to ensure an efficient and unbiased recruitment process for all parties.



Apply as soon as possible, no later than 2026-08-14. Screening will take place on an ongoing basis during the application period. Logical and personality tests may be used as part of the selection process, and a background check may be required for this role.



If you have questions or would like more information, please contact: Gunér Johanna- Manager Occupational Medical - johanna.guner@scania.com



We look forward to your application!

jobs.title: Asset Administrator
jobs.description:
ISS är ett av världens största tjänsteföretag och i år firar vi 80 år i Sverige! Med över 6500 medarbetare i landet, från norr till söder, levererar vi service som gör skillnad. Vi erbjuder våra kunder allt från städning till teknisk service, mat- och arbetsplatstjänster. Vi skapar arbetsplatser där människor trivs, företag växer och där hållbarhet är en självklarhet – socialt, miljömässigt och affärsmässigt. Våra medarbetare är hjärtat i det vi gör – och avgörande för att våra kunder ska känna sig trygga, sedda – och för att deras arbetsplatser ska blomstra.

At ISS, we are looking for an engaged and experienced Asset Administrator with strong skills in both English and Chinese, spoken and written, for a fixed-term parental leave cover starting in October 2026 and ending in April 2027. Do you want to help deliver high-quality service and play an important role in supporting asset and material management for our customer Huawei? Then we encourage you to apply for our Asset Administrator role at ISS’ customer site in Kista.

About the role

As an Asset Administrator, you will be responsible for supporting the customer’s asset and material management processes. The role is based onsite in Kista and may also involve administrative coordination connected to the customer’s offices in Lund and Gothenburg. You will help ensure that assets and materials are managed in line with company policies and routines, while also supporting office-related administration, events, and expatriate management. We place great importance on your ability to work independently, communicate clearly, and deliver high-quality work in a structured and service-minded way.

Your responsibilities will include, among other things:

    Managing assets and materials, including purchase, counting, storage, and scrap processes.
    Following company policies and regulations related to asset and material management.
    Cooperating with internal and external parties for asset and material counting, checking, and follow-up.
    Analyzing requirements and communicating with colleagues to manage different situations effectively.
    Supporting administrative requirements, such as admin regulations training and admin system operations.
    Providing expatriate management and support.
    Supporting daily office-related administration and problem-solving when needed.

The position is full-time and based onsite in Kista. This is a fixed-term parental leave cover, starting in October 2026 and ending in April 2027.

What we offer

You will work in a varied and important role where your contribution supports ISS’ service delivery and helps our customer achieve their goals. You will work closely with competent colleagues and be part of a workplace where we value collaboration, development, and high-quality service. ISS’ size and broad range of services provide strong development opportunities, both nationally and globally. Our focus is on taking care of and developing our employees, because we believe that “People make places”. ISS offers a wide range of training opportunities and talent development programs, all designed to help you stay engaged and grow in your career.

We place great importance on diversity and inclusion. At ISS, all people are valued equally and have the same rights and opportunities. Our employees reflect the diversity of society, which is both a competitive advantage and a valuable asset in our long-term sustainability efforts. Our inclusive corporate culture empowers our people, enhances creativity and productivity, and creates a more attractive workplace.

The core values that guide the way we work at ISS are unity, honesty, responsibility, entrepreneurship and quality. Therefore, it is important that you embrace a way of working and a mindset that align with these values.

Who are we looking for?

We are looking for someone with previous experience from an administrative and service-oriented role. Experience from asset management, office administration, or working in an international company is considered an advantage. You have a strong focus on delivering high-quality work and are structured, detail-oriented, and well organized.

You have good organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to plan, prioritize, and execute tasks and smaller projects independently. Good MS Office skills, including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook, are required. The ability to create high-quality internal formal documents is considered a plus. Fluent written and verbal communication skills in Chinese and English are essential, while Swedish language skills are an advantage.

As a person, you are service-minded, communicative, responsible, and proactive. You enjoy cooperating with different stakeholders and are comfortable acting as a professional representative of both ISS and the customer.

Do you have questions about the position?

If you have any questions, please contact the recruiting manager Rasmus Huldt: rasmus.huldt@se.issworld.com

Please note: We do not accept applications by email or post. Applications must be submitted through our recruitment system. Applications sent by email or post will be deleted without being processed.

We look forward to receiving your application!

jobs.title: Lähihoitaja kotihoitoon
jobs.description:
ETSIMME OULUN ALUEELLE LÄHIHOITAJAA KOTIHOITOON KEIKKATYÖHÖN

Kotihoito tarjoaa mahdollisuuden tehdä yksilöllistä ja merkityksellistä työtä, jossa asiakkaan hyvinvointi ja elämänlaatu ovat keskiössä. Pääset aloittamaan työssä heti tai sopimuksen mukaan.

MITÄ KOTIHOIDON TYÖ SISÄLTÄÄ?

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Perushoito ja asiakkaan päivittäinen avustaminen

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn, hyvinvoinnin ja turvallisuuden tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

MITÄ TARJOAMME SINULLE?

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden työskennellä omalla tavallasi, asiakasta kunnioittaen

* Ammattitaitoisen ja kannustavan työyhteisön tueksesi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuutta, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

Kiinnostuitko? Jätä hakemuksesi! Haastattelemme jo hakuajan aikana.

Nähdään Alinassa!

----------------------------------------

Haluatko tietää lisää meistä? Löydät lisätietoa verkkosivuiltamme [https://alinahoivatiimi.fi/].

Alina on valtakunnallinen ketju, joka työllistää jo 350 alan ammattilaista. Paikallisia Alina-yrityksiä on jo yli 40 eri puolilla Suomea. Yhdeksän kymmenestä asiakkaastamme suosittelisi Alinaa tuttavilleen, ja työtyytyväisyytemme sai arvosanaksi 4,39/5 vuonna 2025.

Alina on osa Norlandiaa [https://norlandiacare.fi/], joka tarjoaa innovatiivisia ja monipuolisia hyvinvointi- ja terveyspalveluita kaikille vauvasta vaariin sekä nelijalkaisille ystävillemme. Suomessa Norlandian toimintoihin kuuluvat hoivakodit YHDESSÄ palvelukortteleissa, Tampereella sijaitseva potilashotelli, Norlandia Päiväkodit ja Aberia.

You roll up your sleeves and dive into each job with focus and pride, using advanced tools and cleaning systems to bring belongings back to life. You track and photograph contents, keep meticulous records, and make sure every item is handled with care. You troubleshoot, problem-solve, and stay one step ahead to keep projects on schedule. You take ownership of your work and lead by example, creating a positive, efficient, and safe environment for your team. Every day, your skill, energy, and attention to detail help turn chaos into calm for clients when they need it most.

jobs.title: Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway
jobs.description:
Specialist Psychiatrist – Northern Norway

 

We are looking for a specialist psychiatrist for a permanent position in Northern Norway.

You will join a well-functioning outpatient clinic and work closely with an experienced team. The region is known for its relaxed pace of life, strong professional environments, and supportive colleagues.

Your role
  • Assess, diagnose, and treat patients with psychiatric conditions
  • Contribute actively to interdisciplinary collaboration and treatment planning
  • Supervise junior doctors and support internal training
  • Take part in developing the service and improving clinical practice
Qualifications
  • European medical authorization and specialist certification in psychiatry
  • Good English skills and motivation to learn Norwegian (language training provided)
  • Solid clinical competence and ability to work independently
What the clinic offers
  • Permanent position in a stable and well-organized outpatient unit
  • Close collaboration with experienced and supportive colleagues
  • Flexible working hours, with options for extended shifts and additional pay
  • Access to courses, seminars, and continuous professional development
  • Optional participation in acute care rotation, with extra compensation
  • Pension and insurance schemes through KLP
Why Northern Norway?

Northern Norway offers a unique combination of professional opportunities and quality of life.

You get access to modern healthcare facilities while living close to nature. The region is known for its dramatic landscapes, with mountains, fjords, and coastline right outside your door.

It is a great place for both individuals and families. You will find good schools, safe communities, and a slower, more balanced lifestyle.

Outdoor activities are part of everyday life — whether it is hiking, skiing, fishing, or simply enjoying the Northern Lights in winter and the midnight sun in summer.

Despite the remote location, you have access to regional airports and solid connections to the rest of Norway and Europe.

  • Personal follow-up throughout the entire recruitment process
  • Relocation support for you and your family (housing, schools, kindergartens)

  • Guidance with authorization, paperwork, and practical matters

Aiempi kokemus kaupan alalta on etu, mutta tärkeintä on aito kiinnostus asiakaspalvelutyöhön ja valmius tarttua monipuolisesti myymälän erilaisiin työtehtäviin.

Työtä tehdään myymälän aukioloaikojen mukaisesti kaikissa vuoroissa, myös öisin. Tehtävä edellyttää täysi-ikäisyyttä (18 vuotta). Seinäjoen keskustan Smarket Itikanristeys ja Megakeskus tekevät arjessa tiivistä yhteistyötä, joten tässä työssä myyjän työn monipuolisuus toteutuu mahdollisuutena työskennellä kahdessa market yksikössä.

Me Eepeellä sanomme olevamme ihan tavallisissa töissä. Se tarkoittaa meille rehellistä työtä, jossa jokaisen panoksella on merkitystä. Tarjoamme mukavan työyhteisön, kattavan perehdytyksen, erinomaiset henkilöstöedut sekä mahdollisuuksia kasvaa ja kehittyä urasi aikana.

Miksi hakea Eepeelle?
· Laajat S-ryhmän ja Eepeen henkilöstöedut, jotka ovat käytössä koko kotitaloudellasi, tietyin edellytyksin. Tämä tarkoittaa alennuksia ruoasta, juomista, meikeistä, elektroniikasta tai vaikkapa hotelliöistä. Tutustu henkilökuntaetuihin:Erinomaiset edut – Eepee
· Kuulut koko henkilöstöä koskevan tulospalkkiojärjestelmän piiriin
· Kattavat työterveyspalvelut sekä liikunnan ja hyvinvoinnin Epassi-edut
· Poikkeuksellisen paljon mahdollisuuksia! Voit vaihtaa ammattia, toimialaa tai ottaa lisätyötä oman osaamisesi ja toiveidesi mukaan

Kiinnostuitko? Hae mukaan rakentamaan uuden S-market Itikanristeyksen menestystarinaa! Lähetä hakemuksesi viimeistään 10.8.2026.
Käsittelemme hakemuksia ja haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuaikana, joten jätä hakemuksesi mahdollisimman pian.

tiina.rinne@sok.fi / 010 764 6991

Eepee on osuuskauppa,jonka omistavat sen yli 94 000 asiakasomistajaa. Tarjoamme toimialueellamme työpaikan 1300 palvelualan ammattilaiselle lähes 80 toimipaikassamme.
Eepeellä teemme ihan tavallisia töitä. Tavallisuus on voima, joka erottaa meidät muista. Meillä työ ei ole vain peruspesti, mutta samalla se on juuri sitä. Tavallinen työ on sitä, mitä pitääkin olla – tehokasta, arvokasta ja tärkeää. Ihan tavallisen työn lisäksi, meillä on epätavallisen hyvät edut ja poikkeuksellisen mahtavat työkaverit.

jobs.title: Myyjä, Sale Karjalohja
jobs.description:
Primary location:
LOHJA

Etsimme nyt vakituista MYYJÄÄ Karjalohjan Saleen! Tehtävä on osa-aikainen, 20 h/vko.Myyjän työ sopii sinulle, joka innostut asiakaspalvelusta ja tekemisen meiningistä. Siitä on tietysti hyötyä, jos olet työskennellyt vastaavissa tehtävissä jo aiemmin, mutta se ei ole välttämätöntä – me perehdytämme kyllä! Voit tutustua Salemme tunnelmaansomessa, ja saatatpa bongata tulevien työkavereiden kasvojakin!

🛒Salen myyjänä teet ihan tavallisia töitä:työpäiväsi täyttyvät asiakaskohtaamisista, kassatyöstä, hyllytyksestä sekä hävikin ja saatavuuden hallinnasta. Tavallisuus ei kuitenkaan tarkoita tylsää tai merkityksetöntä – päinvastoin! Meille tavallista on asiakkaiden hurmaaminen leveällä hymyllä ja reippaalla työotteella.

🌟Toivomme, että pidät asiakkaiden kohtaamisesta, tiimityöskentelystä, fyysisestä työstä ja reippaasta työtahdista. Edellytämme 18 vuoden ikää ja mahdollisuutta työskennellä vaihtelevissa aamu- päivä- ja iltavuoroissa n. klo 7–21 välillä.

Haluamme vastaavasti tarjota sinulle
·💚Ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta erityisen hyvät henkilöstöedut! Miltä kuulostaisi -25 % alennus S-ryhmän ravintoloista? Tai -15 % alennus käyttötavaroista mm. Prismoista ja Sokokselta? Suomen parhaimmiksikin kutsutuista henkilöstöeduista voit lukea esimakuatäältä.
·💸Kaupan työehtosopimuksen mukaista palkkaa koulutuksesi ja kokemuksesi perusteella. Tuntipalkkasi tulee sijoittumaan välille 11,16–14,93 €/h. Ja lisät päälle!
·💰Mahdollisuuden vuosittaiseen tulospalkkioon.
·💎Arvokasta kokemusta asiakaspalvelusta, myynnistä ja tiimityöstä. Näitä taitoja tarvitaan lähes jokaisessa työpaikassa, joten tilaisuus kerryttää kokemusta kannattaa käyttää hyödyksi.
·🛒Jos kaipaat enemmän viikkotyötunteja, voit halutessasi tehdä lisätöitä joko kotimyymälässäsi tai SSO:n muissa toimipisteissä. Samalla kerrytät eurojen lisäksi osaamista ja saat uusia työkavereita.
·🤩Harvinaisen hyvät työkaverit! 88 % työntekijöistämme suosittelee SSO:ta työnantajana. Karjalohjalla sinua odottaa 6 hengen tiimi valmiina hommiin kanssasi!
💎Työn ja vapaa-ajan sujuvamman yhteensovittamisen vaikuttamalla itse omiin työvuoroihisi. Sale Karjalohjalla kuten yhä useammassaSSO:ntoimipisteessä, otetaan lokakuussa käyttöönyhteisöllisen työvuorosuunnittelu.Uudessa mallissa työntekijät voivat valita itselleen sopivia työvuoroja sovittujen pelisääntöjen mukaisesti.

💚Me SSO:ssa olemme sitoutuneet työskentelemään monimuotoisen ja syrjimättömän työympäristön puolesta, jossa kunnioitetaan ja arvostetaan kaikkien työntekijöidemme ainutlaatuisia taustoja, taitoja ja näkemyksiä.

Lisätiedot ja hakeminen
Työsuhteen tyyppi: vakituinen
Työaika: osa-aikainen 20 h/vko
Työt alkavat: syyskuussa sopimuksen mukaan
Huomaathan, että haastattelemme hakijoita jo hakuajalla, ja valintapäätökset tehdään heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

📞Lisätietoja tehtävistä antaa arkisin klo 8–16 myymäläpäällikkö Anne-Mari Kujala joko puhelimitse 044320 5796 tai sähköpostitseanne-mari.kujala@sok.fi.

Työnantajakuvaus
Me SSO:ssa arvostamme ihan tavallisia töitä, mutta vielä enemmän arvostamme niitä epätavallisen upeita ihmisiä töiden takana. Uskomme, että ihmiset ratkaisevat onnistumisen. Myyjä, tarjoilija, asiantuntija ja tuhat muuta – me kaikki teemme yhdessä kotiseudustamme parempaa paikkaa elää. Siksi meidät valittiinkin yhdeksi Suomen Innostavimmista työpaikoista vuonna 2025. Työllistämme noin 1200 ammattilaista neljällä eri toimialalla, 80 eri toimipaikassa läntisellä Uudellamaalla ja Salon seudulla. Lue lisää ihan tavallisista töistä ja epätavallisen hyvistä eduista osoitteessasso.fi/toihinmeille.

jobs.title: Field Maintenance Technician CTC_LIS
jobs.description:
Field Maintenance Technician â CTC-LIS

Location: Townsville, Queensland

Employment Type: Full time


About Cubic Defence

At Cubic Defence Australia, we deliver world-class training and simulation capability in support of the Australian Defence Force. Our teams help create and sustain technology solutions that support mission success, safety and readiness for those who serve.


About the Role

Reporting to the 2IC Field Services, the Field Maintenance Technician is responsible for supporting maintenance activities and ensuring the ongoing availability of Combat Training Centre â Live Instrumentation System (CTC-LIS) equipment. This hands-on role supports the preparation, deployment and maintenance of CTC-LIS Relay Stations, including diagnosis and repair of telecommunications equipment such as UHF, microwave and LTE systems, as well as basic servicing and maintenance of diesel-powered generators.


This position requires significant time deployed away from Townsville to various Australian Army and non-Defence training areas. During Force-on-Force exercise phases, you will work in a small team environment providing 24-hour maintenance coverage in the field.


Key Responsibilities

  • Conduct inspections, maintenance and associated repairs of CTC-LIS instrumentation and telemetry equipment.
  • Diagnose and repair telecommunications equipment, including UHF, microwave and LTE systems.
  • Conduct pre-deployment readiness checks of telemetry and mechanical equipment.
  • Maintain CTC-LIS equipment during field deployments.
  • Service and perform minor repairs to diesel-powered generators.
  • Provide technical advice and assistance during instrumentation function checking phases.
  • Be prepared to deputise for the 2IC Field Services during periods of absence.
  • Assume a leadership role within a small team environment during field deployments when required.


About You

You are a capable and motivated technician with strong fault-finding skills, sound communication ability and the confidence to work in both field and workshop environments. You are comfortable operating in dynamic conditions, prioritising maintenance issues and clearly communicating intent and outcomes.


Background and Experience

  • Experience in the installation and maintenance of communications systems.
  • Basic knowledge and understanding of electronics and electrical principles.
  • Proven fault-finding and problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to identify, analyse and prioritise maintenance issues.
  • Ability to work effectively in both field and workshop environments.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Experience using IT systems and programs.


Conditions of Employment

  • Certificate III in Telecommunications, Electrotechnology or a comparable qualification.
  • Clean Heavy Truck Licence to drive company equipment, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Vehicle Loading Crane high risk licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Work at Heights qualification, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Forklift licence, or willingness to undertake training to obtain one.
  • Successful completion of a National Police Check.
  • Ability to obtain and hold an Australian Government Security Vetting Agency security clearance.


Working Environment

This role requires significant time deployed in the field and flexibility to support business operations across multiple time zones. From time to time, you may be required to monitor and respond to telephone calls, emails and other necessary communications from Cubic, customers or suppliers outside ordinary working hours to support critical issues or business needs.


Compliance and General Duties

  • Comply with the role job description and Cubicâs Quality Management System.
  • Follow Cubic Health, Safety and Environment policies and procedures.
  • Comply with established security policies and procedures.
  • Follow Cubic Human Resources procedures.
  • Perform other duties as requested.


Apply Now

If you are a technically skilled professional who enjoys hands-on work, problem-solving in demanding environments and supporting high-tempo military training exercises, we would welcome your application.

jobs.title: Manager salle de Loisirs (H/F)
jobs.description:
Rejoignez l'aventure d'un nouveau centre La Tête Dans Les Nuages à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91)
Bienvenue chez La Tête Dans Les Nuages !

Depuis plus de 25 ans, La Tête Dans Les Nuages fait vivre à ses visiteurs des expériences de loisirs uniques et immersives.
Arcades nouvelle génération, attractions interactives, réalité virtuelle, anniversaires, événements d'entreprise, moments en famille ou entre amis : nos centres sont de véritables lieux de vie et de divertissement pour tous les publics.

Dans le cadre de l'ouverture prochaine de notre nouveau site à Sainte-Geneviève-des-Bois (91), nous recherchons notre futur(e) Manager Loisirs.

Vous aimez le terrain, le management de proximité et le contact client ? Vous souhaitez participer à une ouverture de site et contribuer à sa réussite dès les premiers jours ? Alors rejoignez-nous !

Votre mission
Rattaché(e) au Directeur de Site, vous êtes un acteur clé de l'exploitation quotidienne du centre.
Véritable relais managérial sur le terrain, vous accompagnez les équipes et veillez à offrir à chaque visiteur une expérience mémorable.

- Manager et accompagner les équipes
- Participer au recrutement et à l'intégration des nouveaux collaborateurs.
- Former, accompagner et animer les équipes au quotidien.
- Garantir la bonne application des procédures et des standards de qualité.
- Fédérer les équipes autour de la satisfaction client et de l'esprit de service.
- Assurer le bon déroulement de l'activité durant votre présence.
- Garantir une expérience client exceptionnelle
- Accueillir et accompagner les visiteurs.
- Conseiller les clients sur les différentes offres du centre.
- Accompagner l'organisation des anniversaires, événements privés et séminaires.
- Veiller à la satisfaction des clients tout au long de leur visite.
- Gérer les éventuelles réclamations avec professionnalisme et réactivité.
- Assurer le bon fonctionnement du site
- Superviser les opérations d'ouverture et de fermeture du centre.
- Veiller au respect des règles d'hygiène, de sécurité et des procédures internes.
- Contrôler la bonne tenue des espaces de loisirs et d'accueil.
- Participer à la gestion des stocks et des approvisionnements.
- Garantir la disponibilité et la qualité des prestations proposées.
- Être un véritable ambassadeur de La Tête Dans Les Nuages
- Partager votre enthousiasme avec les équipes et les visiteurs.
- Contribuer à créer une ambiance conviviale et dynamique.
- Participer activement à la réussite commerciale du site.

Votre profil
Vous êtes titulaire d'un Bac +2 minimum ou disposez d'une expérience équivalente.
Vous justifiez d'une première expérience réussie en management de proximité, idéalement dans l'un des secteurs suivants :
Loisirs, Restauration, Commerce / Retail, Hôtellerie, Evénementiel, Distribution.

Vous êtes reconnu(e) pour :
Votre excellent relationnel, votre sens du service client, votre leadership naturel, votre dynamisme et votre esprit d'équipe, votre capacité à gérer les priorités et à prendre des initiatives, votre goût pour le terrain et l'opérationnel.

Vous appréciez les environnements dynamiques où aucune journée ne ressemble à une autre.

Conditions du poste

Travail selon planning variable.
Présence requise les week-ends, jours fériés et certaines soirées selon l'activité du site.
Deux jours de repos consécutifs en semaine.
Horaires aménagés dans le respect de la réglementation du travail.
Les avantages
Tickets restaurant après 2 mois d'ancienneté.
Mutuelle d'entreprise.
Prise en charge des transports en commun à hauteur de 50 %.
Intégration au sein d'un groupe leader du loisir indoor.
Participation à l'ouverture d'un nouveau site ambitieux.

jobs.title: Autolakerer til Århus
jobs.description:
Autolakerer søges til at få lakken til at skinne igen! 

Er du den, der får et tilfredsstillende sug i maven, når en bil forlader kabinen med en spejlblank finish? Elsker du duften af frisk lak og præcision i hver eneste sprøjtning? Så er det dig, vi leder efter!

Byens bilpleje.com er Danmarks førende virksomhed inden for kosmetisk klargøring af biler; herunder autolakering, buleopretning, rustbeskyttelse samt udskiftning af autoglas - vi er bilbranchens foretrukne samarbejdspartner. Byens bilpleje.com blev grundlagt i 1997 og beskæftiger i dag over 400 medarbejdere. Hertil håndterer virksomheden mere end 200.000 biler om året.

Hvad skal du lave?

Du bliver en del af et team af lakspecialister. Dine opgaver inkluderer bl.a.:

  • Ansvarsområde er kabinen og du skal være med til at sikre den daglig drift i kabinen.
  • Sikre jævnt flow, korrekt farvematch og en finish, der spiller.
  • Selvom du har et medansvar for kabinen, er du en del af et stærkt team, der hjælper hinanden, når der er brug for det.
  • Alt det andet: Fordi ingen arbejdsdag er helt ens.

Hvem er du?

Du er en frisk type med humor, der elsker en god snak med kollegaerne over en kaffepause – men også en, der går op i kvalitet og finish. Vi leder efter dig, der:

  • Har erfaring med sprøjtelakering – enten som udlært autolakerer eller med solid erfaring.
  • Går op i kvalitet og finish – du lakerer ikke bare, du skaber mesterværker.
  • Du evner at strukturere dine opgaver
  • Har B-kørekort – så bilerne ikke kun ser flotte ud, men også kan flyttes.
  • Elsker tempoet i en virksomhed, hvor ingen dage er helt ens.

Hvad får du?

  • Løn efter kvalifikationer – vi ved, hvad dygtige folk er værd!
  • Gode kollegaer, der deler din passion for lakering og håndværk.
  • Markeds bedste redskaber/produkter at arbejde med
  • Mulighed for udvikling
  • Et stærkt fællesskab med humor og højt til loftet.
  • Overenskomst, pension og de fordele, du fortjener.

Ansøg nu – før en anden snupper din plads!

Vi holder samtaler løbende, fordi vi vil have den helt rigtige lakmester med på holdet hurtigst muligt. Men hey – vi ved, at kvalitet tager tid, så vi venter gerne på den rette.

Hvis du tænker: "Det dér job er som skabt til mig!" – så spild ikke tiden! Send din ansøgning afsted med det samme. 

Grundet GDPR-forordningen modtager vi ikke ansøgninger på mail, hvorfor disse ikke tages i betragtning. Ansøgningen skal sendes elektronisk via vores hjemmeside www.byensbilpleje.com.

 Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte Susanne Damgaard Petersen på 30432854

jobs.title: Pastry chef for winter season 2026-2027
jobs.description:
Kakslauttanen Arctic Resort is one of Finland's best-known and most talked about travel destinations. This family business, founded in 1974, is in Saariselkä, Lapland. Kakslauttanen hosts around 30,000 visitors each year, many of them from abroad. We are looking for a skilled and experienced pastry chef to join us for our winter season 2026-2027.

Contract is seasonal, starting mid November until end of March 2027. We provide full hours, 112,5h/3week period.

What we are looking for:

* Strong previous experience as apastry chef

* You will create together with us pastry recipes, main star of the recipe will be the products coming out of our own Kakslauttanen distillery.

* You are also able to create your own cakes and other pastries, sweet and salty.

* You are capable of learning and followingnew recipes (e.g. some traditional Finnish pastries).

* You have great cooperation and communicationskills at least in English, Finnish languageis considered as an advantage.

* Following Finnish hygiene standards (Finnish hygiene passport can be arranged by us)

* Culinary school Education is a plus.

* Stress management skills, during winter season days can be busy.

In Finland, you are required to have a valid Finnish Hygiene Passport. The Hygiene Passport is valid for life, and we will help you obtain it. The cost of the Hygiene Passport is the responsibility of each employee.

The location of the resort is in the middle of lovely nature, and here you also have time to enjoy nature and try different activities that you might never get to try otherwise. We have also a small gym for our staff, and possibilities to try cross country skiing and other winter activities.

It is possible to rent an shared apartment through us, so it is easy to join us where ever you are coming from. Apartments are for two people. In terms of employment, we follow the collective agreement of the tourism and restaurant industry, and the salary is according to the agreement, considering the applicant's previous experience and education.

You can also read [https://kakslauttanen.teamtailor.com/posts]our blog to see how it's like to work at Kakslauttanen.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Security
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.

About the Role:

We are seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own our vulnerability management program end to end. In this role, you will drive vulnerability intake, triage, remediation, and reporting across our bug bounty program, our Google Cloud Platform (GCP) infrastructure, source code hosted on GitHub, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS services. You will partner closely with platform engineering, product engineering, SRE, security, IT, legal, and vendor management to make sure vulnerabilities are found fast, triaged accurately, and closed within SLA — and that leadership always has a clear, current picture of the organization's risk posture.The ideal candidate uses AI and automation aggressively to scale themselves, but understands that the core value is clarity, tradeoffs, and execution, not just tooling.



What you'll do:

 - Program Ownership: Own and continuously improve the vulnerability management program, including intake, severity scoring (CVSS/risk-based), SLA definition, and remediation tracking across all asset types.

 - Bug Bounty Operations: Manage the triage/payouts/rewards workflow, and report on program health and trends.

 - Cloud Remediation (GCP): Drive remediation of vulnerabilities found in GCP infrastructure — IAM, networking, Compute/GKE, storage, and logging/monitoring configuration — by partnering with security, cloud, and platform engineering teams.

 - Code & Supply Chain Security: Coordinate remediation of vulnerabilities surfaced through SAST/DAST/SCA tooling (Wiz Code, Snyk, Dependabot, code scanning, secret scanning) across engineering repos, including dependency and supply-chain risk.

 - SaaS Vendor Risk: Build and manage the process for assessing and tracking security posture across third-party SaaS applications.

 - Escalation & Exceptions: Define and enforce escalation paths for overdue or critical/high-severity findings, including risk acceptance and exception processes with appropriate sign-off.

 - Cross-Team Accountability: Partner with engineering managers and tech leads to embed remediation work into sprint planning and hold teams accountable to remediation SLAs.

 - Reporting & Alerting: Establish and maintain a single source of truth for vulnerability status, aging, SLA compliance, and risk trends, with dashboards for engineering leadership, security leadership, and executives.

 - Audit & Compliance Support: Support audit and compliance efforts (SOC 2, ISO 27001, customer security questionnaires) by keeping vulnerability management evidence and metrics audit-ready.

 - Process & Automation: Drive process improvements and automation to reduce manual triage effort and improve time-to-remediation across all vulnerability sources.



Required Skill & Experience:

 - Experience: 4–6+ years of experience in technical program management, security program management, or security operations, with direct ownership of a vulnerability management or application security program.

 - Bug Bounty Expertise: Hands-on experience running a bug bounty program (e.g., HackerOne, Bugcrowd, Intigriti), including triage and payout workflows.

 - Cloud Security Knowledge (GCP): Working knowledge of GCP security fundamentals: IAM, VPC/networking, Security Command Center, Cloud Logging/Monitoring, and common cloud misconfiguration risks.

 - Code Security Familiarity: Familiarity with GitHub-based development workflows and code security tooling (Wiz Code, Dependabot, SAST/DAST/SCA tools such as Snyk, Semgrep, or CodeQL).

 - Risk Prioritization: Strong grasp of vulnerability scoring frameworks (CVSS) and risk-based prioritization.

 - Communication: Excellent cross-functional communication skills — able to translate technical vulnerability data into business risk for executive audiences and hold engineering teams accountable without owning the code themselves.

 - Reporting Tools: Proven ability to build reporting/dashboards (e.g., Linear, Jira, ServiceNow, Tableau, Looker) that give leadership real-time visibility into program health.

 - Compliance Awareness: Experience supporting compliance frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI-DSS, or FedRAMP.



What we value:

 - Systems Thinking: The ability to see the “big picture” and understand how vulnerability management decisions impact the entire stack — cloud, code, and vendor ecosystem alike.

 - Technical Influence: The ability to drive alignment across engineering and security through expertise and collaboration rather than direct authority.

 - Autonomy: Comfortable owning a program end to end and driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

 - Bias for Action: A track record of closing the gap between finding a vulnerability and actually getting it fixed.
   
   

This is a full-time role that can be held from our Foster City, CA office. The hybrid role has an in-office requirement of Monday, Wednesday, and Friday.



Full-Time Employee Benefits Include:

💰 Competitive Salary & Equity

💹 401(k) Program with a 4% match (US Only)

jobs.title: ICEYE : Senior Payroll Specialist (Fixed-term Contract)
jobs.description:
Type: Full-time, fixed term (3-6 months)

Location:Maarintie 6, 02150 Espoo, hybrid

Application deadline: 10.08.2026

ICEYE is looking for a **Senior Payroll Specialist** to join the Global Payroll team as an additional resource during an exciting period of growth.

This is a fixed-term position for approximately 3–6 months, and we hope you can start as soon as possible. We review applications throughout the application period and will fill the position as soon as we find the right person, so we encourage you to apply sooner rather than later.

**What will you be doing?**

In this role, you will support global payroll operations across ICEYE's international organization, with a particular focus on Finland, one of the company's largest payroll entities. Working closely with the Senior Payroll Specialist based in Warsaw, as well as colleagues in HR and Finance and external payroll providers, you will help ensure accurate and compliant payroll operations while contributing to the continuous development of payroll processes.

More specifically, your responsibilities include:

- Coordinating end-to-end payroll operations across approximately 12 countries together with external payroll providers

- Preparing, validating, and submitting payroll data to ensure accurate and timely payroll processing

- Ensuring payroll activities comply with local legislation and internal policies

- Supporting the onboarding of new legal entities and contributing to process development and automation initiatives

- Partnering with internal stakeholders and external vendors to continuously improve payroll operations


**What makes you a great fit?**

We hope you are a proactive and detail-oriented payroll professional who enjoys solving problems and improving ways of working. You thrive in a fast-paced international environment, communicate effectively with stakeholders across functions, and take ownership of delivering high-quality payroll services.

**We require you to have:**

- Around 3–5 years of experience in end-to-end payroll, ideally in an international or fast-paced environment

- Strong knowledge of Finnish payroll legislation and payroll processes, with experience supporting payroll across Europe

- Experience working with third-party payroll providers in a multinational environment

- Excellent Excel skills and experience working with payroll and HRIS systems

- A full working proficiency in English


**We consider as an asset:**

- Knowledge of local labor and payroll legislation outside Europe


**We can offer you:**

- A unique opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing New Space company operating globally

- Meaningful ownership in an international payroll environment supporting employees across multiple countries

- The opportunity to improve payroll processes and help shape future ways of working

- A collaborative and experienced team where your expertise is valued from day one

- Cozy office spaces in Otaniemi, Espoo


**Practicalities:**

This is a full-time and 3-6 months fixed term position. You will be employed as aTalent employee at ICEYE. We hope you can start as soon as possible. The role will be located in Espoo, and we hope you are able to work at the office at least a few days per week as part of a hybrid model. Salary in this position is 5200-5500 €/month (gross) depending on the level of your experience, and will be negotiated individually.

**Sounds like you?** Please submit your CV and motivation letter in PDF-format in English by the latest 10th of August via our application system here: https://emp.jobylon.com/applications/jobs/373689/create/. A motivation letter is optional, but with a role-specific motivation letter you can provide more information about your relevant skills and why this would be an interesting opportunity for you.

Please note that we are actively reviewing applications throughout the application period and processing them in the order they are received. Remember to use the application system, we do not accept applications by email. We want to ensure that all applicants can participate in the process equally, and we will take individual accessibility needs into account where necessary. You can familiarize yourself with ICEYE here: https://www.iceye.com/company. For more information about the recruitment process contact aTalents Junior Recruitment Consultant Sofia Hyvärinen(+358 503613288, sofia.hyvarinen\[at\]atalent.fi). If Im unable to answer your call right away, please leave a text message and Ill get back to you as soon as possible.

jobs.title: Project Specialist, Konecranes
jobs.description:
**_Konecranes moves what matters._** _We are a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs._

_Konecranes is committed to ensuring that all employees and job applicants are treated fairly in an environment which is free from any form of discrimination._

**Would you be our new Project Specialist?**

We are looking for a Project Specialist to join Konecranes and play a key role in customer invoicing and project support activities related to crane delivery projects. In this role, you will be responsible for both external and internal customer invoicing in Finland while also supporting invoicing-related activities across the Nordic countries. You will work closely with project managers and sales teams, ensuring that invoicing, project administration and project closing activities are completed accurately and efficiently.

Your day-to-day work will focus primarily on invoicing-related tasks, including handling bank and corporate guarantees as well as credit note processes. You will support project and order closing activities in SAP and help ensure that invoicing and project processes run smoothly throughout the entire project lifecycle. In addition, you will have the opportunity to contribute to the development of processes and ways of working, and when needed, support project managers with various administrative tasks.

The position is a full-time fixed-term assignment for 12 months, with a possibility for continuation. You will be employed by Biisoni and work on assignment at Konecranes. We hope you can start as soon as possible, preferably during September 2026. The role is based in Hämeenlinna and offers a hybrid working model after the onboarding period.

**What are we looking for?**

We are looking for a professional with an interest in invoicing, project support and business processes. To succeed in this role, we hope you have previous experience in invoicing-related tasks and ideally a commercial, business, or finance-related educational background. Experience with SAP is considered a strong advantage, particularly if you have worked with invoicing or order-related processes. You communicate fluently in Finnish and have a good command of English, as you will collaborate with stakeholders in Finland and across the Nordic countries.

As a person, you are proactive, systematic and solution-oriented. You enjoy taking ownership of your work and can work independently while also collaborating effectively with stakeholders. Strong communication skills, attention to detail and the ability to solve problems are important in this role, as you will need to identify and resolve invoicing-related issues and help ensure that processes run smoothly. We also value a development-oriented mindset and an interest in improving ways of working and creating more efficient processes.

**Why join Konecranes?**

Konecranes offers you an opportunity to work in a global technology company whose solutions help keep ports and industries moving around the world. You will join an experienced and supportive team where expertise is actively shared and learning is encouraged. Through this role, you will gain broad exposure to delivery projects, project business, and SAP-based processes, giving you a comprehensive understanding of how customer projects progress from order creation all the way to final delivery and invoicing.

As your expertise grows, you will have opportunities to expand your responsibilities and explore different career paths within Konecranes. The experience gained in this role can provide a strong foundation for future opportunities in project management, project support, and specialist positions. In addition, this role supports a long-term business need, meaning there is a possibility to continue your career with Konecranes after the initial assignment period.

**Are you interested?**

If you are interested, we would love to hear from you as soon as possible. Please submit your application via the link by 20.8.2026. Interviews will be started already during the application period, and the position will be filled once the right person is found.

The recruitment process is carried out in cooperation with Biisoni. For more information on the position, please contact Elise Niinimäki, HR Coordinator, email: **elise.niinimaki@biisoni.fi**.

jobs.title: Architecte réseaux laser en espace libre (h/f) (H/F)
jobs.description:
Job Description:

Job posting in English below

Rejoignez Airbus Defence & Space !

Au sein d'Airbus Defence and Space, le rôle de l'entité Connected Intelligence (CI) est de fournir à ses clients des solutions de communications sécurisées, à haut débit, multimédia (voix, données, vidéo), disponibles à tout moment et partout dans le monde.

Pour ce faire, CI est devenu un leader mondial des communications par satellites (SATCOM) civiles et militaires capable de concevoir et opérer des infrastructures en propre ou pour ses clients. Pour maintenir ce leadership, CI mène une politique ambitieuse d'innovation afin d'étoffer son portefeuille de solutions à haute valeur ajoutée.

Dans ce but, CI cherche un/une Architecte réseaux Laser en espace libre (H/F) maîtrisant les technologies de communication par Laser et la réalisation de réseaux incluant des segments Laser :
Réseau IP conventionnels;
Réseaux point à point, point à multipoint, maillés, ... ;
Porteurs fixes et mobiles;
Milieux : spatial, aérien, terrestre, maritime.


Vous avez un intérêt pour les réseaux IP et les systèmes de communication complexes, hautement sécurisés. Vous êtes capable de faire preuve de créativité et avez l'envie de vous investir sur des sujets techniques complexes et innovants. Vous serez intégré(e) à un pôle d'ingénierie chargé de concevoir et développer les systèmes de communication de défense du futur.  

Les activités actuelles de l'équipe ont pour but d'exploiter les possibilités offertes par les technologies émergentes (laser, quantique,...) dans le cadre des services de communications sécurisés, sur tout type de support (satellite, 5G,...), en utilisant des techniques de réseaux programmables (SDN).

Vous prendrez part en tant qu'Architecte aux différents projets faisant appel aux moyens de communication Laser.

Ce poste exige une connaissance des risques potentiels de non-conformité.

Le/la titulaire s'engage à agir avec intégrité, fondement du succès et de la croissance durable de la Société.

Ce poste nécessite une habilitation de sécurité ou nécessite d'être éligible à une habilitation par les autorités reconnues.

Tâches et responsabilités :

Vous aurez les missions suivantes :
Assurer une veille technologique permanente au contact des équipes internes et des équipementiers ;
Supporter les avant ventes à savoir (ex : pédagogie envers les équipes internes et envers les clients; proposition de solutions techniques) ;
Maquetter des solutions ou des preuves de concept ;
Contribuer à la conception des solutions destinées aux clients (ex: spécification des segments Laser; Interface avec les autres composants systèmes) ;
Spécifier les évolutions nécessaires des composant Airbus Defence & Space pour implémenter ces solutions et identifier d'éventuels nouveaux composants à développer ;
Assurer le maintien de tous les documents techniques liés aux solutions proposées ;
Support et expertise aux équipes de conception et d'IVQ système.


Profil :

Vous avez la formation, les expériences et compétences suivantes :
Titulaire d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur (ou équivalent) dans le domaine des réseaux informatiques avec une spécialisation sur les systèmes optiques Laser et Optoélectronique ;
Expérience dans des environnements réseaux complexes, typés opérateurs télécom ou militaire ou WAN étendus de grands groupes ou d'OIV ;
Capacité reconnue à concevoir et réaliser des solutions techniques livrées à des clients ;
Connaissance des problématiques de transmission par laser ainsi que des réseaux IP classiques ;
Notions d'ingénierie des systèmes complexes ;
Vous êtes autonome et désireux de porter des sujets innovants ;
Vous savez travailler en équipes pluridisciplinaires et avez d'excellentes qualités relationnelles ;
Niveau de négociation en Français et avancé en Anglais.


====

Join Airbus Defence & Space !

Within Airbus Defence and Space CIS, the role of the Connected Intelligence (CI) business unit is to provide its customers with secure, high-speed, multimedia (voice, data, video) communications solutions available at any time and anywhere in the world.

To achieve this, CI has become a world leader in civil and military satellite communications (SATCOM), capable of designing and operating infrastructure on its own or for its customers. To maintain this leadership, CI is pursuing an ambitious policy of innovation to expand its portfolio of high value-added solutions.

To this end, CI is looking for a Free Space Laser Network Architect (M/F) who is proficient in laser communication technologies and the implementation of networks including laser segments:
Conventional IP network;
Point to point, point to multipoint, mesh networks, ... ;
Fixed and mobile carriers;
Environments: space, air, land, sea.


You have an interest in IP networks and complex, highly secure communication systems.

jobs.title: Sr. Manager, Business Development
jobs.description:
Replit is the agentic software creation platform that enables anyone to build applications using natural language. With millions of users worldwide, Replit is democratizing software development by removing traditional barriers to application creation.


Replit is seeking a Senior Business Development Manager to lead and scale our outbound sales development team as we expand our go-to-market efforts. This role will oversee a team of BDRs (Business Development Representatives) proactively targeting and engaging high-potential accounts to build a robust pipeline for our Account Executives.

The ideal candidate will have hands-on outbound prospecting experience and proven leadership skills, a strong understanding of the modern GTM technology, previous experience in creating systems and orchestrating technology to support an efficient & scalable 0->1 outbound workflow, and previous experience collaborating tightly with marketing and sales ops to build highly-targeted account lists and multi-channel outreach sequences. Experience & interest in vibe coding and/or technical experience is highly valued.

This position is critical to our go-to-market strategy, responsible for defining our outbound playbook, identifying key target personas, hiring top-tier talent, coaching team members, and ensuring persistent, high-quality outreach & pipeline generation across all segments from SMB to Enterprise. You'll establish the foundation for scalable revenue growth while architecting a personalized first-touch experience that sets the tone for their Replit journey.

We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for proven sales development professionals who excel in both strategic account targeting and team leadership, with a passion for technology and AI. You'll leverage your expertise to build a world-class BDR organization that effectively cuts through the noise to communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL…

 - Build, lead, and scale a high-performing team of Business Development Representatives

 - Develop and implement BDR processes, playbooks, and best practices for cold and warm-outbound channels

 - Coach and mentor BDRs on qualification methodology, objection handling, and pipeline generation techniques

 - Partner with sales leadership to provide feedback on territory assignments, quotas, performance metrics, lead handoff processes

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ensuring your team can articulate this vision compellingly

 - Collaborate with marketing and operations to optimize lead routing, provide feedback on campaign effectiveness, and improve lead quality & conversion

 - Analyze team performance data and implement strategies to improve conversion rates and meeting quality

 - Recruit, hire, and onboard new SDR/BDR team members as the organization scales

 - Maintain accountability for team quota attainment and individual BDR development

 - Work closely with Account Executives and AE leaders to ensure smooth handoffs and tight feedback loops

 - Uphold CRM hygiene and reporting accuracy across the SDR organization

 - Stay current on industry trends and competitive landscape to inform team strategy




REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - 5+ years of sales development experience with at least 3 years in a leadership or management role, preferably some with a technical ICP

 - Proven track record of building and scaling BDR teams, preferably in a high-growth environment

 - Strong individual contributor background with deep understanding of both inbound & outbound prospecting, demand gen strategies, and industry best practices

 - Excellent coaching and mentoring abilities with experience developing junior sales talent

 - Data-driven approach to performance management and process optimization

 - Outstanding written and verbal communication skills

 - Experience with CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot/SFDC, LinkedIn, ZoomInfo, Clay, SmartLead, Outreach, Default, etc)

 - Ability to recruit, interview, and assess SDR candidates effectively

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills, particularly with marketing and sales teams

 - Passion for technology and ability to quickly learn and teach complex technical concepts

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus




NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

 - You've worked at an early-stage startup or in developer tools

 - Experience building inbound SDR programs from 0-1 and/or scaling from early stage

 - Basic understanding of software development or coding concepts

 - Experience with multi-channel prospecting (email, phone, social)

 - Degree in Computer Science or related field (or equivalent practical experience)




TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE

 - Replit

 - Hubspot CRM (Salesforce coming soon)

 - ZoomInfo

 - Outreach

 - Gong

 - Chorus

 - Clay

 - SmartLead

 - Nooks

 - Default

 - LinkedIn Sales Navigator

 - Hashboard, Hex
   
   


THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF

 - You're not based in the Salt Lake City area and/or willing to relocate

 - You have no interest in understanding the software development lifecycle or learning basic coding concepts

 - You're not passionate about AI

 - You prefer individual contributor work over people management and team building

 - You're uncomfortable with a fast-paced startup environment where priorities may shift quickly



This is a full-time hybrid role and has an in-office requirement.

jobs.title: Gesundheitsberater/in
jobs.description:
Wir suchen im Homeoffice eine/n offene/n, empathische/n und kommunikationsstarke/n
**Gesundheitsberater / Gesundheits-Coach (Quereinstieg)**

Sind Sie bereit für eine sinnstiftende berufliche Neuorientierung? Wir sind zukunftsorientiert im Bereich Healty Longevity (Langes gesundes Leben unterwegs. Hier suchen wir Sie mit Lebenserfahrung, die Menschen auf ihrem Weg zu einem gesünderen Leben begleiten möchten. Auch ohne klassische Ausbildung im medizinischen Bereich ermöglichen wir Ihnen einen erfolgreichen Quereinstieg.

**Ihre Aufgaben: Was Sie erwartet**

Kunden/Interessenten Gewinnung Betreuung und Beratung
•     Sie führen Beratungsgespräche mit unseren Interessierten Kundinnen und Kunden (persönlich oder online).
•    Lösungsfindung: Sie unterstützen unsere Klienten dabei, gesundheitliche Ziele zu definieren und im Alltag umzusetzen (z.B. in den Bereichen Ernährung, Bewegung und Stressmanagement).
•    Begleitung: Sie fungieren als kontinuierlicher Ansprechpartner/in und motivieren unsere Kundinnen und Kunden auf ihrem Weg.
•    Administration: Sie erfassen die Beratungsgespräche und verwalten diese.
Ihr Profil: Was Sie mitbringen
•    Berufserfahrung: Sie haben bereits Berufserfahrung in einem anderen Tätigkeitsfeld gesammelt (z.B. aus Kundendienst, HR, Vertrieb, Pädagogik, Gastronomie oder Fitness).
•    Lebenskompetenz: Sie verfügen über eine hohe soziale Kompetenz, Empathie und ein ausgeprägtes Interesse an Gesundheitsthemen.
•    Kommunikationstalent: Sie sind ein starker Kommunikator, der gut zuhören kann und komplexe Dinge verständlich erklärt.
•    Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutschkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift Gute mündliche Kenntnisse Schweizerdeutsch(weitere Sprachen sind ein Plus).
•    Lernbereitschaft: Sie haben Freude daran, sich neues Fachwissen im Bereich Gesundheit und Prävention anzueignen.

**Unser Angebot: Was wir Ihnen bieten**
•    Strukturierter Quereinstieg: Ein umfassendes Einarbeitungsprogramm inkl. Mentoring.
•    Aus- und Weiterbildung: Interne berufsbegleitende zum zertifizierten Healthy Longevity Coach HLV Akad,).
•    Sinnstiftende Tätigkeit: Ein Job, bei dem die Gesundheit und das Wohlbefinden von Menschen im Mittelpunkt stehen.
•    Moderne Arbeitsbedingungen: Flexible Arbeitszeiten im Homeoffice
•    Faire Entlöhnung: Ein attraktives Gehaltspacket sowie gute Sozialleistungen.

Haben wir Ihr Interesse geweckt?
Wir freuen uns auf Ihre vollständigen Bewerbungsunterlagen (Lebenslauf, Motivationsschreiben mit Fokus auf Ihre Motivation für den Quereinstieg) an die hinterlegte Mail-Adresse

jobs.title: Lastbilchauffør søges til faste ture - Fredericia
jobs.description:
X max ApS søger lige nu dygtige lastbilchauffører til vores afdeling i Fredericia.

Som chauffør hos os får du en hverdag præget af faste ture med få stops. Du kender dine ruter, og vi prioriterer et roligt arbejdsmiljø uden stressende bytrafik eller konstante nye leveringsadresser. Det giver dig mulighed for at fokusere på sikker kørsel og overblik.

Du møder ind i Fredericia og kører ud på dine fastlagte ture. Arbejdstiden er fuldtid (5 dage om ugen) med ca. 10 timers effektiv arbejdstid om dagen, planlagt med fornuftige køreplaner og respekt for pauser.

 

Vi forventer, at du

  • Har et gyldigt CE-kørekort.

  • Har erfaring med kørsel med trækker og trailer.

  • Kan kommunikere på enten dansk eller engelsk – både mundtligt og skriftligt (nødvendigt for sikkerhed og kundekontakt).

  • Er ansvarsbevidst, punktlig og kan arbejde selvstændigt.

  • Sætter pris på klare rammer, faste rutiner og et velorganiseret arbejde.

Vi tilbyder

  • Høj løn – vi belønner din erfaring og indsats.

  • Faste ture – du ved, hvad du skal, og hvor du skal hen.

  • Få stops – ingen stressende jagt på mange små adresser.

  • Udgangspunkt fra vores depot i Fredericia.

  • Et stærkt team med fokus på trivsel, godt samarbejde og ordentlige forhold.

  • Et internationalt miljø, hvor vi værdsætter mangfoldighed.

Ansøgning

Er du den stabile og erfarne chauffør, vi mangler i teamet i Fredericia? Så send din ansøgning og dit CV allerede i dag. Vi ser gerne ansøgninger på både dansk og engelsk.

Send din ansøgning til: xmax-online@outlook.com Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at ringe til os på 28 19 98 18.

Vi glæder os til at høre fra dig!

X max ApS – Professionel transportløsning med personlig touch.

**************************************************************************************************************

**************************************************************************************************************

Truck Driver Wanted for Fixed Routes - Fredericia

X max ApS is currently looking for skilled truck drivers for our department in Fredericia.

As a driver with us, you will experience a workday characterized by fixed routes with few stops. You know your routes, and we prioritize a calm working environment without stressful city traffic or constantly changing delivery addresses. This allows you to focus on safe driving and maintaining an overview.

You will report to our location in Fredericia and drive your predetermined routes. This is a full-time position (5 days a week) with approximately 10 effective working hours per day, planned with sensible schedules and respect for rest breaks.

We expect that you:

  • Hold a valid CE driver’s license

  • Have experience driving with a tractor and trailer

  • Can communicate in either Danish or English – both verbally and in writing (necessary for safety and customer contact)

  • Are responsible, punctual, and able to work independently

  • Appreciate clear frameworks, fixed routines, and well-organized work

We offer:

  • High salary – we reward your experience and effort

  • Fixed routes – you know what you need to do and where you need to go

  • Few stops – no stressful rush to many small addresses

  • Base location at our depot in Fredericia

  • A strong team focused on well-being, good collaboration, and proper working conditions

  • An international environment where we value diversity

Application
Are you the stable and experienced driver we are looking for in our Fredericia team? Then send your application and CV today. We welcome applications in both Danish and English.

Send your application to: xmax-online@outlook.com
If you have questions about the position, you are welcome to call us at 28 19 98 18.

We look forward to hearing from you!

X max ApS – Professional transport solutions with a personal touch.

jobs.title: Electronics Production Technician
jobs.description:
Work tasks: The role
As an Electronics Production Technician, you will support the assembly, inspection, testing and rework of electronic components and printed circuit boards used in our products and development systems. You will work closely with our engineering team, following technical documentation and testing procedures, identifying faults and recording results accurately. Your work will help ensure that our electronic assemblies meet the required quality and performance standards. This role is suitable for someone with a vocational background or practical experience in electronics who enjoys precise, hands-on work and wants to develop their skills in an advanced engineering environment. Key responsibilities • Assemble electronic components, printed circuit boards and related systems • Inspect incoming PCB assemblies, components and solder joints visually and under a microscope • Perform soldering, cleaning, handling and rework of PCB assemblies • Carry out electrical measurements and functional testing using standard test equipment and dedicated test rigs • Identify faults, perform initial troubleshooting and escalate complex issues to engineers • Read and follow electronic schematics, datasheets, assembly instructions and testing procedures • Prepare cables, connectors and electronic connections • Record inspection, testing and rework results accurately • Maintain the traceability of components and completed work • Monitor electronic component and consumable inventory and communicate replenishment needs • Provide practical feedback and suggest improvements to assembly, testing and work procedures

We offer: What we offer
• A monthly gross salary of €2394–€3724 depending on your experience and skills • Hands-on work with advanced space and optical communication technology • Close cooperation with electronics, embedded software and mechanical engineers • The opportunity to help establish and improve assembly and testing processes as the company grows • Varied work across electronics assembly, inspection, testing, troubleshooting and production support • A small international team where your contribution has a visible impact on the final product Occasional remote work for suitable tasks may be agreed with the hiring manager. The role follows standard business hours in Estonia, with reasonable flexibility in daily starting and finishing times by agreement with the hiring manager.

Other requirements: What we are looking for
Required experience • Vocational education in electronics or equivalent practical experience • Practical experience with electronics assembly and PCB handling • Ability to read electronic schematics, component datasheets and technical instructions • Soldering and PCB rework skills • Ability to use standard electronic test equipment, including multimeters, oscilloscopes and laboratory power supplies • Ability to identify electronic components and understand their markings and package information • Basic fault-finding and troubleshooting skills • A careful, methodical and quality-focused approach • Ability to follow procedures and document work accurately • English at B2 level or above • Willingness to learn new equipment, processes and techniques We welcome applications from both experienced technicians and strong junior candidates with relevant practical skills and a solid foundation in electronics. Nice to have • Experience with surface-mount and through-hole soldering • Experience using hot-air rework equipment • Experience with FBGA rework or reballing • Experience operating pick-and-place or reflow equipment • Experience testing PCB assemblies using dedicated test rigs • Familiarity with IPC workmanship standards or relevant IPC certification • Experience maintaining production, testing or traceability records • Experience with component inventory and production consumables • Previous experience in electronics production, prototyping or a laboratory environment

Option to work from home: No

jobs.title: Animal Care Manager
jobs.description:
The Beluga Operating Company ehf is seeking an animal care manager.

What you'll bring to the team
Lead the Future of Beluga Whale Conservation
Imagine waking up each day knowing your work is helping shape the future of one of the world's most unique marine conservation projects.



At the SEA LIFE TRUST Beluga Whale Sanctuary, you'll lead an experienced team dedicated to providing world-class care for Little Grey and Little White, our resident belugas, while also overseeing the welfare of rescued puffins and our aquarium collection.



This is far more than an animal care management role. It's an opportunity to combine exceptional leadership, animal welfare expertise and conservation passion at the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.

If you're an inspiring leader with extensive experience working with cetaceans or large marine mammals, we'd love to hear from you.



As our Animal Care Manager (Curator), you'll lead all aspects of animal care, welfare and husbandry across the sanctuary.



Working closely with the General Manager and the wider SEA LIFE TRUST and Merlin Entertainments teams, you'll ensure our animals receive exceptional care while supporting scientific research, conservation, education and unforgettable guest experiences.



You'll lead, coach and develop a passionate team of animal care professionals whilst ensuring the highest standards of welfare, safety and operational excellence.

What You'll Be Doing
Leading World-Class Animal Care
Lead the care, health and welfare of our resident beluga whales, puffins and aquarium animals.
Oversee animal husbandry, enrichment, operant conditioning and behavioural management.
Ensure excellent standards across all animal habitats and life support systems.
Drive continual improvements in animal welfare and husbandry practices.
Leading and Developing People
Inspire, coach and develop a highly skilled animal care team.
Create a culture of collaboration, continuous learning and professional development.
Provide leadership during day-to-day operations and emergency response situations.
Ensure clear performance expectations and high professional standards.
Conservation & Collaboration
Work alongside veterinarians, conservation partners, researchers and animal welfare specialists.
Provide expert advice to the SEA LIFE TRUST, Merlin Entertainments and external stakeholders on cetacean care.
Support ongoing conservation programmes and future sanctuary developments.
Operational Excellence
Manage departmental budgets, veterinary services and critical animal care resources.
Ensure compliance with animal welfare legislation, licensing requirements and health & safety standards.
Oversee record keeping, husbandry documentation and life support operations.
Participate in the animal care call-out rota.
Inspiring Others
Help bring conservation to life by engaging with guests, media and local communities.
Support educational programmes and public awareness initiatives.
Act as an ambassador for the SEA LIFE TRUST and our conservation mission.
Qualifications & Experience
We're looking for someone who combines exceptional technical expertise with outstanding leadership.

You'll ideally have:

Essential
At least 10 years' experience working within a cetacean, aquarium or zoological environment, including significant leadership experience.
Extensive knowledge of marine mammal behaviour, training and welfare.
Proven experience leading and developing professional animal care teams.
Strong understanding of operant conditioning, enrichment and husbandry.
Excellent communication and decision-making skills.
Strong swimming ability and confidence working in open water.
Ability to work from boats and in challenging marine environments.
Fluent English.
Ability to obtain the legal right to live and work in Iceland.
Desirable
Degree in Zoology, Biology or a related discipline.
Experience with Life Support Systems (LSS).
Drysuit or cold-water diving qualifications.
PADI Rescue Diver (or higher).
Veterinary technical experience.
Bird rehabilitation experience.
First Aid qualification.
Experience handling cetaceans in open-water environments.
Benefits
This isn't just another animal care leadership role.



You'll be joining one of the world's most recognised marine conservation charities and helping shape the future of marine mammal welfare.



You'll have the opportunity to:

Lead the world's first open-water beluga whale sanctuary.
Work with internationally respected animal welfare experts.
Influence global conservation and welfare standards.
Develop and mentor an exceptional animal care team.
Make a genuine difference to the lives of marine animals every single day.
Live and work in the stunning natural surroundings of Iceland.
About the SEA LIFE TRUST
The SEA LIFE TRUST is a global marine conservation charity dedicated to protecting the world's oceans and marine wildlife through conservation, education and campaigning.



Our Beluga Whale Sanctuary in Iceland provides a safe, natural environment for formerly captive beluga whales while inspiring millions of people to care for our oceans.



Together, we're creating a future where marine life can thrive.



If you're an experienced animal care leader who shares our passion for conservation, welfare and exceptional animal care, we'd love to hear from you.


Apply today and help shape the future of marine conservation.

Please apply by filling in an online application here: https://form.vinnumalastofnun.is/eures/ and put "260714-06" in the field for employer.
Last application date is August 14, 2026

jobs.title: Henkilökohtainen avustaja Hankasalmen alueelle
jobs.description:
**Tule mukaan luomaan elämäsi tarinaa Avustajasi Validia Oy:lle! Haemme nyt henkilökohtaisia avustajia Hankasalmen alueelle.**

Miltä kuulostaisi merkityksellinen ja arvokas työ sinulle sopivilla työajoilla? Haluaisitko saada työkokemusta hoitoalasta näköalapaikalta, tai kaipaatko tekemistä eläkepäivien ratoksi rauhallisissa olosuhteissa yksi asiakas kerrallaan? Tule mukaan! Henkilökohtaisena avustajana meillä pääset osaksi asiakkaidemme arvokkaita tarinoita.

Validialla henkilökohtaisen avun asiakkaat ovat vammaispalvelujen piiriin kuuluvia henkilöitä. Henkilökohtainen apu on kotona tai kodin ulkopuolella tapahtuvaa avustamista niissä asioissa, joihin henkilö ei itse kykene sairauden tai vamman vuoksi. Avustaminen voi olla harrastuksissa tai opiskelussa tukemista, kodinhoidollisia askareita tai vapaa-ajan tapahtumien mahdollistamista. Toisinaan avustajan tärkeimpänä tehtävänä on olla juttukaverina ja seurana: olla se kiireetön ihminen ihmiselle. Henkilökohtaisen avustajan rooli asiakkaan arjessa on merkittävä, sillä pyrkimyksenä on tukea ja mahdollistaa kotona asuminen mahdollisimman pitkään, sekä tarjota mahdollisuus aktiiviseen ja mielekkääseen arkeen toteuttaen asiakkaan itsemääräämisoikeutta.

Työ sopii sinulle, joka kaipaat vaihtelevuutta ja satunnaisuutta työhösi työtä tehdään asiakkaan tarpeiden ja toiveiden mukaisesti. Sinulla on myös mahdollisuus vaikuttaa vuorojesi ajankohtiin yhdessä asiakkaan kanssa sopien. Työskentelet itsenäisesti ja sitoudut sovittuihin käytäntöihin. Avoimella asenteella ja omalla persoonalla pääsee pitkälle! Joustavuuden ansiosta työmme sopii niin opiskelijalle kuin eläkeläisellekin lisäansioksi. Emme edellytä sinulta alan koulutusta tai työkokemusta, mutta nämä luetaan eduksi.

**Tarjoamme sinulle**

- Työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkkauksen: Yksityisen sosiaalipalvelualan TES, palkkaluokka G15A

- Joustavan työajan

- Mahdollisuuden tutustua vammaistyöhön ja hoitoalaan

- Perehdytyksen osaamisesi mukaan

- Ammattitaitoisen huumorilla höystetyn työyhteisön tuen

- Mahdollisuuden lisäopintojen kautta työllistyä myös muihin sosiaali- ja terveysalan työtehtäviin


**Toivomme sinulta**

- Aitoa kiinnostusta avustamistyötä kohtaan

- Positiivista ja iloista asennetta

- Halua oppia uutta ja kehittyä työssäsi

- Riittävää suomen kielen taitoa, muu kielitaito katsotaan eduksi


Edellytämme sinulta Tartuntatautilain 48 §:n mukaista rokotussuojaa sekä 55 §:n mukaista tuberkuloosiselvitystä. Lisäksi tarkistamme rikosrekisteriotteen sosiaali- ja terveydenhuollon valvonnasta annetun lain mukaisesti.

Jätäthän tietosi hakulomakkeen kautta. Henkilökohtaisen avun tehtäviin tarvitaan uusia työntekijöitä sitä mukaa, kun asiakaskuntamme kasvaa. Olemme hakijoihin yhteydessä, kun hakijan ja asiakkaan tarpeet ja toiveet kohtaavat. Täytäthän hakemuksesi siis huolellisesti!
