Tarjoamme monipuolisen työn kansainvälisten asiakkaiden parissa, upeissa tunturimaisemissa ja osana pientä, ammattitaitoista työyhteisöä.

Mitä työ sisältää?

Työ on ennen kaikkea asiakaspalvelua ja opastamista. Vastaat siitä, että asiakkaamme saavat turvallisen, sujuvan ja mieleenpainuvan elämyksen.

Työtehtäviisi kuuluu esimerkiksi:

- asiakkaiden vastaanottaminen ja opastaminen

- moottorikelkka-, lumikenkä- ja muiden aktiviteettien ohjaaminen

- asiakkaiden kuljettaminen yrityksen bussilla tarvittaessa

- varusteiden valmistelu ja huolto

- kalustosta huolehtiminen

- muut matkailuyrityksen päivittäiset tehtävät


Kuljetuksia on vain osa työstä – pääpaino on asiakkaiden opastamisessa ja laadukkaan elämyksen tuottamisessa.

Toivomme sinulta

- D-ajokorttia ja voimassa olevaa kuljettajan ammattipätevyyttä

- sujuvaa suomen ja englannin kielen taitoa

- iloista ja asiakaslähtöistä työotetta

- oma-aloitteisuutta ja vastuullisuutta

- kykyä työskennellä sekä itsenäisesti että osana tiimiä


Eduksi katsomme

- aiemman kokemuksen matkailu- tai ohjelmapalvelualalta

- ensiapukoulutuksen

- muun kielitaidon

- kokemuksen moottorikelkoista tai muista ulkoaktiviteeteista


Vaikka et täyttäisi jokaista kohtaa, kannustamme silti hakemaan, jos uskot olevasi oikea henkilö tehtävään.

Mitä tarjoamme?

- Pienen ja kannustavan työyhteisön

- Edullisen, kalustetun majoituksen Kilpisjärvellä


Miksi Kilpisjärvi?

Kilpisjärvi on yksi Suomen ainutlaatuisimmista matkailukohteista. Työpäivien aikana pääset liikkumaan tuntureilla, työskentelemään kansainvälisten asiakkaiden kanssa ja kokemaan arktisen luonnon parhaimmillaan.

Vapaa-ajalla käytössäsi ovat:

- upeat vaellusreitit

- laskettelu ja maastohiihto

- kalastus

- Norjan vuonot vain noin 50 kilometrin päässä

- revontulet ja tunturiluonto aivan kotiovella


Tämä työ sopii sinulle, jos viihdyt ihmisten parissa, pidät vaihtelevista työpäivistä ja haluat viettää talven paikassa, josta moni tulee vain haaveilemaan.

Työsuhde

- Talvikausi 2026–2027

- Työsuhde tai halutessasi myös yrittäjäsopimus

- Työ alkaa sopimuksen mukaan


Kiinnostuitko?

Lähetä hakemuksesi ja kerro, miksi juuri sinä sopisit osaksi Kilpissafareiden tiimiä. Käymme hakemuksia läpi jo hakuaikana ja täytämme paikan heti sopivan henkilön löydyttyä.

jobs.title: Nurse
jobs.description:
Give your career a new dimension

Core mission:
The Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL), situated in Grenoble, France, is Europe's leading research facility for scientific research using neutrons. Every year, we host over 2000 visits by scientists, who come to the Institute to carry out world-class research.
The ESRF-ILL-EMBL medical service "SMTC" (Service de Médecine du Travail en Commun) is a joint occupational health service, whose main mission is to prevent any alteration in the health of workers because of their work. You will work together with another nurse and a medical assistant to ensure the smooth running of the service under the coordination of the Occupational Health Doctor.

Your tasks:
Your main responsibilities will be the following:
- Provide routine and emergency care
- Update staff medical records in the Medical Service software
- Prepare medical check-ups, perform additional examinations (including toxicological and radio-toxicological examinations) and monitor the health of staff
- Perform informative and preventative medical check-ups for new hires (known as "visites d'information et de prévention infirmier")
- Be the first point of contact for staff and visitors, provide advice on healthcare matters and perform vaccinations
- Manage medical equipment supplies and keep track of stocks of medications
- Schedule regular medical check-ups for staff
- Record occupational accidents and incidents on the SMTC register
- Put in place risk prevention measures and raise awareness of occupational hazards
- Carry out workstation assessments
- Take part in meetings of the CSSCT (Workplace Health and Safety Commission) and other committees
- Provide statistical data for regulatory documentation

Your profile:
- You have a French "Diplôme d'Etat d'Infirmier·ière" (or equivalent diploma) allowing you to work as a nurse in France. You have at least five years' experience, preferably in a hospital environment (emergency department, intensive care unit, etc.)
- You hold, or are currently pursing, a French "Diplôme d'Infirmier·ière en Santé au Travail (DIUST)".
- If you are not already an occupational first-aid trainer, the ILL will help you gain this qualification.
- You have sound knowledge in the area of occupational health and ensure that you keep your skills up to date with continuous professional development (CPD).
- You are proficient in the use of computer software (Word, Excel, email) and you are able to adapt quickly to new software.
- You are capable of managing emergencies, prioritising, and reporting efficiently.
- You are familiar with, or interested in learning about, the risks associated with working under ionising radiation.
- You have an excellent command of spoken and written French and English.

What we offer:

Quality of life - This position is based in Grenoble, a hub for research and technology, ideally located in the heart of the French Alps (just 3 hours from Paris/Provence by train, 1 hour from Lyon international airport and 1 ½ hours from Geneva). It is important for us that our staff achieve a healthy work-life balance. We therefore offer home working (under certain conditions), generous annual paid leave entitlement and a host of other benefits that you will discover when you arrive!

Prospects - We guarantee you a stable fixed-term contract based in Grenoble in a multicultural scientific environment.

Benefits - We offer generous social benefits (expatriation allowance, excellent health cover), moving and relocation assistance (under certain conditions) and an annual productivity bonus. We also offer language courses for you and your partner and subsidies for the use of public transport and the staff canteen, as well as for holidays and a variety of cultural and sports activities. For more details, visit https://www.ill.eu/careers/working-at-the-ill/employment-conditions.

Sounds interesting?
Then why not take your next career step with us by applying online - preferably in English - via our career portal, quoting reference number 26/34. This vacancy will remain open until we find the suitable candidate, so do not hesitate to apply as soon as possible. Please note that all applicants are subject to administrative screening (background checks). For this post, medical fitness, including for work under ionising radiation, is required. We are committed to equal opportunities and diversity and therefore welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates.

Institut Laue-Langevin (ILL) - operates Europe's leading research facility for basic research with neutrons in Grenoble (France). The passion for progress and technology unites us and makes innovation in science and research possible every day. Let's work together to change our society and our world for the better.

www.ill.eu/careers

Arbeidssted: Gardermoen flyplass

Oppstart: Så snart som mulig - intervjuer kjøres fortløpende

Stillingsprosent: 100 prosent

Hos Sixt er tempoet høyt, forventningene tydelige og kvalitet helt avgjørende. Nå søker vi flere klargjørere som vil være med på å levere førsteklasses kundeopplevelser, hver eneste dag. I din rolle hos oss som klargjører er du en nøkkelperson i driften. Det er du som sørger for at bilene våre er rene, klare og klare til levering, akkurat når kundene trenger dem. Du jobber tett med kolleger i skranke og ledelse, og bidrar til god flyt i en travel hverdag. Hos oss betyr klargjøring mer enn vask, det handler om presisjon, ansvar og kvalitet i alle ledd.

Arbeidsoppgaver:

  • Klargjøre og vaske leiebiler i henhold til Sixt sine standarder.

  • Sikre god flyt mellom bestilling, tilgjengelig bilpark og levering.

  • Registrere og følge opp skader på biler.

  • Følge opp service og dekkomlegg.

  • Håndtere utstyr som barneseter og skistativ.

  • Yte god kundeservice når situasjonen krever det.

  • Sørge for orden og struktur på arbeidsplassen.

Hvem ser vi etter?

Du liker å jobbe effektivt, tar ansvar og er opptatt av å levere et godt sluttresultat.

  • Har førerkort klasse B (manuell og automat).

  • Har plettfri vandel (politiattest kreves).

  • Jobber raskt, nøyaktig og strukturert.

  • Har høy arbeidskapasitet og god fysisk form.

  • Liker å jobbe i team og motiveres av å hjelpe andre.

  • Behersker norsk og engelsk, muntlig og skriftlig.

  • Har grunnleggende datakunnskaper.

Hva tilbyr vi?

Hos Sixt blir du en del av et selskap som vokser, og som vet at gode kundeopplevelser starter med dyktige medarbeidere.

  • En aktiv og variert arbeidshverdag på Norges største flyplass.

  • Et godt arbeidsmiljø med engasjerte kolleger.

  • Grundig opplæring og tydelige rammer.

  • Reelle utviklingsmuligheter for den som vil mer.

Klar for å bli en del av Sixt på Gardermoen? Vi vurderer søknader fortløpende, søk i dag.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Sixt Bilutleie er en internasjonal bilutleiekjede med 4500 utleiestasjoner i 118 land.  Sixt er verdens største BMW kunde og er kjent for å tilby premium biler i hele verden. Sixt er en premium utleiekjede med sterkt fokus på service, kvalitet og sikkerhet.  I Norge har vi 70 utleveringssteder og er til stede på alle de store flyplassene. Sixt i Norge har mer enn 50 års erfaring med mobilitet, og har drevet en landsdekkende kjede i 20 år. Det er Autoleie AS konsernet som har franchise rettighetene for Sixt i Norge, og har hovedkontor i Kristiansand. Konsernet er opptatt av å drive en sunn drift og har levert bransjens beste resultater de siste årene.

Kotihoidossa työsi on monipuolista, itsenäistä ja ihmisläheistä. Työskentelet asiakkaiden omissa kodeissa ja tuet heitä toimimaan arjessa turvallisesti ja mahdollisimman omatoimisesti. Työtehtäviisi kuuluvat mm.:

* Lääkehoito (osaamisen ja lupien mukaisesti)

* Terveyden kokonaisvaltainen seuranta ja mittaukset

* Asiakkaan toimintakyvyn ja hyvinvoinnin tukeminen

Kotihoidossa jokainen työpäivä on erilainen. Pääset hyödyntämään ammattitaitoasi laaja-alaisesti ja tekemään työtä, jolla on todellista merkitystä asiakkaiden arjessa.

* Merkityksellisen, arvostetun ja itsenäisen työn

* Mahdollisuuden hyödyntää laajasti omaa osaamistasi

* Yksityisen sosiaalialan työehtosopimuksen mukaisen palkan

MITÄ TOIVOMME SINULTA?

* Lähihoitajan tutkintoa ja voimassa olevia lupia

* Asiakaslähtöistä, vastuullista ja lämminhenkistä työotetta

* Kykyä itsenäiseen työskentelyyn ja päätöksentekoon

* Erinomaista suomen kielen taitoa

* Oman auton käyttömahdollisuus katsotaan eduksi, sillä liikut asiakaskohteiden välillä

jobs.description:
Hos CityFys søger vi en engageret og dygtig massør til vores virksomhedsordninger i Aarhus – uanset om du er nyuddannet eller har flere års erfaring! Vi er på udkig efter en passioneret massør, der ønsker at arbejde i et udviklende og støttende miljø, hvor du kan gøre en forskel for vores kunder.

Hvorfor CityFys?

Som massør hos CityFys får du stor frihed under ansvar og fleksible arbejdstider, så du kan tilpasse arbejdet efter dit liv. Vi tror på kontinuerlig udvikling og opfordrer dig til at eksperimentere med forskellige massageteknikker, der passer til hver kundes unikke behov. Hos os bliver du en del af vores "lille-STORE-familie" – et team af professionelle behandlere, der arbejder tæt sammen om at skabe den bedste oplevelse for kunderne.

Vi værdsætter både personlig og faglig vækst, og vi skaber et arbejdsmiljø, hvor din passion for at hjælpe andre bliver anerkendt og belønnet.

Hos CityFys er vores mål at være Danmarks bedste arbejdsplads for massører og levere kvalitetsbehandlinger til vores kunder.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Faste og attraktive behandlingsdage i CityFys’ virksomhedsordninger og i egen klinik

  • Mulighed for ekstra vikaropgaver og fleksible timer

  • Gratis og løbende efteruddannelse, herunder kurser i triggerpunkter, ergonomi, stretching og meget mere. Læs om kurserne her: CityFys kurser

  • Fordelagtige vilkår, inklusiv fitness- og sundhedsordning

  • Fleksibel aflønning – enten per faktura eller som dataløn

  • Løbende support og sparring, så du kan udvikle dig i dit tempo

Er du klar til at tage din karriere som massør til næste niveau?

Send din ansøgning via vores hjemmeside: http://cityfys.dk/søg-job/  
Vi tilbyder hurtig tiltrædelse og glæder os til at høre fra dig!

Har du spørgsmål? Ring til os på tlf. 70 200 726.

Om CityFys:
CityFys A/S er Danmarks største leverandør af massageordninger og betjener flere af landets største virksomheder. Vi har været i branchen siden 1999 og driver egne wellnessafdelinger i DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen København og Water & Wellness Randers.

 

English version:

At CityFys, we are looking for an engaged and skilled masseur for our corporate programs in Aarhus – whether you're newly graduated or have several years of experience! We are seeking a passionate masseur who wants to work in a supportive and developmental environment where you can make a difference for our clients.

Why CityFys?

As a masseur at CityFys, you’ll have great freedom with responsibility and flexible working hours, allowing you to adapt your work to your life. We believe in continuous development and encourage you to experiment with different massage techniques tailored to each client’s unique needs. With us, you will become part of our "small-BIG family" – a team of professional therapists who work closely together to create the best experience for our clients.

We value both personal and professional growth, and we create a work environment where your passion for helping others is recognized and rewarded.

At CityFys, our goal is to be Denmark's best workplace for masseurs and to deliver high-quality treatments to our clients.

We offer:

  • Fixed and attractive treatment days in CityFys’ corporate programs and in oue own clinic

  • Opportunity for additional substitute work and flexible hours

  • Free and ongoing further education, including courses in trigger points, ergonomics, stretching, and much more. Read about the courses here: CityFys courses

  • Beneficial conditions, including fitness and health plans

  • Flexible compensation – either per invoice or as salary

  • Ongoing support and guidance, allowing you to develop at your own pace

Are you ready to take your career as a masseur to the next level?

Send your application via our website: CityFys Job Postings
We offer quick onboarding and look forward to hearing from you!

Have any questions? Call us at +45 70 200 726.

About CityFys:
CityFys A/S is Denmark's largest provider of massage services and serves some of the country's largest companies. We have been in the industry since 1999 and run our own wellness departments at DGI Huset Herning, DGI Byen Copenhagen, and Water & Wellness Randers.

jobs.title: Produktförvaltare Data till Produktförvaltning
jobs.description:
Vill du vara med och stärka hur Ålandsbanken arbetar med datakvalitet, datastyrning och uppföljning inom finansieringsområdet? Vi söker nu en Produktförvaltare Data som vill bidra till att utveckla våra arbetssätt och skapa långsiktig nytta för både verksamheten och våra kunder. I rollen får du en central position i utvecklingen av hur data används, kvalitetssäkras och följs upp inom banken. Du bidrar till att vår data är korrekt, spårbar och ändamålsenlig – både för affärsstyrning, rapportering och regulatoriska krav.

Din roll

Som Produktförvaltare Data ingår du i Produktförvaltningens processeffektiviseringsteam. Här får du en viktig roll i att utveckla arbetssätt, kontroller och uppföljning som stärker bankens användning av data. I nära samarbete med verksamheten, Data Governance och IT bidrar du till att omsätta behov och krav till praktiska lösningar som skapar värde i det dagliga arbetet.

I rollen arbetar du bland annat med att:

- Utveckla, definiera och följa upp kontroller för datakvalitet, dataflöden och affärsregler.

- Identifiera och driva förbättringar som gör data mer tillförlitlig, spårbar och användbar.

- Samverka med olika delar av organisationen, framför allt verksamheten, Data Governance och IT.

- Medverka i kravställning, testning, prioritering och uppföljning kopplat till regelverk, rapportering och verksamhetens behov.


Din bakgrund

Vi söker dig som har erfarenhet av arbete med data, analys, informationshantering eller uppföljning och som har god förståelse för processer, interna kontroller och hur krav kan omsättas till fungerande arbetssätt.

Du har högskoleutbildning med system- eller ekonomisk inriktning, alternativt motsvarande relevant arbetserfarenhet. Eftersom vårt arbetsspråk är svenska behöver du behärska svenska väl i både tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet från bank, finans eller annan reglerad verksamhet, särskilt inom finansieringsområdet. Tidigare kunskap inom finansieringsområdet och goda kunskaper i engelska ser vi också som värdefullt.

Din profil

För att trivas och lyckas i rollen tror vi att du är strukturerad, analytisk och initiativrik. Du har förmåga att driva frågor framåt, skapa struktur i en roll under utveckling och kommunicera tydligt och pedagogiskt med både verksamhet och tekniska intressenter. Du samarbetar gärna tvärfunktionellt, anpassar dig till ändrade förutsättningar och motiveras av att förstå samband, förbättra flöden och skapa lösningar som gör verklig nytta för både verksamheten och bankens kunder.

Om du vill kombinera verksamhetsförståelse, data, analys och förändringsarbete i en roll med hög påverkan, ser vi fram emot din ansökan.

Att bli en del av oss

Som del av vårt team får du vara med där det händer. Vi erbjuder dig en engagerad arbetsplats där du får möjlighet att arbeta tillsammans med ett ambitiöst och lösningsfokuserat team. Arbetet är intressant med mångsidiga arbetsuppgifter och goda möjligheter att utvecklas inom finansieringsområdet.

Här kan du läsa mer om vad vi erbjuder dig som blir en del av laget Ålandsbanken!

https://www.alandsbanken.ax/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Mariehamn)

https://www.alandsbanken.fi/sv/om-oss/karriar/arbeta-pa-alandsbanken (Helsingfors)

Vill du veta mer?

Tjänsten är en tillsvidareanställning med placering i Mariehamn eller Helsingfors.

Närmare upplysningar kring tjänsten ges av Avdelningschef Johanna Beeks, Johanna.Beeks@alandsbanken.fi.

Sista ansökningsdag för tjänsten är den 16.08.2026. Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningsperioden.

Välkommen med din ansökan – vi ser fram emot att höra från dig!

jobs.title: Work based learning Tusla Training School - Special Care Services
jobs.description:
In order to work in Ireland a non-EEA National, unless they are exempted, must hold a valid employment permit. Please review the Eligibility and requirements for an employment permit if you are unsure of your eligibility to apply for this vacancy.
The Child and Family Agency was established on 1st January 2014 and is responsible for a range of statutory functions including provision of child protection, alternative care, specified regulatory services and a range of family support services. Further information is available on www.tusla.ie The policy of the Child and Family Agency to enable children to live with their own families wherever possible and to support parents where necessary in fulfilling that role. In circumstances where this is not possible, Residential Care incl. Special Care remains a valuable option for children who cannot be cared for at home. Entry requirements: Be registered in the Social Care Workers Register maintained by the Social Care Workers Registration Board maintained by CORU. or Hold a CORU approved Social Care Worker qualification and have applied for CORU registration (evidence of application will be necessary) or Hold one of the following qualifications and be committed to a pathway towards Social Care education: Youth and Community work qualification BA (Hons) Youth and Community Development BA (Hons) Psychology Addiction Studies (Level 7) BA (Hons) Counselling and Addiction Studies Disability Diploma (Primary Care) Degree in Social Science (minimum Level 7) Purpose of role: This programme involves 3 months classroom-based learning followed by 3 months’ work placement in Tusla Special Care Unit in Dublin. The purpose of the post is to provide the employee with on the job learning opportunities as a work-based learner in social care with access to shadow a social care worker, learn social care skills while providing direct administration support to the social care services that seeks to improve the health and social wellbeing of the service users within the context of local communities and children’s residential and special care services. On successful completion of the 6-month programme and evidence of competency assessment, you will be offered a permanent contract of employment Main duties and responsibilities: To participate in the development and implementation of Care and Placement Plans and to ensure appropriate recording of same. To promote the rights and responsibilities of each child/young person within the centre. To promote physical, emotional, social and religious welfare of each young person in care. To encourage attendance at school, training centres, medical and clinical appointments. To be responsible for the organisation of personal documents, arrangements, information and finance on behalf of the young person. To liaise with the parent, family, general services and other agencies on behalf of the young person. To attend meetings in relation to the care and developments of the young person. To undertake various aspects of home management including the household budget, upkeep and cleaning.

jobs.title: Tutor | Mentor | Lektiehjælper | Online | Privatunderviser | Folkeskole og gymnasie
jobs.description:
Engagerede tutorer søges!

Arbejdssted: Online (eller nær dit hjem)
Ansættelsesform: Deltid/Freelance
Ansøgningsfrist: Hurtigst muligt

Om os:
Tutora er en innovativ og voksende virksomhed, som tilbyder privat lektiehjælp til elever i folkeskolen og gymnasiet både online og fysisk. Vi tror på, at den rette undervisning kan gøre en verden til forskel, og derfor søger vi engagerede og dygtige tutorer, som vil være med på vores tutorteam.

Jobbeskrivelse:
Som tutor hos Tutora vil du få mulighed for at undervise elever i forskellige fag og hjælpe dem med at opnå deres mål. Vi søger tutorer inden for følgende områder:

  • Dansk

  • Matematik

  • Nat.vid. fag (fysik, kemi, biologi m.m.)

  • Humanistiske og samf.vid. fag (engelsk, samfundsfag, tysk m.m.)

Dine ansvarsområder:

  • Forberedelse og gennemførelse af undervisningslektioner online og/eller fysisk.

  • Løbende kommunikation med elever og forældre om fremskridt, planlægning m.m.

Vi forventer at du:

  • Har stærke faglige kompetencer inden for et eller flere af de ovennævnte fag.

  • Er tålmodig, engageret og brænder for at hjælpe andre med at lære.

  • Kan tage ansvar og administrere et undervisningsforløb fra start til slut selvstændigt og pålideligt.

  • Har erfaring med undervisning eller tutoring (ikke et krav, men en fordel).

Vi tilbyder:

  • Fleksible arbejdstider, der kan tilpasses din kalender.

  • En meningsfuld og givende rolle, hvor du kan gøre en forskel.

  • Konkurrencedygtig løn baseret på erfaring og kvalifikationer (145 - 170 DKK/time).

  • Et støttende og venligt arbejdsmiljø.

Ansøgning:
Er du klar til at blive en del af vores tutorteam og hjælpe elever med at nå deres fulde potentiale? SEND DIN ANSØGNING HER. Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os på 28962740 eller via email på info@tutora.dk.

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig!

jobs.title: Uppsökande ungdomsarbete

jobs.description:
Sveps ungdomsverkstaden lediganslår ett vikariat inom uppsökande ungdomsarbete 25.9.2026-17.9.2027.

Som anställd inom det uppsökande ungdomsarbetet är dina arbetsuppgifter att handleda och stöda unga som saknar arbete eller studieplats. Du arbetar utgående från den ungas behov och förutsättningar, stöder de unga i bl.a. vardags- och livshanteringsfrågor, hjälpa dessa finna de tjänster som de är i behov av samt förbereder den unga att ta emot rätt sorts stöd. Arbetet är självständigt i dialog med den unga, med ett nära samarbete med uppsökande teamet samt med Sveps övriga personal.

Som uppsökare förutsätts du ha god kännedom om samhällets välfärdstjänster, erfarenhet av nätverksarbete och god samarbetsförmåga. Du förväntas ha en god kompetens i bemötande av personer i olika livssituationer och med olika bakgrund. Du bör ha utmärkta kunskaper i svenska (muntligt och skriftligt) samt förmåga att arbeta på finska.

Vi önskar att du har högskoleexamen och mångårig arbetserfarenhet inom det pedagogiska, sociala området eller annan lämplig bransch. Vi uppskattar speciellt erfarenhet av arbete med unga.

För att kunna genomföra ett gott arbete skall du ha god initiativförmåga och arbeta lösningsorienterat.

Vi erbjuder dig ett omväxlande och intressant arbete i en trevlig arbetsgemenskap i centrala Helsingfors.

jobs.description:
Vi søker en dyktig og engasjert tømrer for oppdrag hos våre kunder. Som tømrer vil du få varierte oppdrag innen nybygg, rehabilitering, innredning og vedlikehold. As a carpenter, you will receive varied assignments within new construction, rehabilitation, interior design and maintenance.

Hva vi ser etter

  • Fagbrev som tømrer eller solid erfaring fra byggebransjen.

  • Gode ferdigheter i bruk av relevante verktøy og maskiner.

  • Selvstendig, løsningsorientert og med god arbeidskapasitet.

  • Positiv holdning til samarbeid og kommunikasjon med kolleger og kunde.

  • Førerkort klasse B er en fordel.

Arbeidsoppgaver

  • Utføre prefabrikkert og tradisjonelt tømrerarbeid i boliger og næringsbygg.

  • Montering av reisverk, tak, gulv og innredning.

  • Lesing av tegninger og samarbeid med prosjektleder for å sikre fremdrift og kvalitet.

  • Delta i planlegging av arbeidsoppgaver og bidra til et godt arbeidsmiljø på byggeplass.

  • Sørge for orden og sikkerhet på arbeidsstedet.

Perform prefabricated and traditional carpentry work in residential and commercial buildings. Installation of ceilings, floors and interior decoration.

Vi tilbyr

Vi vurderer kandidater fortløpende.

If you do not have your own home in Bergen, we can help you with this.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

Nordvest Bemanning AS er et bemanningsbyrå med lang erfaring innen formidling og utleie av faglært arbeidskraft. Vi rekrutterer i dag medarbeidere til et bredt utvalg av fagområder. Selskapet ble etablert i 2005, og har siden den gang hatt en positiv utvikling i forhold til kunder og oppdrag. Vårt hovedkontor ligger på Askøy like utenfor Bergen og vi er i dag et team på 150 medarbeidere.

Nordvest Bemanning AS is a recruitment agency with great experience in provision and hiring of skilled labour. We are currently recruiting employees for a wide range of specialist areas. The company was established in 2005, and since then has had a positive development in relation to customers and assignments. Our head office is located on Askøy just outside Bergen and we are at the moment a team of 150 co-workers.

jobs.title: Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Lappeenrantaan
jobs.description:
**Haemme liikenteenohjaajia datakeskushankkeelle Lappeenrantaan.**

**Työt alkavat elokuun/syyskuun aikana.**

**Keitä olemme?**

Ramudden luo kokonaisvaltaisia työturvallisuusratkaisuja tietöihin, rakennuksiin, tiloihin, rautateille ja erilaisiin infrastruktuurin projekteihin. Teemme työmme turvallisesti ja välittäen!

**Ketä haemme?**

Haemme liikenteenohjaajia Lappeenrannassa sijaitsevalle datakeskushankkeelle.

Mitä tarjoamme? Tarjoamme turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön. Tavoitteenamme on varmistaa se, että sinä ja kaikki muut liikenteessä liikkujat pääsevät turvallisesti töihin tai kouluun sekä takaisin kotiin. Minne sitten olettekin matkalla, turvaamme matkasi!

**Mitä työ sisältää?**

Liikenteenohjaajan työhön kuuluu varmistaa työmaan läpikulkevan liikenteen turvallinen kulku ja eteneminen. Liikenteenohjauksessa työskennellään useimmiten pareittain. Pidämme huolta myös kollegoistamme.

**Mitä vaaditaan?**

Sinun tulee olla täysi-ikäinen

Sinulla tulee olla normaalit aistit: näkö, kuulo ja reaktiokyky

Sinulla tulee olla vähintään AM121 tai B-luokan ajokortti

Odotamme liikenteenohjaajiltamme myös hyvää liikennetuntemusta.

**Koulutamme ja perehdytämme sinut tehtävään alla olevien koulutusten avulla:**

Tieturva 1-koulutus

Työturvallisuuskoulutus

Liikenteenohjaajan pätevyys

**Palkkaa maksamme Asfalttialan työehtosopimuksen (TES) mukaisesti.**

**Sen lisäksi tarjoamme sinulle:**

Turvallisen ja ammattitaitoisen työyhteisön

Laadukkaat työvälineet ja -varusteet

Reilun ja tasapuolisen kohtelun

Mahdollisuuden edetä uralla sekä

Erilaisia työsuhde-etuja

**Lisätietoja arkisin klo 9–15;**

**Alfons Lindfors, 0400606325, alfons.lindfors@ramudden.fi**

**Johanna Järvinen, 0400442955, johanna.jarvinen@ramudden.fi**

jobs.title: Talent Management
jobs.description:
WHO WE ARE

Notion is the collaborative AI workspace where teams and agents think together https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=vkpYpWfEK5s. We're building one place where your knowledge, projects, meetings, and AI tools live side by side, so work is faster, clearer, and less fragmented. Millions of individuals, small teams, and large companies run their work on Notion.



Notinos (our employees) are customer zero in bringing this future of work to life. We care about craft, building things that last, and the belief that great work is still fundamentally human. Our goal isn’t to ship the next feature. Each and every team of Notinos is working to set the standard for how humans work together in the AI era. From building a business’s system of record to making and managing AI agents to automating away the busy work, we care deeply about giving our customers more time for their life’s work.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Notion is entering a new chapter of People work: more AI-native, more strategic, and more focused on building systems that help every Notino do the best work of their career. We're building toward a four-pronged People Consulting model:



1) Strategic People Partners who steer orgs as the consultative layer closest to the business.

2) Talent Management is the systems and programmatic engine layer — talent programs, systems and resourcing work that support our People Partners & talent density.

3) People Relations is the primary arm and escalation point for employee relations.

4) People Operations owns the operational layer of the end-to-end employee lifecycle, a layer we're increasingly scaling through agentic services.



We are looking for the right person to join our existing Talent Management arm. This person will help define, operationalize, and continuously improve how we grow talent at Notion. This role sits at the intersection of talent philosophy, people partner strategy and enablement.



This is not a siloed program role. It is an extension of our strategic People Partner & Talent Management org: someone who brings deep talent management craft, strong business judgment, and the operating muscle to turn philosophy into practice across the company.




WHAT YOU’LL OWN

1) Maintain and operationalize Notion’s talent philosophies

 - Codify and evolve our talent philosophies across performance, growth, leadership, career development, internal mobility, early career, and high-performance expectations.

 - Translate principles into practical tools, rituals, and operating mechanisms that People Partners and leaders can use.

 - Ensure our philosophies stay connected to business needs, company strategy, and the realities of how work is changing.

2) Ensure the talent systems we build are durable and make talent expectations clear, consistent, and actionable — without over-programming or adding unnecessary process.

 - Co-build the programmatic layer & talent engine for People Partners

 - Help steer and co-build the overall talent enablement engine equipping People Partners to drive higher-quality actions with leaders. If People Partners are consultants, our talent management arm builds the resources to enable talent density.

 - Keep our core philosophies aligned with our deployment-ready materials: playbooks, manager guides, conversation frameworks, decision tools, calibration support, and coaching resources.

 - Partner closely with strategic People Partner leaders to identify where enablement is needed most and how it should show up in the business. Develop net new, creative strategies aligned with Notion’s values and vision.

 - Ensure People Partners are not just consuming talent programs, but actively shaping and deploying them with context and judgment.

3) Enable talent density

 - Bring the taste, craft, and pattern recognition to understand what different talent segments need to grow.

 - Design self-service strategies & actions that help leaders develop talent

 - Power up our mechanisms to better identify, engage, stretch, and retain talent.

 - Enable our leadership bench.

4) Lead fluid, high-leverage talent strategy projects

This role will flex into the highest-priority talent questions of the moment. Examples of historical and potential high-impact projects include:

 - Early career strategy enablement: helping define the scaffolding, manager expectations, growth model, and experience needed to make Notion a definitive launchpad for early-career talent.

 - Total rewards exploration: partnering with Total Rewards, Talent, and People leaders to explore what recognition could look like in a more AI-native, high-performance environment.

 - Role architecture for the next generation of work: rethinking how roles, levels, career paths, and talent systems should evolve as AI changes what people can do.

 - Internal mobility and talent flow: partnering with People Ops, Recruiting and People partners in creating clearer, higher-touch pathways for high-slope talent to find the right next opportunity inside Notion.

 - Leadership expectations: supporting the translation of Notion’s leadership philosophy into practical enablement for managers and leaders.




HOW YOU’LL WORK

 - Embedded, not independent: You will work as an extension of strategic People Partner leaders and existing Talent Management team, not as a separate talent silo.

 - Strategic + practical: You can shape philosophy at 10,000 feet and turn it into an executable V1 strategy in a week – not for the purpose of moving fast, but for getting opinions and engagement of the right solution fast.

 - High taste, low ego: You have strong opinions about what great talent work looks like, but you build through partnership and field feedback.

 - Systems-minded: You design for repeatability and leverage, while knowing when to do the unscalable thing first.

 - Business-first: You anchor talent work in company outcomes, not HR activity.

 - AI-native and Notion-powered: You are energized by reimagining how talent work should change when AI can remove manual coordination and amplify judgment. You also understand how Notion can support our initiatives.

 - Path-agnostic: You’re glad to start as an individual contributor and build the case for a team through impact, not title.




SKILLS YOU’LL NEED TO BRING

 - Significant experience designing, scaling, and evolving talent management strategies and programs (e.g. performance, talent reviews, succession planning, career architecture, or related initiatives).

 - Proven ability to influence senior leaders and drive cross-functional change without formal authority.

 - Experience translating ambiguous talent philosophies into scalable tools, frameworks, and operating mechanisms.

 - Strong business acumen and organizational judgment, with the ability to connect talent decisions to company outcomes.

 - Excitement for reimagining talent management in an AI-native world.



Notion is committed to providing highly competitive cash compensation, equity, and benefits. The compensation offered for this role will be based on multiple factors such as location, the role’s scope and complexity, and the candidate’s experience and expertise, and may vary from the range provided below. For roles based in San Francisco or New York City, the estimated base salary range for this role is $230,000 - $270,000 per year.



By clicking “Submit Application”, I understand and agree that Notion and its affiliates and subsidiaries will collect and process my information in accordance with Notion’s Global Recruiting Privacy Policy https://notion.notion.site/Notion-Global-Recruiting-Privacy-Policy-fc3eb4e829354a26a2bb6fd5e289b550?pvs=74 and NYLL 144 https://notion.notion.site/Ashby-AI-Bias-Audit-2b0efdeead05803bbbfae159ec86c528. #LI-Onsite




A NOTE ON AI

You don’t need deep AI expertise for every role, but we do expect every Notino to be intellectually curious, drawn to tinkering and discovery, and excited to use AI as a real collaborator in their work. For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement — when that’s the case, we'll say so explicitly in the qualifications. People who thrive here don’t treat AI as a novelty. They use it to think better, and make their work easier for others to build on.




EQUAL OPPORTUNITY & ACCOMMODATIONS

We hire talented people from a wide range of backgrounds. If you’re excited about this role but don’t meet every bullet, we still encourage you to apply. Notion is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of any legally protected characteristic. Consistent with applicable law, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. Notion provides reasonable accommodations during the application process; if you need one, please let your recruiter know.



Notion is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate in hiring or any employment decision based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, genetic information, veteran status, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or other applicable legally protected characteristic. Notion considers qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Notion is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If you need assistance or an accommodation due to a disability, please let your recruiter know.

jobs.title: Architecte Systèmes et Virtualisation VMware (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Le consultant devra réaliser un état des lieux du parc de virtualisation existant analyser les usages et fonctionnalités VMware réellement activés recueillir et structurer les besoins des équipes techniques et des métiers comparer les solutions alternatives disponibles sur le marché évaluer leur couverture fonctionnelle, leur maturité et leur capacité à supporter les volumes concernés étudier les possibilités de migration et les contraintes de réversibilité définir les scénarios cibles possibles construire une trajectoire technologique à moyen et long terme piloter ou préparer des preuves de concept animer les différents experts internes synthétiser les conclusions restituer les recommandations aux DSI et aux instances de direction.

Profil recherché

Description du profil :

Le besoin porte sur un Lead Architecte ou Architecte transverse senior , avec une véritable posture de consultant stratégique.

Les compétences indispensables

Les compétences indispensables sont une forte expérience d'architecture VMware une expérience significative sur OpenStack une bonne connaissance des solutions alternatives de virtualisation une expérience des infrastructures à très grande échelle une compréhension des problématiques de datacenter, de réseau, de stockage et de matériel une capacité à raisonner comme un fournisseur de cloud privé une expérience de l'industrialisation et de la mise à disposition rapide de services une capacité à construire et défendre une conviction technologique une excellente aptitude à l'animation, à la synthèse et à la restitution auprès de dirigeants.

Attentes sur la posture

Le candidat ne doit pas être uniquement un administrateur ou un architecte technique spécialisé dans l'exploitation.

Il doit être capable de prendre de la hauteur, d'organiser une étude, d'encadrer les expertises techniques et de produire des recommandations facilitant la prise de décision de la direction.

Dimension de l'environnement

Dimension de l'environnement

Le consultant interviendra sur une infrastructure d'une taille très importante, équivalente à plusieurs dizaines de milliers de machines ou d'unités techniques.

Une expérience limitée à des plateformes unitaires, des prototypes ou des environnements de petite taille ne sera pas suffisante Contraintes liées

Le profil devra comprendre les contraintes liées au fonctionnement d'un cloud provider interne à l'industrialisation des déploiements aux infrastructures majoritairement hébergées sur site au déploiement de services nécessitant du matériel ;

à une trajectoire de transformation sur trois à quatre ans

jobs.title: RN & LPT (Global Search)
Assurance qualité (H/F)
jobs.description:
Description du poste :

Location: Gémenos, France

Construisons ensemble un avenir de confiance

Thales est un leader mondial des hautes technologies spécialisé dans trois secteurs d'activité : Défense & Sécurité, Aéronautique & Spatial, et Cyber & Digital. Il développe des produits et solutions qui contribuent à un monde plus sûr, plus respectueux de l'environnement et plus inclusif. Le Groupe investit près de 4,5 milliards d'euros par an en Recherche & Développement, notamment dans des domaines clés de l'innovation tels que l'IA, la cybersécurité, le quantique, les technologies du cloud et la 6G. Thales compte près de 85 000 collaborateurs dans 65 pays.

Nos engagements, vos avantages***Une réussite portée par notre excellence technologique, votre expérience et notre ambition partagée***Un package de rémunération attractif***Un développement des compétences en continu : parcours de formation, académies et communautés internes***Un environnement inclusif, bienveillant et respectant l'équilibre des collaborateurs***Un engagement sociétal et environnemental reconnu

Votre quotidien

En nous rejoignant à Gémenos, vous intégrez un site localisé entre mer et collines provençales, regroupant nos activités d'identité et de sécurité numériques et nos activités de défense alliant à la fois ingénierie et production, et favorisant un environnement de travail collaboratif et convivial.

Au sein de l'équipe Qualité Offres et Projets, vous contribuez à sécuriser les offres stratégiques et à garantir leur faisabilité technique, opérationnelle et financière avant leur contractualisation.

En tant que Bid Quality Assurance Manager, vous serez en charge de Évaluer la conformité des offres en vérifiant l'application des processus, procédures et bonnes pratiques qualité tout au long de la phase d'avant-vente.***Analyser les risques qualité, techniques, opérationnels et organisationnels afin d'anticiper les impacts potentiels sur l'exécution future des projets et proposer des plans d'actions adaptés.***Accompagner les équipes offres dans l'identification des écarts, la résolution des problématiques et la mise en œuvre des actions préventives et correctives nécessaires à la sécurisation des propositions commerciales.***Contrôler la prise en compte et la bonne gestion des exigences clients, qu'elles soient techniques, contractuelles ou organisationnelles, par l'ensemble des contributeurs de l'offre.***Vérifier la qualité, la cohérence et l'exhaustivité de la documentation produite afin de garantir une transition efficace entre la phase d'offre et la phase projet.***Conseiller la Direction et les parties prenantes en produisant des analyses objectives sur les risques identifiés, tout en contribuant au développement des compétences des équipes grâce à des actions de coaching, de mentorat et de partage des bonnes pratiques.

Votre profil

- Votre priorité est de sécuriser des offres complexes et stratégiques tout en maîtrisant les risques associés Vous avez l'ambition d'accompagner des équipes multidisciplinaires dans l'amélioration continue de leurs pratiques qualité Vous avez envie de contribuer à des projets d'envergure internationale au sein d'un environnement technologique exigeant ?

Vous disposez d'un diplôme d'Ingénieur en génie logiciel, informatique ou domaine équivalent et justifiez de plus de 15 années d'expérience dans les domaines techniques, la gestion d'offres et/ou la gestion de projets sur Les processus, méthodes et outils d'assurance qualité La gestion d'offres, la gestion de projets et les activités d'achats Le développement logiciel, les tests, la validation et l'intégration de systèmes Les référentiels qualité, notamment la norme ISO 9001.

La maîtrise courante de l'anglais, à l'écrit comme à l'oral, est indispensable pour ce poste.

Le leadership, la capacité d'analyse, le sens de l'organisation et l'aptitude à fédérer des équipes autour d'objectifs communs sont des atouts que l'on vous reconnaît ?

Alors ce poste est fait pour vous !

At Thales we provide CAREERS and not only jobs. With Thales employing 80,000 employees in 68 countries our mobility policy enables thousands of employees each year to develop their careers at home and abroad, in their existing areas of expertise or by branching out into new fields. Together we believe that embracing flexibility is a smarter way of working. Great journeys start here, apply now!

  • Odgovornost i proaktivnost u radu

jobs.description:

  • Planiranje i organiziranje održavanja: izrada plana godišnjeg preventivnog održavanje, definira godišnje ciljeve i aktivnosti koji su uključeni u pripremu strategije tvrtke, sudjeluje u pripremi pokazatelja vrijednosti za ciljeve, sudjeluje u pripremi programa upravljanja okolišem koji su uključeni u planiranje i organiziranje investicijskih projekata, organiziranje provođenja redovitih mišljenja o stanju strojeva i opreme te otklanja pronađene pogreške.
  • Vodi i kontrolira provedbu investicijskih projekata i nadgleda provedbu redovitih preventivnih pregleda strojeva i uređaja, prati i daje izvješća o zastojima u radu i poteškoćama, kontrolira otklanjanje kvarova, potvrđuje interne naloge za održavanje, upravlja troškovima održavanja za postizanje ciljeva i maksimiziranje dobiti, priprema sve potrebne izvještaje.
  • Planira i izrađuje ciljeve za podređene zaposlenike, sudjeluje u izradi plana obrazovanja i osposobljavanja i osposobljavanja na radnom mjestu, utvrđuje učinkovitost obrazovanja i osposobljavanja, ocjenjuje rad i izvedbu podređenih zaposlenika, predlaže nagrade i promocije, organizira vođenje evidencije prisutnosti i odsutnosti s rada svojih podređenih, potiče zaposlenike na davanje korisnih prijedloga, organizira mentorstvo, potiče zaposlenike da prijavljuju eventualne opasnosti od nezgode i ozljede na radu.
  • Komunicira interno, te prema vani, voditelj je u procesu rada prema podređenim zaposlenicima i dobavljačima.
  • Sudjelovanje u procesu racionalizacije potrošnje energije.
  • Sudjelovanje u projektnim timovima, praćenje provedbe, kontrola projektne dokumentacije.
  • Poznavanje propisa i promjena u zakonodavstvu i njihovo uvođenje u provedbu postavljenih zadaća.
  • Za vrijeme svoje odsutnosti, iz bilo kojeg razloga, dužan je osigurati da se rad obavlja bez problema i osigurati zamjenu.
  • Obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu rukovoditelja.
  • Odgovornost za realizaciju planova održavanja u pogonu.
  • Odgovornost za funkcioniranje elektro i strojnog održavanja.
  • Odgovornost za rad u skladu sa Zakonom o radu, Zakonom o očuvanju okoliša i zahtjevima sustava ISO standarda.
  • Odgovornost za funkcionalnu i pouzdanu raspoloživost strojeva za proizvodnju.
  • Odgovornost za racionalno i učinkovito korištenje i naručivanje rezervnih dijelova.

jobs.title: 2. SPASILAC / SPASITELJICA
jobs.description: Na temelju članka 30. Statuta, ravnatelj ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Trg Krešimira Ćosića 11, Zagreb, raspisuje J AV N I N A T J E Č A J za prijam radnika u radni odnos na neodređeno vrijeme 2. Naziv radnog mjesta: SPASILAC (m/ž) – 4 izvršitelja/izvršiteljice Rad s punim radnim vremenom, neodređeno vrijeme uz probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci Mjesto rada: Zagreb Sprema: VKV/SSS, važeće uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa Koeficijent složenosti poslova: 1,61 Radno iskustvo: 1 godina Posebna znanja i vještine: nisu potrebna Opis poslova: vrši nadzor vodene površine s kopna ili čamca te površine bazena, provodi preventivne aktivnosti vezane uz sigurnost korisnika te brinu za sigurnost korisnika u smislu životne ugroze i spašavanja iz vode, pruža neodgodivu prvu pomoć, vrši neprekidan nadzor na svom području djelovanja za koje je zadužen i odgovoran tijekom u vremenu utvrđenom rasporedom, nadzire poštivanje bazenskog i plažnog reda, brine za čistoću bazena, raspored pruga, rekvizita i opreme na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, dnevno obavlja čišćenje bazenskog oplošja i/ili plaže, sudjeluje u pripremi i realizaciji sportskih natjecanja ili drugih događanja na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, osigurava natjecanja na vodi te druge manifestacije u blizini vode, daje informacije korisnicima u smislu uputa i pravila za korištenje bazena, jezera ili plaže, uz spasilačke poslove, sudjeluje kao ispomoć realizatorima sportskih programa u provođenju sportskih programa, provjere plivanja i dr., prema potrebi, obavlja redarske poslove na prostoru cijelog objekta, odgovoran je za stanje skladišta rekvizita i opreme, vodi pisanu evidenciju o dnevnom čišćenju bazena, intervencijama te oštećenjima na bazenu, jezeru ili plaži, sudjeluje u remontu bazena, prvenstveno u čišćenju školjke i oplošja bazena, obavlja i druge poslove po nalogu nadređenog u okviru stručne spreme i djelokruga rada. Plaću radnika čine osnovna odnosno ugovorena plaća i dodaci na osnovnu plaću. Osnovna plaća je umnožak koeficijenta složenosti poslova radnog mjesta na kojemu radnik radi i osnovice za izračun plaće, uvećan za 0,5 % za svaku navršenu godinu radnog staža. Osnovica za obračun plaće iznosi 1.075,94 eura bruto. Na javni natječaj se mogu javiti osobe oba spola. Radni odnos se zasniva na neodređeno vrijeme, uz obavezni probni rad u trajanju od 6 mjeseci. Kandidati su u prijavi dužni navesti osobne podatke (ime i prezime, adresa stanovanja, broj telefona odnosno mobitela, po mogućnosti e-mail adresa), naziv i redni broj radnog mjesta za koje se podnosi prijava. Kandidati koji se natječu za više radnih mjesta dužni su za svako radno mjesto podnijeti posebnu prijavu. Uz svaku prijavu dužni su priložiti traženu dokumentaciju. Kandidati su prilikom prijave dužni priložiti sljedeću dokumentaciju: • prijavu za javni natječaj (obrazac prijave može se preuzeti na web-stranici Ustanove: https://www.sportskiobjekti.hr/pravilnici-i-natjecaji/1164), • životopis, • dokaz o državljanstvu (osobna iskaznica, putovnica, vojna iskaznica ili domovnica), • dokaz o stručnoj spremi: presliku diplome ili svjedodžbe (ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži inozemnu kvalifikaciju, dužan je uz istu dostaviti i dokaz o priznavanju inozemne obrazovne kvalifikacije), • uvjerenje o nevođenju kaznenog postupka (ne starije od 3 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja), • uvjerenje o osposobljenosti Hrvatskog Crvenog križa (preslika uvjerenja) – za radno mjesto pod rednim brojem 2., • dokaz o ukupnom radnom iskustvu, ne stariji od 1 mjeseca od dana objave javnog natječaja: Elektronički zapis (e–radna knjižica) ili Potvrda o podacima evidentiranim u matičnoj evidenciji Hrvatskog zavoda za mirovinsko osiguranje, a koji Zapis/Potvrda, između ostalih podataka, mora sadržavati i podatke o poslodavcu, početku i prestanku osiguranja, stvarnoj i potrebnoj stručnoj spremi, radnom vremenu, općini rada – prebivališta i trajanju staža osiguranja. Kandidati koji dostavljaju dokumentaciju na stranom jeziku dužni su uz istu dostaviti ovjereni prijevod na hrvatski jezik. Ukoliko kandidat uz prijavu priloži dokumente u kojima osobni podaci nisu istovjetni, dužan je dostaviti i dokaz o njihovoj promjeni (presliku vjenčanog ili rodnog lista). Kandidat koji ostvaruje pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju prema posebnim propisima dužan je u prijavi na javni natječaj pozvati se na to pravo i ima prednost u odnosu na ostale kandidate samo pod jednakim uvjetima. Da bi ostvario pravo prednosti pri zapošljavanju, kandidat koji ispunjava uvjete za ostvarivanje toga prava, dužan je uz prijavu na javni natječaj priložiti sve dokaze o ispunjavanju uvjeta iz natječaja, kao i rješenje, odnosno potvrdu o priznatom statusu, te dokaz iz kojeg je vidljivo na koji način je prestao radni odnos kod posljednjeg poslodavca (ugovor, rješenje, odluka i sl.) Temeljem članka 103. Zakona o hrvatskim braniteljima iz Domovinskog rata i članovima njihove obitelji (Narodne novine, 121/17, 98/19, 84/21 i 156/23) i članka 49. Zakona o civilnim stradalnicima iz Domovinskog rata (Narodne novine, 84/21), kandidati koji se pozivaju na pravo prednosti dužni su dostaviti sve dokaze iz citiranih odredbi Zakona. Dokazi potrebni za ostvarivanje prava prednosti pri zapošljavanju objavljeni su na Internet stranici Ministarstva hrvatskih branitelja Republike Hrvatske https://branitelji.gov.hr/pristup-informacijama/835 . Kandidat koji se, sukladno članku 9. Zakona o profesionalnoj rehabilitaciji i zapošljavanju osoba s invaliditetom (Narodne novine, 157/13, 152/14, 39/18 i 32/20), poziva na pravo prednosti prilikom zapošljavanja, dužan je uz prijavu na natječaj, osim dokaza o ispunjavanju traženih uvjeta, priložiti i dokaz o utvrđenom statusu osobe s invaliditetom. Urednom prijavom smatra se prijava koja sadrži sve podatke i dokumentaciju navedenu u javnom natječaju. Osoba koja nije podnijela pravodobnu i urednu prijavu ili ne ispunjava formalne uvjete iz javnog natječaja, ne smatra se kandidatom prijavljenim na javni natječaj. Kandidati prijavljeni na javni natječaj bit će pozvani pisanim putem na prethodnu provjeru znanja i sposobnosti bitnih za obavljanje poslova radnog mjesta na koje se primaju. Prethodnoj provjeri znanja i sposobnosti mogu pristupiti samo kandidati koji ispunjavaju formalne uvjete iz natječaja. Ako kandidat ne pristupi prethodnoj provjeri znanja, smatra se da je povukao prijavu na javni natječaj i više se ne smatra kandidatom. Rok za podnošenje prijava je 8 (osam) dana od dana objave javnog natječaja u novinama, na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči HZZ-a te na web-stranici i oglasnoj ploči ustanove Upravljanje sportskim objektima. Prijave s naznakom „ZA NATJEČAJ – PRIJAM U RADNI ODNOS – NAZIV I REDNI BROJ RADNOG MJESTA ZA KOJE SE PODNOSI PRIJAVA“ dostavljaju se na adresu: Upravljanje sportskim objektima, Baštijanova 52a, 10 000 Zagreb. Ustanova Upravljanje sportskim objektima zadržava pravo poništenja natječaja, u cijelosti i/ili u dijelu, odnosno pravo ne odabrati niti jednog kandidata, bez obveze obrazlaganja svoje odluke i bez ikakve odgovornosti prema kandidatima. jobs.title: 100% Remote Technical Implementation Manager (Hotel PMS / CRS Integration Specialist) EN (Hotelfachmann/-frau)
jobs.description:
Weitere Berufsbezeichnung:
Hotel Revenue Manager; Hotel Systems Experte

Stellenbeschreibung:
Hotel PMS use Experience Required (please do not apply if you have never used a hotel PMS)

Location: Fully Remote (EU preferred – Spain / Portugal / Southern Europe or global if compatible with EOR or contractor setup)
Employment Type: Full-Time (Flexible Hours)
Experience Level: Experience with hotel systems required
Salary Range: €30.000 - 45.000

Company Overview

Hotel Res Bot is a fast-growing SaaS company building AI-powered automation systems for the hospitality industry.

Our platform automatically reads incoming reservation emails and generates tailored offers for guests.

Unlike many traditional hotel systems, we work entirely with live real-time data from PMS, CRS, IBE, and Channel Manager APIs. Because of this, stable integrations and accurate data flow are critical to our product.

This is where this role comes in.

Job Summary

Are you the person at the hotel everyone turns to when the PMS stops syncing, the channel manager misbehaves, or integrations break?  This can be a great transition role into hotel tech from hotel operations

We are looking for a Hotel Systems Integration Specialist to take ownership of technical connectivity and implementation for our hotel partners.

This role is focused specifically on integration execution and system connectivity. You will work closely with our Account Management and Support teams, but you will not be responsible for commercial account management or first-line customer support. Your primary responsibility is ensuring that integrations between hotel systems and our platform are configured, tested, and functioning reliably.

You will also play an important internal role by helping our developers understand new PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager integrations — translating vendor documentation, operational workflows, and real-world hotel requirements into clear technical specifications and test scenarios.

What You’ll Do (Responsibilities)

Own Technical Onboarding
Lead the technical setup and activation of new hotel clients on our platform.

Ensure Reliable Connectivity
Configure, test, and validate integrations between our system and hotel PMS, CRS, and Channel Manager environments.

Translate Hotel Requirements into Technical Specs
When hotels request specific workflows (e.g. reservation field mapping, folio posting rules, or company profile handling), analyze whether and how their PMS APIs support it.

Work with API Documentation & Testing Tools
Use tools like Postman to test API endpoints, validate responses, and confirm system behavior before implementation.

Bridge to Engineering
Translate integration findings into clear, actionable specifications and GitLab tickets for the engineering team.

Troubleshoot Integration Issues
Investigate and resolve connectivity problems such as synchronization errors, missing reservation data, or incorrect folio postings.

Guide Hotel Technical Teams
Support hotel IT, revenue, or operations teams through setup steps such as API authentication (e.g. Microsoft Graph) and simple DNS configuration (e.g. CNAME records).

What We Are Looking For

Must Have

Experience with Hotel Systems Required
Previous experience working with hotel systems (such as PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, or other hotel operations platforms) is required.

Interface (API) Curiosity & Documentation Skills
Ability to read and interpret API documentation and figure out how to validate behavior using tools like Postman.

Technical Comfort (No Coding Required)
Comfort working with structured data (JSON/XML), basic API concepts, and technical troubleshooting workflows.

Strong Communication Skills
Ability to communicate clearly with both hotel operational teams and technical stakeholders.

Problem-Solving Mindset
You enjoy investigating why systems don’t work and prefer practical solutions over theoretical perfection.

Fluent English
Written and spoken.  No German required.

Nice to Have (We Can Teach You)

- Experience using Postman for API testing
- Basic understanding of DNS / CNAME configuration
- Experience with PMS vendors such as Mews, Opera, Cloudbeds, Protel, SiteMinder, D-EDGE, SynXis, or Apaleo
- Previous experience in hotel tech (PMS, Channel Manager, CRS, IBE vendors)

What Success Looks Like

Within 6 weeks, you will be independently:

- Onboarding and configuring hotel system integrations
- Testing API endpoints and validating integration behavior
- Translating hotel requirements into clear technical specifications
- Creating actionable engineering tickets for integration work
- Supporting live troubleshooting of connectivity issues

Culture & Working Style

We are a fully remote, international team operating in a trust-based environment.

We value:

- Remote & flexibility first – work from anywhere, structure your day how it works best for you
- High autonomy with high responsibility – you own your work end-to-end
- Strong error culture – mistakes are expected as part of learning; we focus on fixing and improving, not blaming
- Respectful communication – direct feedback is welcome, personal attacks are not
- Pragmatism over perfection – we prefer working systems over theoretical perfection

We work in a fast-moving environment where clarity improves over time through iteration, not upfront perfection.

Benefits

- Fully remote position
- Flexible working hours
- Direct access to engineering and product teams
- High autonomy and ownership
- Opportunity to grow into technical product or engineering roles
- Equipment provided (laptop + accessories if needed)

How to Apply

Please send your application to: career@hotelresbot.com

Please include:

- CV or short professional background
- Brief cover letter explaining: - Your experience with hotel systems (PMS, CRS, Channel Managers, etc.)
- Your comfort level with reading API documentation and using tools like Postman
- Why you are interested in hotel SaaS implementation and connectivity

Ergänzende Informationen:
Homeoffice:
Umfang: Maximal 100%
Anforderungen an den Bewerber:
Grundkenntnisse: Datenaustauschformat JSON, Tourismusplattformen und Buchungssysteme
Erweiterte Kenntnisse: Hotelverwaltungs-, Reservierungssystem Opera, Reservierung (Hotel- und Gaststättengewerbe)

This full-cycle sales position encompasses new client acquisition. We believe this role offers a distinctive opportunity for people who excel in client-facing situations and have a passion for driving sales and AI. You'll leverage your skills to effectively communicate Replit's value proposition: a world where anyone can create software using natural language.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL:

 - Evangelize a future where anyone can create software in natural language, ushering in a change in the nature of the firm on par with the PC era

 - Serve as the primary point of contact for prospects and customers, guiding them through the buying journey

REQUIRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

 - Experience with, or direct observations of full-cycle sales, from prospecting to closing deals to managing existing customers

 - Proficiency in using CRM systems and sales tools (e.g., Hubspot)

 - Ability to quickly learn and articulate the value of new technologies

 - Experience with or strong interest in AI and machine learning is a plus

NICE TO HAVE:

 - You're an active Replit user

TOOLS + TECH STACK FOR THIS ROLE:

THIS ROLE MAY NOT BE A FIT IF:

jobs.description:

About the role We are seeking a Mechanical Technician to join our team supporting underground mining operations in Navan, Ireland. Working as part of a small, highly collaborative maintenance team, you will be responsible for maintaining, servicing, troubleshooting, and repairing bulk explosives pumping systems and associated equipment used in underground mining environments. This is a hands-on role that requires a strong mechanical background, a proactive attitude, and the ability to work independently in a safety-critical environment. While the primary focus is mechanical maintenance, knowledge of electrical systems, PLCs, and industrial controls would be highly advantageous. The successful candidate will play a critical role in supporting equipment reliability, operational uptime, and safe production outcomes while working closely with operational and maintenance stakeholders underground. What you will be doing Maintain, troubleshoot, and repair bulk explosives pumping equipment and associated mechanical systems used in underground mining operations. Perform preventative and corrective maintenance activities to maximise equipment reliability and availability. Diagnose and resolve mechanical faults, supporting operational continuity and minimising downtime. Assist in identifying and resolving electrical and PLC-related issues where required, collaborating with specialist support teams as necessary. Support maintenance planning and execution activities to ensure safe and efficient operations. Participate in on-call rotations and respond to maintenance call-outs outside standard working hours when required. Maintain accurate maintenance records and documentation. Work collaboratively across site functions, supporting operational requirements beyond core trade responsibilities when needed. Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with all Safety, Health, Environment and Security (SHES) standards, policies, and procedures. Align all activities with Orica’s Charter Values, Purpose, and Strategy. What you will bring Relevant trade qualification, diploma, degree, or equivalent experience in Mechanical Maintenance or a related discipline. Experience working in industrial, mining, heavy equipment, maintenance, or similar environments. Experience maintaining pumps, hydraulic systems, rotating equipment, or similar mechanical systems. Previous underground mining experience is strongly preferred. Knowledge of electrical systems, industrial controls, or PLCs would be highly advantageous. Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills with a practical, hands-on approach. Ability to work independently and safely in a remote operational environment. Strong work ethic and willingness to contribute across multiple operational activities. Effective communication and collaboration skills. This role requires participation in an on-call roster, including out-of-hours and weekend call-outs.

jobs.description:
Har du hænderne godt skruet på og har lyst til at være med til at fremtille kvalitetsprodukter? Og har du lyst til at blive del at et godt hold og en arbejdsplads i udvikling?

Så kom med om bord på Team Plagborg.

Jobbet

Sammen med dine andre kollegaer får du din egen arbejdsplads, med eget værktøj, udstyr og det hele.

Dine opgave bliver at håndbygge dele og halvfabrikata, som bliver en del opbygningen af nye varebiler og lastbiler.

Du er den dygtige gør-det-selv håndværkertype, som ud fra en skitse eller en model finder gode kvalitetsløsninger på tekniske og håndværksmæssige opgaver.

Ingen dage er ens, og du arbejder med mange forskellige opgaver og materialer, blandt andet aluminium, stål, plast og befæstelse.

Du bliver en del af et team af gode kollegaer med et godt sammenhold, og vi står klar med et godt fællesskab, åbenhed og humor.

Arbejdet er på daghold.

Din baggrund og erfaring

Du er god til at bruge dine hænder, og du sætter en dyd i at lave delene på den helt rette måde, så det ender med et slutprodukt i den ønskede kvalitet.

Du har teknisk flair, er detaljeorienteret og kvalitetsbevidst, og du har erfaring med håndværktøj, bearbejdning og montage. 

Din uddannelsesmæssig baggrund er ikke afgørende, og du modtager en grundig oplæring.

Du er en holdspiller som selv kan tage initiativ, og du er kvalitetsbevidst og er god til præcisionsarbejde.

Du bliver en del af et team med trivsel og arbejdslyst i fokus

Vi er en spændende virksomhed i udvikling, og i fællesskab bygger vi hver dag mange forskellige nye produkter efter kundernes ønsker.

Ja, faktisk er vi nogle af de største og bedste, så du kommer med på vinderholdet.

Du bliver en del af et team med mange forskellige mennesker og typer, som har til fælles at vi brænder for hinanden og for vores kunderne.

Det er ikke bare noget vi siger, for det er noget vi gør hver dag – og vi beviser det gennem vores trivselsmålinger. Du kan se mere her: https://www.plagborg.dk/karriere/hils-paa-vores-medarbejdere.aspx

Hvis du spørgsmål, så kontakt gerne Adm. direktør Erik T. Lauridsen på telefon 21213242 eller på mail etl@plagborg.dk

jobs.title: Open applications for Chief Engineer
jobs.employer: THE QRILL COMPANY AS AVD ÅLESUND
jobs.description:
Aker QRILL Company is a world leader in the sustainable production of krill-based products. We are dedicated to enhancing the nutritional value of feed for aquaculture and livestock and contributing to a more sustainable global food system. Our business has experienced consistent growth within the Aker BioMarine organization. In 2024 we were spun out as a stand-alone entity, and we remain a reputable company in the maritime industry known for a focus on operational excellence. Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

We are now looking for a Chief Engineer who will work on board our vessels in Antarctica

As the Chief Engineer, you will oversee all technical operations within our organization. You will be responsible for leading the engine department, managing projects, and ensuring the efficient operation and maintenance of our equipment and facilities. The ideal candidate will have a strong background as Chief Engineer, exceptional leadership skills, and a proven track record of success in similar roles. Chief Engineer is overall responsible and in charge of all technical installations onboard the vessel, and all R&M and ordering of spare parts for these components as well as responsible for, and being sure costs are held at or below budget.

Other responsibilities will be:

  • Lead and manage the engine department, providing guidance, mentoring, and support to achieve project goals and objectives.

  • Oversee the design, development, and implementation of engineering projects, ensuring compliance with industry standards and regulations.

  • Manage the maintenance and repair of equipment and infrastructure, optimizing efficiency and minimizing downtime.

  • Collaborate with other departments to support company objectives and initiatives.

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve operational performance and reduce costs.

  • Ensure compliance with safety regulations and promote a culture of safety within the engine department.

Your profile

Are you the Chief Engineer we’re looking for?

The right candidate has experience from, preferably, other shipping or fishing companies. You are structured and systematic yet flexible and responsive. You have a positive, can-do attitude and manage to roll up your sleeves with the motivation to respond in a 24/7/365 operation.

Qualifications:

  • Engineer Officer Class 1, CoC M1.

  • Medical Certificate

  • Safety Course for officers

  • At least 5 years of experience in role as Chief Engineer.

  • Strong leadership and management skills, with the ability to inspire and motivate a team.

  • Excellent problem-solving abilities and analytical skills.

  • Proficient in project management software and tools.

  • Knowledge of regulatory requirements and industry best practices.

  • Effective communication skills, both verbal and written.


Location: Vessel/Antarctica


Application and contact information

Does this sound like an exciting opportunity? Please don't hesitate to apply as we will be contacting candidates on an ongoing basis. 

Please send your application letter and CV in either English or Norwegian via the application link.


About Aker QRILL Company:

We develop ingredients for use in the aquaculture and animal feed markets, as well as deliver raw materials for production of human health supplements. Our value chain stretches from our vessels and sustainable krill harvesting operations in Antarctica, through our logistics hub in Montevideo, and all the way to customers around the world.

The Company operates a fleet of five vessels, including two cargo vessel and three fishing vessels, leading krill fishing within the Antarctic region. The three fishing vessels operate on the fishing grounds year-round, except for one month in October, which is dedicated to maintenance and repairs while the cargo vessel transports products and crew to and from the fishing grounds throughout the year.

Our offices are located in Fornebu and Ålesund, with the logistics base and product warehouse in Montevideo, Uruguay. We are about 500 employees globally, of which about 430 work on board our krill vessels in Antarctica. We are a diverse company with more than 25 nationalities, spread across all time zones and most continents. Together, we form an international, high performing, diverse and fun work environment.

Working with us means you appreciate diversity, are highly skilled within your field and can cope with unexpected situations. You enjoy a fast pace, tolerate quick decisions and continuously ongoing changes. You are a true team player who “chips in” when the situation requires so.

QRILL™ Aqua is a functional feed ingredient for shrimp, marine fish, and salmonids, increasing productivity in aquaculture - through improved growth, health and quality.

QRILL™ Pet is a functional ingredient for pet nutrition with documented health benefits for companion animals. Proven in numerous studies to benefit pet health, the omega-3s help maintain the health of the heart, kidneys, liver, joints, brain, eyes, skin and coat.

Why should you be part of our team?

You can expect hard work and a lot of fun and challenges. In return we promise you will be part of an exciting journey. If you show initiative and desire for more responsibility, we will give it to you and support you along the way. We strongly believe that our team of people want to do their best. All in the spirit of being the leading company in our industry and always striving to raise the bar.

Om arbeidsgiveren:

We are the world’s leading krill company, delivering premium ingredients for human and animal nutrition. Aker QRILL Company is an Antarctic krill-harvesting company dedicated to improving health across species. We develop krill-based ingredients for nutraceutical, aquaculture, and animal feed applications, backed by rigorous science and research into krill’s benefits. Sustainability is at the core of our operations, rooted in world-class standards.

 - Drive workflow adoption and value realization for a book of named accounts ensuring your customers know how to deliver outcomes with Notion

 - Contribute directly to NRR with predictable renewal and expansion pipeline and proactive product adoption for your book of business

 - Partner closely with Solutions Consultants on strategy for expansion and renewal for shared accounts, including owning the commercial opportunity for flat and at-risk renewals

 - Define and maintain mutual success plans that proactively guide customers through their AI Transformation and demonstrate ROI to executive-level stakeholders with periodic business reviews

 - Facilitate use-case consultations that guide customers through their continuous Solutions Design and identify new workflow opportunities that drive outcomes and increase value with Notion

 - Identify opportunities to engage Services for customers with complex or technical implementation needs and partner closely with the Services team throughout delivery to ensure successful outcomes and value delivered

 - Learn Notion’s product and the broader AI ecosystem inside and out so you can be best suited help customers navigate new ways of working and build durable systems in Notion as the underlying system

 - Help build and deliver OA programs that generate customer and business outcomes across Notion’s install base




SKILLS YOU'LL NEED TO BRING

 - 3+ years of experience driving customer adoption, value realization, renewals, or expansion within a B2B software environment

 - Strong customer-facing discovery instincts, with the ability to understand business problems, map workflows, and translate goals into practical implementation plans

 - Technical fluency and presence as a trusted advisor—while you won't be building for your customers, you should be capable of co-design, configuring, and troubleshooting Notion workspaces and workflows

 - Commercial awareness and the ability to partner with account owners on renewal risk, expansion potential, and account strategy

 - Ability to design and help customers build workflows that drive usage based consumption, connecting adoption patterns to measurable commercial outcomes

 - Strong program and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to manage success plans, timelines, risks, and customer commitments across a book of accounts

 - You operate with agency, urgency, and customer empathy, bringing structure to ambiguous problems and helping teams move from ideas to working systems

 - You’re obsessed with AI, constantly building with the newest tools and learning new ways of working




NICE TO HAVES

 - Prior experience in customer success, solutions consulting, implementation, technical account management, or post-sales strategy for productivity, collaboration, or workflow software

 - Experience working with flat, at-risk, or complex renewal accounts and helping customers return to a clear value path

 - Experience partnering in a shared account ownership model with sales, solutions, support, or implementation teams

 - Experience designing repeatable customer programs, playbooks, or interventions that improve retention, expansion, and adoption at scale
